name: Abbadomon
raw_text: A mysterious Digimon that evolved enormously by absorbing the negative data that the [[Network]] is overflowing with beyond its limit. Its raison d'être is to transcend good and evil, and return everything to nothingness. It bites into Digimon and the [[Digital World]] itself with the large mouth at its center and the mouths on its numerous tentacles, and after doing so, only empty, blank data is left behind. The birth of Abbadomon is undoubtedly a crisis for the entire Digital World, and it is conjectured that some [[Digital World (concept)|Digital World]]s from other dimensions have been annihilated by it.{{br}}Its Special Moves are firing cursed beams from all of the eyes on its tentacles ({{AT|Gaze Eraser}}), seizing the enemy with its tentacles and swallowing them whole with its central mouth ({{AT|Gala-lightness}}), and additionally, firing a white beam from that mouth ({{AT|White Liner}}); you will be erased the instant you suffer any of these techniques. name: Abbadomon Core
raw_text: The main body that exists within [[Abbadomon]], it is its true form. It seeks nothingness, prefers nothingness, and rejects everything except nothingness. After it turns everything into nothingness, it disappears itself, fulfilling its purpose.{{br}}Its Special Move is making the energy that it shoots from both of its hands stick to the enemy, corroding them, and gnawing away at their whole body ({{AT|Eclipse None}}). In addition, it has "{{AT|Bingerard}}", in which it transforms its right arm into a spear and pierces with it, and "{{AT|Death Charge}}", in which it transforms its left arm into a gun barrel and fires energy shots. Also, its "{{AT|Gaze Eraser}}", cursed beams fired from all of the eyes on its cape, is even more cursed than when it is performed by Abbadomon. name: Achillesmon
raw_text: Confuses the enemy with afterimages caused by its high-speed movement. A kicking technique that it dishes out using its swift speed. Throws its divine spear and ensures that it pierces the enemy's [[Digicore]].

name: Aegiochusmon
raw_text: A God Man Digimon which synthesized the abilities of various species, using a humanoid body as a base. This synthesis of species is said to have resulted from the pursuit of the ultimate state, or omnipotence, dramatically altering its appearance to match its surroundings. This form is composed of data taken from the Dragon-species, so the Dragon-species data lying dormant within its body manifests on the surface of its body, centered upon the crystal in its chest, and establishes itself as armor. This armor is a Powered Suit that affects not only Aegiochusmon's defensive power but also its physical strength, drastically increasing its offensive power. Its Special Moves are commencing a rush attack with fists shrouded in the thunder produced from its horn ({{AT|Bolt Break Knockdown}}), and shaping thunder into a pile, then impaling the opponent from just overhead to drive them into the ground ({{AT|Lightning Pile}}). It is said that if the pile of "{{AT|Lightning Pile}}" pierces the opponent once, the piles cast afterward will always hit, regardless from where they're cast. Also, it has a technique called "{{AT|Charging Strike}}" which pierces the opponent's head with its horn using a high speed charge that capitalizes on its prided leg strength. This form is composed of data taken from the Dragon-tribe, so the data of the Dragon-tribe sleeping within its body manifests on the surface of its body, centered upon the crystal in its chest, and establishes itself as armor. This armor is a Powered Suit that affects not only Aegiochusmon's defensive power but also its physical strength, drastically increasing its offensive power. A form that released hidden power, and evolved from Aegiomon. Rushes in and attacks with fists shrouded in lightning from its horn. Forms a pile out of lightning and impales the enemy with it from overhead, driving them into the ground. Uses its leg strength for a high speed charge that stabs the opponent's head with its horn. Restores the party's Digimon by one [[Level|Generation]].{{ref|''[[Digimon Story: Time Stranger]]''}}

name: Aegiomon
raw_text: A God Man Digimon that has an appearance fusing the lower body of a goat with the upper body of a human. As a member of the same musical troupe as [[Sirenmon]], it is usually playing the pipes called "{{EQ|w=Syrinx}}" hung at its waist and enjoying the music. Although it has a peace-loving personality and doesn't really like to fight, the power it conceals within is unquantified, and when Aegiomon fights to protect something, it exhibits unique talent for combat. It is said that by playing the "{{AT|Attract Echo}}", which attracts the attention of those who hear it, on the {{EQ|Syrinx}} it possesses, Aegiomon snatches away the sense of self of those who continue to listen to its sound, and blinds them to everything but its figure. With this, it can produce an opportunity for other Digimon to flee, or a chance for them to pursue. Its Special Moves are hurling a sharp, backwards kick with its prided goat legs ({{AT|Iron Trust}}), and beating the opponent while releasing the electricity circulating within its body from a portion of its arms, numbing the opponent's sensitivity and dulling their movements ({{AT|Stun Beat Blow}}). Although it has a peace-loving personality and doesn't really like to fight, the power it conceals within is unquantified, and when Aegiomon fights to protect something, it exhibits unique talent for combat. A Digimon that conceals great power and plays a central role in the story. A God Man Digimon that has an appearance fusing the lower body of a goat with the upper body of a human. name: Aegisdramon
raw_text: A Cyborg Digimon born from the fusion of a [[Plesiomon]] with [[Seadramon-species]] data. It is said that its shining armor, made of [[Gold Digizoid]], will purify all evil. It is a member of the [[Crack Team]], and is mainly in charge of analyzing information on the enemy and reconnaissance. It is also known as the brains of the Crack Team due to the fact that the analyzed information is quickly sent to the Crack Team deployed to its surroundings, allowing them to keep the upper hand in combat situations. In addition, it has enough firepower to wipe out a whole battalion, even when acting alone. Its Special Moves are firing gigantic shots of water from both its arms ({{AT|Power Water}}), shooting down an enemy it has {{w|radar lock-on|locked}} onto with missiles launched from its deck ({{AT|Blaze Power}}), and crushing the opponent with a water current spewed out from its mouth ({{AT|Tera Hydro Breath}}). Also, it has "{{AT|Shine Breaker}}", wherein it simultaneously fires a large quantity of missiles enough to cover the sky, and charges upon the enemy at its maximum output. name: Aero V-dramon
raw_text: [[V-dramon]] evolved further, and as Aero V-dramon, it became able to move through the sky. Among the rare species of V-dramon, it is said that only veteran warriors that have come through numerous battles are able to evolve, so its existence is already becoming a legend. Not only did its evolution grant it wings, but it also evolved several parts of its body for better grappling, acquiring stronger offensive and defensive power. If you include its attacks from the sky, there are probably no longer any opponents who can rival Aero V-dramon. Its Special Moves are forming a {{w|V}}-shaped energy substance that seems to connect the horn on its snout to the edges of its wings, then soaring towards the opponent ({{AT|V-Wing Blade}}), and launching a shock wave which has the appearance of a dragon ({{AT|Dragon Impulse}}). Although "{{AT|V Wing Blade}}" is a technique that cuts the opponent to pieces with the blades of its wings, its weakness is that it cannot be used if it is not in flight. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Among the few [[V-dramon]] that exist in the world, only the toughest that win countless battles can evolve into this form. With its high-level offense/defense, as well as its added ability to attack from the skies, it's said to be unbeatable. Its Special Move is an upside-down V-shaped energy mass that is shot straight at the enemy, "{{AT|V Wing Blade}}".  The legendary holy dragon Digimon that evolves from [[V-dramon]] after it has won many battles. It grows wings so that it may fly the skies. Its body is evolved for better combat, earning itself high-level offense and defense skills.  {{MultiDesc Launches an explosive shock wave with the appearance of a dragon.{{DD|a|earov-dramon}} Punches foe with fist of glowing energy.{{ref|''[[Digimon World: Digital Card Arena]]''}} Charges up blades on its wrists with energy and slashes at the foe.{{ref|''[[Digimon World: Digital Card Arena]]''}} An attack identical to {{AT|Twister Saber}}. Uses wings to call a flurry of winds that create a wind barrier.{{ref|''[[V-23|Digimon Adventure V-Tamer 01: "Mighty Wing"]]''}} Spews a high-temperature, V-shaped heat ray from its mouth.{{ref|''[[V-23|Digimon Adventure V-Tamer 01: "Mighty Wing"]]''}}

name: Agumon (2006 Anime Version)
raw_text: A unique [[Agumon]] which has bound red leather belts around its arms, its maturation is presumed to differ from its traditional evolutions. As it's still growing, its power is weak, but it has grown hard, sharp claws on its hands and feet, and demonstrates its power in battle. Its Special Move is spewing flaming breath from its mouth, striking the opponent ({{AT|Baby Flame}}). Also, it can amass "{{AT|Baby Flame}}" in its mouth and then spew it out all at once ({{AT|Baby Burner}}), which is much more powerful. Having grown up and become able to walk on two legs, it is a Reptile Digimon which has an appearance like a tiny dinosaur. name: Arcturusmon
raw_text: A mysterious Digimon that is said to have evolved by concentrating dark, evil energy to the extreme. In a study on certain Digimon that produce the secretion known as GRB Factor, it was found that they "theoretically" evolved when a simulation was conducted in which large amounts of [[Gulus Realm Burst|GRB Factor]] were injected into the Digimon that produce it themselves to their limit. Although the simulation was repeated hundreds of times, all of the simulation results confirmed that they would evolve into this Digimon, so it is theorized to be a Digimon that can manifest even in the real [[Digital World]] as long as the conditions are met. It is unknown what sort of ecology it has, but since the level of dark energy measured in the simulation was by far the highest among Digimon that have currently been discovered, it is conjectured that when this Digimon manifests, it will generate a [[Digital Hazard]] that drastically alters the environment of the Digital World. Its supposed Special Moves are piercing the opponent with the drills on its arms and injecting them with GRB Factor to corrode them ({{AT|Black Death}}), and coating the drills on both its arms with large amounts of GRB Factor and spinning them rapidly, allowing it to compress the GRB Factor to its utmost limit, and then shooting it ({{AT|Black Confession}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Pierces the opponent with the drills on its arms, and injects them with GRB Factor to corrode them.{{DD|a}} Coats the drills on both its arms with large amounts of GRB Factor and spins them rapidly, allowing it to compress the GRB Factor to its utmost limit, and then shoots it.{{DD|a}}

name: Arma Lizamon
raw_text: A Reptile Digimon whose whole body is covered in hard scales. It has a habit of consuming high-density minerals in order to maintain the hardness of its scales, and is based near mineral deposits. It has a nature of wandering around in search of new veins once it can no longer extract minerals from a deposit. The minerals devoured by Arma Lizamon are broken down into particles in a "disintegration reactor" housed within it, which are then converted into energy via the vein-shaped particle accelerator that runs throughout its entire body, and is consumed as an energy source for maintaining the hardness of the scales covering its whole body or when attacking. Its "{{AT|Neutron Laser}}", in which it fires charged neutrons generated by the particle accelerator inside its body from its mouth, excels in penetrability, and is powerful enough to pierce even Perfects that are superior to it when unleashed at full power. In addition, it can also attack over a vast range with its "{{AT|Neutron Diffuser}}", in which it fires scattered beams, albeit diminished in power. During close combat, it burns through the enemy with its "{{AT|Neutron Blade}}", beam-shaped blades formed from emitting charged neutrons by expanding the scales on its arms. As it consumes high-density minerals, an Arma Lizamon with a full stomach becomes extremely heavy in weight, so its "{{AT|Death Roll Press}}", where it curls up its body and performs a rolling tackle, exhibits maximum destructive force when it is full. Since it must consume a sufficient amount of minerals for any of its attack methods to be highly effective, individuals found at their mineral deposit feeding grounds are belligerent, but those wandering around in search of veins are low on energy and rarely fight, often fleeing. It also cooperates with Minidekachimon and spews flaming breath from its mouth in "{{AT|Minideka Flame}}", but it is uncertain whether the flames will be small or large until it comes out. raw_text: A Pterosaur Digimon with three enormous blades growing from its body. The ferocious predator Azhdarmon inhabits cold mountainous regions, reigning as the {{w|apex predator|top predator}} in its habitat. Possessing strong eyesight, it spots prey from extremely high up in the sky without being detected, then performs a nosedive, and skillfully uses the blades on its body to bring down its prey. Since it is a top predator, it is seldom attacked by other Digimon, but there are several occasions where they lose their lives in battle due to territorial disputes between other Azhdarmon over hunting grounds. raw_text: A Baby Dragon Digimon whose body bears a striking resemblance to a dragon. name: Bacchusmon
raw_text: One of the [[Olympos XII]], it styles itself the [[Digital World]]'s foremost drinker. It is very caring with a cheerful personality, and gathers Child or Adult Digimon to hold parties day and night. Because it is able to distill any kind of alcohol within its body, it is said that at parties it answers the requests of the Digimon it has befriended and treats them to alcohol. It prefers the taste of fruit wine, and its favorite fruit wine is something fermented from the sweets borne by the "{{EQO|Karpos Hulē|Fruit Forest}}" forest carried on [[Ceresmon]]'s back, so whenever it can snatch a moment it eagerly requests Ceresmon to "Let me brew fruit wine." For that reason, it is on very good terms with Ceresmon, and they often act together.{{br}}Its Special Moves are wrapping up the opponent in both of its hands, transforming their configuration data into drinking snacks, and then eating them ({{AT|Cook of the Hell}}), and refining alcohol mixed with deadly poisons that cause sleep or paralysis within its body, and then pouring it over the opponent to leave them incapacitated ({{AT|Party of the Heaven}}). Anyone who tries to peek at the insides of the cardboard boxes will end up getting packed into and trapped within one of the boxes. It is not fond of battling as the cardboard covering it is very soft. Wraps the enemy in packing tape.{{DD|ha}} Packs the enemy in a cardboard box and hurls it away.{{DD|ha}}

name: Bagramon
raw_text: Although it was originally a {{w|Azrael|high-ranking Angel Digimon that ruled over death}}, it despaired against the unreasonable justice of the world and rebelled against [[God]]. It then received the scourge of God and eternally lost one of its eyes and half of its body, and has since replaced that half with an artificial body cut from a [[Yggdrasill|sacred tree]]. Its long, artificial right arm can catch hold of ghostly forms, and rip the soul out of a living Digimon's body. The extracted soul can be sent to heaven or hell as Bagramon pleases, and can even be placed in another Digimon's body, a Signature Move of Bagramon's named "{{AT|Astral Snatcher}}". The large ruby with which it replaced its lost eye conceals its "{{AT|Invisible Snake-eyes}}", a power that allows it to observe anywhere within the [[Digital World]], and with this ability, Bagramon is able to instantly obtain any information it wants to know. For this reason, Bagramon is known across the Digital World as the "{{NN|Sage of Death}}". Although Bagramon's sins would be forgiven if it repented before God, Bagramon will not go back to submission under God. This is because Bagramon still seeks to replace the "Unreasonable Justice of the World" that God constructed, and its goal in life is to banish God from the world with its "New Justice". {{SameProfile|DRB}} Although it was originally a high-ranking Angel Digimon that ruled over death, it despaired against the unreasonable justice of the world and rebelled against [[God]]. name: Baihumon
raw_text: One of the [[Four Holy Beasts]] who protect the Digital World, it guards the West and possesses the attribute of steel. Reigning since the age of myth, it is a legendary being like the other Four Holy Beast Digimon, and its strength is said to equal that of a god. Also, although it is the youngest of the Four Holy Beast Digimon, its power is the greatest among the four. Its immortality and tremendous power are brought forth through its twelve [[Digicore]]s. Baihumon is a neutral being just like [[Qinglongmon]], and it isn't someone who will generally become an ally. Its Special Move is a wave emitted from its mouth which converts the opponent completely into metal ({{AT|Kongou}}). The victim of this technique is unable to move while their body rusts, but they are unable to die until they have completely rusted away. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{MultiDesc Slashes the opponent with its claws.<ref name=DW2/>{{note|{{AT|Tekkousou}} and {{AT|Seidouhou}} are unused attacks in ''[[Digimon World 2]]''. Despite not being obtainable normally, they're fully programmed into the game and have unique animations.|n=DW2}} Shoots a sphere with the kanji 青銅砲 written on it.<ref name=DW2/>{{note|n=DW2}} {{--}}

name: Bakumon
raw_text:
A Digimon which has the appearance of the {{w|Baku (spirit)|Baku}}, said to be a dream-eating mythical beast. It is thought that it is a Digimon that was generated from a medical computer for detecting brain waves, and it seems that it uses the data from humans in {{w|REM sleep}} as nourishment. In recent studies, it has been proven that it has the power to purge particularly bad nightmares and malignant computer viruses. Also, since it has the ability to change the captured nightmares and viruses back to normal, it is considered a holy Digimon. There is surely some kind of connection between that sacred, unique ability, and the "{{EQ|Holy Ring}}" which it wears on its foreleg. Its Special Move is releasing its captured nightmares all at once, drowning the opponent in terror ({{AT|Nightmare Syndrome}}). This is the same technique as that of the Perfect Digimon, [[Digitamamon]], but its connection to Bakumon is a mystery. '''Bakumon'''
A Child Level Digimon in the form of a tapir, who eats dreams. After eating someone’s nightmares, he unleashes them on his opponents with his special attack, {{ATK|Nightmare Syndrome}}. The name may be the same as Digitamamon’s attack, but it’s a little different. '''Bakumon'''

name: Ballistamon
raw_text: A heavyweight Digimon that possesses bulky metallic armor and overwhelming power. It appears warlike at first glance, but because of its gentle personality, preferring harmony to conflict, it will never attack first. However, if it gets into a fight, it becomes a powerful and matchless fighter that swings its stout arms and wipes out the opponent.{{br}}With its heavy armor and great power, its potential for both offense and defense is great, and it specializes in one-hit knockout attacks that capitalize on its power, which is such that any of its strikes that manage to connect will leave a huge dent. However, its overly heavy body can be its ruin, not to mention its lack of nimbleness, so it has difficulty fighting fast-moving opponents.{{br}}Its "{{AT|Heavy Speaker}}", which emits a low tone from the speaker in its belly and shatters the opponent, conceals the power to smash rocks and shake mountains, and the level of that power rises when it gets hungry. Also, the horn on its head, which is indispensable in close-combat, is Ballistamon's pride, and it hates for it to be carelessly touched. Its "{{AT|Horn Breaker}}", in which it heroically uses this horn to fling the opponent, is Ballistamon's Signature Move.{{br}}Also, Ballistamon is able to lend its heavy armor and power to another Digimon by changing into its "{{FMO|Enhanced-armor Mode|Soukokyouka Keitai|l=Shoutmon X2}}". {{SameProfile|DRB|except with the removal of paragraphs}} ''{{fc|A heavyweight Digimon that possesses thick armor and overwhelming power!|#B3901A}}''{{br}}A heavyweight Digimon that possesses bulky metallic armor and overwhelming power. name: Baluchimon
raw_text: A Holy Beast Digimon confirmed to exist in herds in ruins unearthed from beneath [[Folder Continent]]. It turns outs that the ruins were once used as a fortress for Angel-species Digimon, and it is presumed that the Baluchimon were the ones that protected the fortress. Although it has a calm and quiet personality, it also has a ferocious side that mercilessly attacks the enemy.{{br}}It is highly intelligent, and once it immediately discerns the hostility of an intruder, it constricts their body with psychokinetic chains ({{AT|Psychic Chain}}), and drives them away. It is said that it displays illusions to those who get lost in the ruins unknowingly with the clouds that it spews out ({{AT|Cloud Vision}}), and leads them out of the ruins while they are in a dream-like state.   Constricts the enemy with psychokinetic chains, and drives them away.{{DD|ha}} Spews out clouds that cause hallucinations.{{DD|ha}}

name: Bancho Golemon
raw_text:
One of the [[BAN-TYO]], this Mineral Digimon differs from regular emotionless [[Golemon]] in that it acts out of its own will. Its figure stands tall and imposing, unconcerned with its surroundings; its harsh treatment extends to everyone, and it will not show even the slightest sign of leniency. It puts even itself under harsh training by stationing itself in the fiercely inhospitable depths of [[Infinity Mountain]].
It is a mysterious Digimon that, although will hardly ever lend a hand to strangers in need of help, will show up even out of nowhere in order to save a comrade with whom it has exchanged blows. With its overwhelming power, it can turn the tables on a disadvantageous situation in one sweep and claim victory.
Its Special Moves are gripping the enemy in its right hand and hammer-throwing them into the distance ({{AT|Tenbagaeshi|Sky-wave Reversal}}), reflecting the beam fired from the {{EQ|Kanshakudama|Manliness-Wrath Soul}} in its abdomen off of {{EQ|Falling Stones}}, resulting in an attack with a large area of effect ({{AT|Kanshaku Dust|Manliness-Wrath Dust}}), and impaling the enemy with the gigantic excavator on its left hand, which is capable of pulverizing even [[Chrome Digizoid]] ({{AT|Yobori Claw Drill|World-Excavating Claw Drill}}). name: Bancho Leomon
raw_text:
A Beast Man Digimon which lives faithful only to the "Justice" in which it trusts. It is said that only Digimon who continue to emerge victorious in battles with fierce champions, without their spirit being "broken", are able to acquire the title of "[[BAN-TYO|Bancho]]", and only five Digimon which possess this title have been confirmed in the recorded history of the [[Digital World]]. As it is a boss that only serves its own "Justice", if something becomes an obstacle to that "Justice", it will see them as "Evil" even if they are a being like the [[Royal Knights]] or the [[Three Archangels]], and they will become an enemy that it has to eliminate. The "{{EQ|w=School uniforms in Japan#Gakuran|GAKU-RAN}}" worn over its shoulders is endowed with a defensive function that negates 89.9% of the opponent's physical strikes. Its Special Moves are unleashing its "{{AT|Shishiraouzan|Lion King Slash}}" from its prided {{w|tantō}}, "{{EQ|Otokodama|Man's Soul}}", and releasing a fist packed with fighting spirit honed to its utmost limit ({{AT|Flash Bancho Punch}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB|except for the incorrect mention of "Four Archangels" (４大天使) rather than Three and the use of less commas}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} '''Bancho Leomon'''

Digivice Breakdown}} Releases a fist packed with fighting spirit honed to its utmost limit.{{DD|ha|bancholeomon}} {{MultiDesc Punches the ground, striking its opponent with the punch's shockwave.{{ref|''[[Digimon Savers: Another Mission]]''}} {{--}}

name: Bancho Lilimon
raw_text: A Fairy Digimon that wears a deep crimson {{w|Bōsōzoku|tokkō-fuku}}. The showy petals it had when it was a [[Lilimon]] have been dyed a dark color, and the pretty impression it used to make is long gone.{{br}}In the [[Digital World]] where the {{w|survival of the fittest|weak are food for the strong}}, it has the conviction to fight for the weak, and has saved many that have been assaulted by evil Digimon. Its tokkō-fuku, which it donned when it acquired the title of "[[BAN-TYO|Bancho]]", is said to be proof of it enforcing that conviction.{{br}}It has many Special Moves where it uses its yo-yos as weapons; there is "{{AT|w=Zettai ryōiki|Absolute Territory}}", which tears the enemy to pieces as well as the space around them, "{{AT|Nightmare Assemble}}", which pierces the enemy and absorbs them, and "{{AT|Twin Petal}}", where it unleashes a {{w|flashkick}} with its gorgeous legs. name: Bancho Mamemon
raw_text: One of the Digimon that have acquired the title of "[[BAN-TYO|Bancho]]", it fights strongly in spite of its small stature, and has a personality that sports a chivalrous spirit and deeply overflowing emotions. As it tries to rebel against the rules of the [[Digital World]], it lives an independent life. It similarly extends a hand to those Digimon who feel ill at ease with and isolated from the world, and from living together they have formed a group called the "{{NNO|Mame-mon Rengō|Mame Group Alliance/Mamemon Union}}". However, continuing to betray the rules of the world is not an easy task for them, and although Bancho Mamemon has had to fight those Digimon who aim to usurp it as leader under the pretense of a rebirth of the group several times over, the collective power of the {{NNO|Mame-mon Rengō|Mame Group Alliance/Mamemon Union}} have made those usurpers withdraw. It is thought that it acquired the title of Bancho from being able to avoid enemies without losing its own family as well in all kinds of predicaments. As with [[Bancho Leomon]], it wears a {{EQ|GAKU-RAN}} that negates the impact of physical attacks, and this defensive effect is often used to protect its companions. Its Special Moves are using its favourite clubs {{EQ|Ougon Batto|Golden Faith/Golden Bats}}, to beat enemies to a pulp ({{AT|Golden Rush}}), and hammering out its brotherly {{EQ|Black Hickeys}} from the {{EQ|Ougon Batto|Golden Faith/Golden Bats}} ({{AT|Senbon Dokkān|Thousand Blasting}}). Moreover, it has a Technique called "{{AT|Bukkomi Otokodama|Strike of the Man's Spirit}}", wherein it extends the prison chains sported on its entire body as it charges towards the enemy. name: Bancho Stingmon
raw_text: An Insect Digimon that is full of pride and lives by constantly overpowering those around it.{{br}}It prioritizes its own pride out of everything else, and its high-ranking pride is said to be first-rate among all of the Digimon. If someone says or does something that damages its pride even the slightest bit, it will never forgive them, regardless of who the opponent is. It is said that it acquired the title of "[[BAN-TYO|Bancho]]" through its uncompromising pride. Its symbolic {{EQ|Gakuran}} was minutely sewn with the shells of various insects, giving it a very firm structure.{{br}}Its Special Moves are skewering the enemy with the drills on both of its arms ({{AT|Bloody Finish}}), releasing {{EQ|Kiraichū|Mine Insects}} that self-destruct on enemies ({{AT|Bakuraiten|Explosive Thunderstorm}}), and shattering the enemy's face with a headbutt ({{AT|Redbutt}}). name: Barbamon
raw_text: As a Demon Lord Digimon which has the appearance of a long-bearded old man, it is one of the "[[Seven Great Demon Lords]]". It resides within the heart of the [[Dark Area]], the {{w|Pandæmonium (Paradise Lost)|den of demons}}, and manipulates Fallen Angel Digimon to run the whole gamut of evil. It is obsessed with all of the treasure which exists within the [[Network]], so out of avarice, and regardless of the means, it has a cruel personality with a greed that would kill Digimon just for a piece of treasure. It is the foremost and most cunning schemer of the Seven Great Demon Lords, and can easily manipulate the Ultimate [[Deathmon]] in addition to Fallen Angel Digimon. Its Special Moves are using its demonic staff "{{EQ|Death Lure}}" to tempt Digimon into an inescapable living hell, converting them to wickedness, and unleashing all of the Dark Area's evil energies at once as an ultra-high-temperature explosion that burns up everything without a trace ({{AT|Pandemonium Lost}}). raw_text: As a Demon Lord Digimon which has the appearance of a long-bearded old man, it is one of the "[[Seven Great Demon Lords]]". It resides within the heart of the [[Dark Area]], the {{w|Pandæmonium (Paradise Lost)|den of demons}}, and manipulates Fallen Angel Digimon to run the whole gamut of evil. It is obsessed with all of the treasure which exists within the [[Network]], so out of avarice, and regardless of the means, it has a cruel personality with a greed that would kill Digimon just for a piece of treasure. It is the foremost and most cunning schemer of the Seven Great Demon Lords, and can easily manipulate the Ultimate [[Deathmon]] in addition to Fallen Angel Digimon. Its Special Moves are using its demonic staff "{{EQ|Death Lure}}" to tempt Digimon into an inescapable living hell, converting them to wickedness, and unleashing all of the Dark Area's evil energies at once as an ultra-high-temperature explosion that burns up everything without a trace ({{AT|Pandemonium Lost}}). In addition, even [[Belial Vamdemon]]'s Special Move "{{ATO|Pandemonium Flame}}" only releases a small fraction of these energies. {{xab|Barbamon}}It has fused its demonic staff {{EQ|Death Lure}} with its right arm to link directly to its demonic power, and can now control more cunning techniques. Its Special Move is transforming the enemy's Digicore that it scoops out with its right hand into a jewel using the [[Seven Great Demon Lords#Crowns|Crown of Greed]] ({{AT|Seventh Jewelrize}}). The jewels shine more the stronger a Digimon is, so it assesses whether they are worth fighting. The radiance of the Crown of Greed manifesting from its right hand is proof of its strength, and is its cherished collection. It powered up by fusing its demonic staff {{EQ|Death Lure}} with its right arm. It transforms the [[Digicore]]s it captures into treasure with the [[Seven Great Demon Lords#Crowns|Crown of Greed]]. It has fused its demonic staff {{EQ|Death Lure}} with its right arm to link directly to its demonic power, and transforms the enemy's [[Digicore]] that it scoops out using its right arm into a jewel with the [[Seven Great Demon Lords#Crowns|Crown of Greed]]. The stronger the Digimon, the more the jewel will shine. Releases the energy of wickedness of the [[Dark Area]], burning everything with a super high temperature blast. Uses its demonic staff to tempt Digimon into an inescapable living hell, converting them to wickedness. Transforms the enemy's Digicore that it scoops out with its right hand into a jewel using the [[Seven Great Demon Lords#Crowns|Crown of Greed]].

name: Baromon
raw_text: An Armor-level Demon Man Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Courage]]". It is also a guardian deity that protects the ruins (database) of a temple in a forgotten jungle. It is said that Baromon is a survivor of the old generation of Digimon, and has several abilities of a lost technology not found in current Digimon. The {{w|third eye}} on its brow is one of them, and it is said that this eye allows it to see into the future, and it is told that it was able to survive even during the collapse of the ancient [[Digital World]]. Its Special Move is manipulating the spirits of the cosmos, causing a group of meteorites to rain down on the enemy ({{AT|Meteor Dance}}). The downside is that it takes time to synchronize with the spirits of the cosmos, but once invoked, it is said that 10 terabytes of data surrounding the target is annihilated. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Demon Man Digimon that evolved due to the [[Digimental of Courage]]. name: Bastemon
raw_text: A Beast Man Digimon also referred to as the "{{NN|Goddess of Cats}}". It loves to be showy and has a sly personality, and its specialty is using its charmingly sparkling eyes and the jewels worn all over its body to bewitch the opponent, allowing it to manipulate them as it desires. Most fall victim to Bastemon's {{w|glamour (presentation)|glamour}}, causing them to be completely eviscerated. Although it excels in nimbleness with its flexible movements, it is also powerful despite its appearance, and the claws on its hands are sharp enough to cut even rocks to pieces. It is said to be at loggerheads with [[Nefertimon]], who is an avatar of light. Its Special Moves are beguiling the opponent with the bewitching charms of its belly dance ({{w|Helter Skelter (song)|{{AT|Helter Skelter}}}}), and getting close to the opponent while dancing, then sucking out all the blood in their body, down to the last drop ({{AT|Vampire Dance}}). name: Bearcatmon
raw_text: A Beast Man Digimon characterized by its large fists and roller skate shoes. Although it has a relatively short build, its physical abilities are extremely high, and it possesses top-level muscle strength and speed among Perfects. There are many individuals of a belligerent nature, and it has a habit of wandering across the [[Digital World]] in search of opponents to fight. If the Digimon it encounters are of the same rank or higher, it will forcibly attack them, but if it considers a Digimon to be of a lower rank, it will leave without doing anything. For Digimon who get abruptly assaulted, these are very troublesome encounters, but those who are ignored rather than attacked feel humiliated for being "weak Digimon", so few Digimon welcome an encounter with Bearcatmon.{{br}}"{{AT|Penetrate Blow}}" is Bearcatmon's most powerful Special Move; a knife-hand strike with all its might that utilizes the physical strength of its whole body to the utmost limit as well as the jet propulsion of its roller skate shoes. It has the power to literally pierce through the opponent's body thanks to its sharp bear claws. Its "{{AT|Murderize Rush}}", in which it rains blows with the brass knuckles on its hands, clenched into fists, is unleashed at a tremendous speed, so it is difficult to evade by sight alone. Despite being less powerful than {{AT|Penetrate Blow}}, its "{{AT|Beardown Spinning Kick}}", a dropkick whose power is enhanced by performing a huge jump after using its jet propulsion to accelerate, and then spinning in midair, is a "showy technique" that it likes to perform due to its flashy appearance. name: Bearmon
raw_text: A Beast Digimon with the appearance of a bear-cub, whose trademark is its baseball cap which is worn backwards. Although it is a little timid at first, it immediately becomes bosom buddies with other Digimon. However, once it begins to battle, with the uncommon physical strength and will-power it possesses—to continue battling no matter what kind of attack it suffers—it becomes a very reliable being. The ability for close combat hidden within its body is very strong, to the point that it bound its fists in leather belts so that its special punches wouldn't hurt itself. Its Special Move is driving a {{w|Tsuki|punch}} into the opponent's chest with all its strength ({{w|Tsuki|{{AT|Koguma Seikendzuki|Bear-cub Punch}}}}). Belongs to the Beast Digimon. [[Gryzmon]]'s younger brother. Best friends with the Human [[Kotemon]]. It is kind but timid, and wishes for the conflict to end. Together with Kotemon, it tried its best to resurrect [[Ornismon]]. Punches at the foe with all its might.{{DD|ha}} Curls up and rolls into the enemy at high speed.{{ref|''[[Digimon Masters]]''}} Attacks the opponent with a swift blow of a powerful beast.<ref name=DSSM />

name: Beel Starmon
raw_text: A Digimon that splendidly manipulates twin pistols, and is also called the "{{NN|Beelzebumon Lady}}" due to its appearance. Its cherished twin pistols, the "{{EQ|Rizoma de Loto|Esp: ''Lotus Root''}}", are like little sisters to the "{{EQ|Berenjena|Esp: ''Eggplant''}}" possessed by [[Beelzebumon]]. It opens up to everybody without hesitation, and in particular, it is close friends with many gun-wielding Digimon, and has been given the nickname "{{NN|Beelko}}" by [[Magna Kidmon]] [[Three Musketeers|and the like]]. However, it is at loggerheads with the solitary Beelzebumon, so although it recognizes its competence, it keeps a slight distance. It is dressed in a jet-black leather suit, and it wears a muffler that is able to transform according to use such as for offense and defense or wings. Its Special Move is homing in on the enemy's vitals with the "{{w|Beelzebub|{{AT|Fly}}}} {{AT|Bullet}}" fired from the {{EQ|Rizoma de Loto|Esp: ''Lotus Root''}}. Furthermore, it can also stab and tear through enemies with the knives stocked on the {{EQ|Rizoma de Loto|Esp: ''Lotus Root''}} ({{AT|Double Claw}}), and wildly fire the guns hidden in the heels of its boots with a keen {{wikia|streetfighter|Senpukyaku}} ({{AT|Hurricane Screw Shot}}). name: Beelzebumon: Blast Mode
raw_text: An ultimate Demon Lord that raised its power and spirit to their utmost limits. Instead of evolving in a wicked manner, it maintained a calmer mental state, and its three sinister red eyes have become green. It demonstrates power and speed at a level incomparable to its usual state, and four jet-black wings grow from its back. One could almost say that the opponent no longer exists the moment they stand before [[Beelzebumon]] when it took on this form. Its right arm is integrated with its {{EQ|Blaster}}, which fires powerful energy waves to disintegrate everything into atoms. Its Signature Move is firing a destructive wave from the {{EQ|Blaster}} on its right arm ({{AT|Death Slinger}}), and its Special Move is drawing a {{w|magic circle}} in front of itself, then firing destructive waves through the circle's center ({{AT|Chaos Flare}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A further evolved form of [[Beelzebumon]]. It has a giant gun on its right arm. Fires a destructive wave from the {{EQ|Blaster}} on its right arm.{{DD|ha|beelzebumonblastmode}} Draws a magic circle before itself, then fires destructive waves through the circle's center.{{DD|ha|beelzebumonblastmode}} Rapid-fires its {{EQ|Blaster}} and {{EQ|Berenjena}}.<ref name=DW3/> Fires spiritual energy from its fist in the form of a lion's head.{{rfe|DT|48|The Power to Protect Juri - Beelzebumon's Fist!}} Raises its sharp claws overhead and then cuts the opponent to pieces.<ref name=BattleEvolution/> A powerful middle kick.<ref name=DTBS1.5/> Attacks with {{EQ|Berenjena}} from the air, or calls down lightning on the enemy. Pierces the enemy with beams of dark matter from its {{EQ|Berenjena}}.{{ref|''[[Digimon World 3]]''}} Rapid-fires its {{EQ|Blaster}} while riding {{EQ|Behemoth}}, before shooting a beam from it.<ref>https://twitter.com/digimon_rearise/status/1233592728824565761</ref>

name: Beelzebumon (2010 Anime Version)
raw_text: An aloof demon warrior possessing terrifying destructive power. Although its taciturnity and indifference towards others give the impression that it has a calm personality, in actuality, it loves battle more than anyone else. It is considered one of the strongest Digimon, and anyone who sees Beelzebumon and still challenges it to a fight is nothing but a fool. Also, Beelzebumon will never run away from a battle it was challenged to. Its "{{AT|Death the Cannon}}", fired from the gigantic "{{EQ|Berenjena SDX|Esp: "Eggplant SDX"}}" gun on its right arm, is a technique which has tremendous power, but what poses the most danger is the fact that it is a {{w|fast draw}} technique. No small number of enemies have been defeated by that fast draw, which is said to have almost godlike speed. Also, its "{{AT|Darkness Claw}}", where it paralyses the opponent in exchange for granting their desires, is rumoured to be the final reward a fool will ever see. That fool, who isn't able to move, will be the target of Beelzebumon's fast draw until it lays down life's burden. {{SameProfile|DRB}} ''The site mistakenly uses the profile of the original [[Beelzebumon]].'' {{SameProfile|DRB}} ''{{fc|Reincarnated from Baalmon, who was saved by [[Kudou Taiki|{{fc|Taiki|#B3901A}}]]'s tears|#B3901A}}{{br}}Reincarnated from Baalmon, it is an aloof warrior possessing terrifying destructive power. Although it is seen as having a calm personality due to its taciturnity, it loves conflict more than anyone else and is one of the strongest Digimon. Its "{{AT|Death the Cannon}}", fired from the gigantic "{{EQ|Berenjena SDX|Esp: Eggplant SDX}}" gun on its right arm, is a tremendously powerful {{w|fast draw}} technique. Its Special Move is rapid-firing its twin shotguns ({{AT|Double Impact SDX}}). name: Blitzmon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Thunder which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]]. Its keen movements, unbecoming of its large build, are a technique to form a high voltage current running throughout its body. It generates a special magnetic field that produces an {{w|anti-gravity}} state in its vicinity, and is capable of high-speed movement. Its overflowing thunder power comes out as sparks from various parts of its body, and although Blitzmon looks mechanical, its personality is, in contrast, expressive and human. Its language is {{w|Troll (Internet)|troll}}ish, but it additionally conveys excess warmth. In battle, its underwater mobility is weak due to the nature of its wrestler-like style. Its Special Moves are clasping its hands together, then dynamically swinging them down ({{AT|Thor Hammer}}), and making lightning fall from the sky like rain ({{w|Mjölnir|{{AT|Mjölnir Thunder}}}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Gathers lightning by clasping its hands together, then dynamically swings them down. Blitzmon grabs Blizzarmon's tomahawks {{EQ|Eji}} and {{EQ|Oji}} and wraps them in electricity, attacking by riding a blizzard created by Blizzarmon.

name: Blizzarmon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Ice, and bears the might of one of the legendary [[Warrior Ten]]. Although its behaviour is better described as recklessness rather than dauntless courage, it is in any case a ruffian overflowing with enthusiasm and ambition. It is extremely curious, loves being in the limelight, and tends to get carried away. Even during battle, it gets up to humorous antics such as striking a pose while offering a prayer unto the god of ice and snow it follows, or calling out the names of its Special Moves. In actuality, however, it is also closely observing the opponent and terrain, with its astuteness letting it gain the upper hand in battle. Its Special Moves are wielding its two tomahawks, "{{EQ|Éji|Black}}" and "{{EQ|Ōji|Black}}", to chop up the opponent with dance-like motions ({{AT|Avalanche Step}}), and restricting the opponent's movement with the extensible hair on its head, then finishing them off with the blades on the hair tips ({{AT|Gletscher Torpedo|Glacier Torpedo}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}}  Wields its two tomahawks, "{{EQ|Éji|Black}}" and "{{EQ|Ōji|Black}}", to chop up the opponent like it was dancing. It has mastered swordsmanship, and become an invincible samurai that could take on a thousand warriors. However, it is beginning to think that there are limits to saving the [[Digital World]] with swordsmanship... A Digimon with the appearance of a general that evolved from [[Buraimon]] to Perfect. It wields an enormous greatsword and cuts down enemies with it. It is said that it can shatter a large mountain in a single blow. Although it is mastering its strength, it is beginning to feel emptiness in battles where it destroys everything. A God Man Digimon clad in crimson armor, wielding a greatsword, it evolves from Digimon who have honed their sword abilities through repeated battles.
Despite being a Perfect, it is an expert who has already mastered swordsmanship.

name: Butterflamon
raw_text: An Armor-level Insect Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Knowledge]]". Like [[Flybeemon]] and [[Honeybeemon]], it is a mythical Digimon that was born due to the power of the Digimental during a large [[Kunemon]] outbreak. It prefers living in areas with flower beds and a warm climate. It hates conflict and has a friendly personality. Its Special Move "{{AT|Sweet Pheromone}}" is a technique for protecting itself when it has no other options, causing phosphorus powder containing a hallucinogenic program stored in its wings to rain down on the opponent and confuse them. This hallucinogenic program also has the effect of alleviating the opposing Digimon's hostility, allowing it to end the battle without injuring them.  {{SameProfile|DRB}} Causes phosphorus powder containing a hallucinogenic program stored in its wings to rain down on the opponent and confuse them.{{DD|ha}} Emits a mysterious sound wave from its wings.<ref name=DSAM/> Attacks with a powerful flying kick.<ref name=DSAM/> Sends balls of light to absorb the target's health.<ref name=DSAM/>

name: Calamaramon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Water which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Warrior Ten]]. It has a half-human, half-beast appearance, and its tentacles are used offensively and defensively to either attack the enemy by rapidly spinning them, or guard its body by gathering them together to form a wall. If it is unable to win while attacking and defending with its tentacles, it will retract its body into its {{w|Mantle (mollusc)|mantle}} and perform a powered-up attack in the form of a giant squid. The flexibility of its mantle is superior to that of its tentacles, so external physical attacks are ineffective. Although it is better at operating underwater or in the air, on land, it skillfully manipulates its ten tentacles to move around like a huge hermit crab. Its personality is sly and short-tempered like a witch. Its Special Moves are spewing corrosive ink from its mouth ({{AT|Nero Corso|Ita: ''Black Course''}}), and hardening its mantle, spinning like a drill, and then smashing into the enemy ({{AT|Titanic Charge}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Digimon that possesses power over Water. Spews out corrosive ink from its mouth. {{DD|ka}} Hardens its mantle, spins like a drill, and then smashes into the enemy.{{DD|ka}} {{--}}

name: Callismon
raw_text: A Demon Beast Digimon with an appearance resembling a bear. Although it is considered to be a Digimon that evolved from the [[Gryzmon]] line, all Callismon are mutants that evolved from individuals that underwent data abnormalities. It is unknown whether the data abnormalities responsible for this occurred suddenly or were caused intentionally, and because its population is small, there are many mysteries surrounding it such as its ecology and evolution requirements.{{br}}It has extremely high combat ability, owing to its hugely developed arms and armaments, and exhibits a ferocious nature that will not stop attacking the opponent until they are defeated.{{br}}Its Special Moves are tearing the enemy apart with its sharp claws, causing their data to disintegrate ({{AT|Deep Forest}}), and firing homing shots from the three gun barrels equipped to its right arm ({{AT|Rodeo Bullet}}). A Synthetic Beast Digimon born when [[Gryzmon]] was remodeled by [[Saiba Neo|Neo]]. Some of [[Arkadimon]]'s Power Data has been built in. It corners the enemy with the homing shots of its Special Move "{{AT|Rodeo Bullet}}", then it tears through the enemy with the claws of its "{{AT|Deep Forest}}"! Tears the enemy apart with its sharp claws, causing their data to disintegrate.{{DD|ka}} Fires homing shots from the three gun barrels equipped to its right arm.{{DD|ka}}

name: Candmon
raw_text:
A Flame Digimon whose [[Digicore]], which can also be said to be a Digimon's heart, burns intensely while mounted atop its head. When the Digicore on its head ceases to burn, Candmon becomes unable to maintain its life processes. One theory suggests that the flame on its head is its true form, and that the rest of its body is naught but a dummy. Despite being a Flame Digimon, it has a docile personality and will not cause harm to its surroundings out of its own volition. Its Special Move is spitting out small fireballs ({{AT|Bonfire}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Flame Digimon whose [[Digicore]], which can also be said to be a Digimon's heart, burns intensely while mounted atop its head.

It has an extremely gentle and docile personality, which is rare for Flame Digimon. As such, it will never cause harm to its surroundings out of its own volition.
It will counterattack with its Special Move by spitting out small fireballs ({{AT|Bonfire}}) only when absolutely necessary, such as when it is ambushed by an enemy. A Flame Digimon. name: Cannonbeemon
raw_text: A massive Digimon that defends the mysterious "aerial, covert honey base, [[Royal Base]]". Although the aerial base is exposed to danger from all angles, Cannonbeemon is able to cover a vast range with a bombarding barrage fired simultaneously from the gigantic arms containers on its upper body. Also, even if the opponent is heavily armored, it can use its Special Move "{{AT|Nitro Stinger}}" to shoot clean through them with its high-caliber laser cannon. Its "{{AT|Sky Rocket ∞}}" fires shots from its containers, which boast an innumerable number of loaded ordnance, and will continue furiously until the coast is completely clear. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A massive Digimon that defends the mysterious "aerial, covert honey base, [[Royal Base]]". The aerial base is exposed to danger from a full 360°, but with a bombarding barrage fired simultaneously from the gigantic arms container on top of it, it can completely cover a vast range. Fires from its super-large caliber laser cannon which can shoot through even heavy armor. Shoots missiles from its honeycomb-shaped missile container.

name: Cannondramon
raw_text: A Cyborg type Digimon equipped with long-distance cannons. Covered in tough armor, it greets approaching enemies with a swing of its tail. Its Signature Move is random-firing grenades from the gun on its front ({{AT|Grenade Storm}}). Its Special Move is firing its cannons while stationed at an area where enemy attacks cannot reach ({{AT|Dyna Cannon}}). Fires beams from the three cannons on its back. Fires grenades from the gun on its front.

raw_text: A Sky Dragon Digimon with large wings, its body surface has turned a high-purity white as a result of the flames of its blazing heart further intensifying. It prefers fair matches in terms of power and speed, and shows a joyful expression as the battle heats up. However, it will not permit injustice or unjust actions, and takes them on in a righteous manner to overcome them. It is said that when it draws out power that transcends its limits during battle, its whole body will glitter with white light, and become so bright that it can even be detected from the [[Digital World (concept)|Digital World]]s of other dimensions.{{br}}It has a variety of combat techniques, and its "{{AT|w=148 Gallia|Gallia}} {{AT|Fissure}}", in which it tears the enemy to pieces with its tough claws, boasts the power to easily cut through [[Chrome Digizoid]], if it has a low purity. In addition, they can also be used at long range, such as its "{{AT|w=620 Drakonia|Dragonia}}", in which it closes its wings and charges like a bullet of light, and "{{j|{{AT|Meteor }}{{AT|w=Lux}}|Lat: "Meteor Light"}}", in which the light from its spread wings rains down as a meteor shower. For its greatest Special Move "{{AT|Gran}} {{AT|w=Nova}}", it gathers all the energy in its body and fires the brightest fireball from its mouth, enveloping the enemy in a scorching-hot star, even if they are an Ultimate. name: Caprimon
raw_text:
A tiny Baby Digimon wearing a metallic helmet. Within the two horns attached to its helmet, it has antennae that are able to receive any radio wave or sound. Caprimon has bat-like traits such as having weak eyesight, instead producing ultrasonic waves from its mouth to detect objects ahead of it based on the rebounding sound waves. For that reason, Caprimon is able to remain active regardless of whether it is day or night. Its technique is generating a resonance between its two horns ({{AT|Howling Hertz}}); even a large Digimon will have their sense of hearing paralyzed if they suffer this technique. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A special Digimon wearing a metal helmet.
The horns on the helmet are said to contain antennae that receive radio waves and sounds.
Caprimon has poor eyesight, so it checks the area ahead with ultrasonic waves before proceeding.
Thanks to this, it can act even in the darkness!! Generates a resonance between its two horns to paralyze the opponent. Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

name: Cargodramon
raw_text: Attacks with the Gatling gun on the front of its fuselage.{{DD|ka}} Hacks the opponent to pieces with the propellers on both of its wings.{{DD|ka}}

name: Catch Mamemon
raw_text: A Mutation Digimon that evolved from a [[Mamemon]] that fused with {{w|file manager|file management}} software data. It has a serious personality and an uncompromising side, and seems to think that managing [[Digitama]] is its duty. It is also capable of walking instead of floating, by using its arm parts as legs. Its Special Move is catching any Digimon that try to lay their hands on the Digitama, and in order to ensure that they do not retaliate, it uses a mysterious power to turn them into a plush toy and carries them away ({{AT|Magic Arm}}). Not only that, its slots start spinning the moment it makes a catch; if they land on triple sevens, its "{{AT|Miracle Bomb}}" activates, turning the captured Digimon into a bomb and using it to attack. It is said that the power of the bomb corresponds to the power of the captured Digimon. name: Cendrillmon
raw_text: Skewers the opponent with its glass slippers. Places its familiars on pumpkin carriage-shaped bombs and has them perform a self-sacrificing attack. Fires an extremely powerful laser beam from the large clock it holds.

name: Centalmon
raw_text: A half-man, half-beast Digimon with a humanoid upper body and a bestial lower body. Its body is protected by a hard substance secreted onto the surface from its insides, and its right arm has fused to become one with its weapon. The ducts extending from its back spout high-pressure vapor, allowing it to move at near-sonic speed, though only for an instant. It has outstanding defense, attack, and speed. It is extremely prideful, and absolutely despises being ordered around or restrained. Its Special Move is using the {{AT|Hunting Cannon}} which has become one with its right arm. It is near impossible to evade this attack. However, because this attack expends a large amount of energy, Centalmon avoids battle whenever possible. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{S2Ep|DA|10|e=Centalmon the Guardian!}} {{S2Ep|DF|40|e=The Chosen Ones!? name: Ceresmon
raw_text: One of the [[Olympos XII]], Ceresmon is a monstrous, gigantic bird Digimon that carries on its back the "{{EQ|Karpos Hulē|Fruit Forest}}", a forest bearing the [[Digital World]]'s greatest sweets and famous fruits. With a body composed of rocks and rich, fertile soil, Ceresmon's soaring form is definitely the epitome of an island floating in the sky.{{br}}Sitting on the head of Ceresmon is "[[Ceresmon Medium]]", which serves as its true form. "Ceresmon Medium" has practically nil fighting strength and so rarely, if ever, comes out in public on its own, but it is said that it will occasionally show itself unattended by the monstrous bird to those who earn its trust. Its personality is filled with gentleness and a kind heart, and it is said that it offers fruit from the "{{EQ|Karpos Hulē|Fruit Forest}}" to hungry Digimon, and shelters injured Digimon in its woods until they recuperate. However, it will reverse its attitude and bring terror as if a demonic forest to those who forget the blessings granted by the forests and land, and unnecessarily injure the trees or pollute the soil.{{br}}Its Special Move "{{AT|Island Freefall}}", in which it slams its huge body against the opponent, inflicts damage from the intense shock wave and vibrations around the area where it falls. For its "{{AT|Burning Blood Shell}}", it fires a magma bodily fluid from its mouth as an enormous flame shot. The unripe fruit from the "{{EQ|Karpos Hulē|Fruit Forest}}" has high concentrations of poison, and its "{{AT|Fruits Flechette}}", in which it scatters them over a wide range, transforms its surroundings into a land of death with that poison upon impact. However, the poison changes into high-quality fertilizer after several days, and then it is reborn as a fertile land. It brings terror as if a demonic forest to those who forget the blessings granted by the forests and land, and unnecessarily injure the trees or pollute the soil. An avatar used by the gigantic [[Ceresmon]] to convey its will. Sitting on the head of [[Ceresmon]], one of the [[Olympos XII]], is "Ceresmon Medium", which serves as its true form. It rarely, if ever, comes out in public, but it is said that it will occasionally show itself to those who earn its trust.  Scatters poisonous, unripe fruit from the "{{EQ|Karpos Hulē|Fruit Forest}}" over a wide range.{{DD|ka|ceresmon|Digimon Reference Book: Ceresmon}} Attacks the enemy with vines, poisoning them and draining their health.<ref name=Survive/>

name: Cernumon

name: Chackmon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Ice which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Warrior Ten]]. It styles itself as holding rank as a member of a polar army's polar region defense force. Since it replies that the matter's top secret if you ask anything about it, the truth is unknown. It's thought to be largely something it dreamed up. However, its operation of the {{EQ|Launcher}} it carries (nicknamed {{w|NATO phonetic alphabet|{{EQ|Romeo}}}}) and its precision conduct in battle are genuine, and its survivalist knowledge also has a strong, truly reliable existence. Since it rarely acts of its own volition, it primarily operates in response to someone's requests or orders. It will have nothing to do if nobody is relying on it, and is likely to worry about its purpose in life and get completely depressed. The shots fired from its {{EQ|Launcher}} are special snowballs, so there are several varieties according to purpose. Its Special Moves are taking the shape of an icicle and pouncing at the opponent ({{AT|Tsurararara~|Icicicicle~}}), and blindly firing {{w|Supercooling|supercooled}} snowballs from the {{EQ|Launcher}} ({{AT|Snow Bomber}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{MultiDesc Blindly fires supercooled snowballs out of {{EQ|Romeo}}.{{DD|ta}} Attacks with its hard, ice-covered fist.{{ref|''[[Battle Spirit: Digimon Frontier]]''}} Its body transforms into an icicle shape and falls down from the sky.{{ref|''[[Battle Spirit: Digimon Frontier]]''}} Wearing its skis, it does a V-shaped jump and assaults the opponent.{{ref|''[[Battle Spirit: Digimon Frontier]]''}} Freezes the opponent's feet with its breath, then hits them with an icy uppercut.{{ref|''[[Battle Spirit: Digimon Frontier]]''}} Breathes out a blizzard.{{rfe|DF|03|''Bullying is Unforgivable! Evolve, Chackmon of Ice''|b}}

name: Chamblemon
raw_text:
A Plant Digimon in the shape of an extremely poisonous mushroom. It is a mystery whether it evolved from [[Mushmon]], or if it is another variant. Although it is often seen as being weak, it is quite the ruffian. If anyone approaches it carelessly, its floating "{{AT|Sweepore}}" spores will attach to them, and sprout into mushrooms containing their drained vitality. If one picks and eats them, they will be brimming with energy, and it seems that among them, the Data-type mushrooms are especially delicious.{{br}}Its Special Move is releasing mushroom bombs of various sizes all at once ({{AT|Champignon Bomb|Fra: "Mushroom Bomb"}}). name: Chamelemon
raw_text:
An Armor-level Reptile Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Kindness]]". Chamelemon's skin has a unique structure, and it has the ability to blend in by scanning the surrounding environment and re-covering the texture of its skin. As a Digimon suited for espionage, it is able to slip through impregnable security and enter databases. For that reason, there are occasions when it is used by various companies in order to enter the databases of rival companies and steal information. Also, it is able to skillfully move both of its eyes, which are equipped with scanning devices, and take in a 360° view. name: Chaosmon
raw_text: Normally, when a [[Jogress]] occurs, the [[Digicore]]s of the two Digimon are completely fused and reborn as a new Digimon; however, Chaosmon retains each of the Digicores of the Digimon before the Jogress, and maintains its form in a very incomplete state. Chaosmon is the codename for Digimon who "should not exist", and according to the "{{w|Central Dogma}}" of the [[Digital World]], are absolute impossible singularities ({{w|software bug|bugs}}). Due to its extremely unstable existence, its lifespan is very short, and it is conjectured that the program being run by the Digital World's [[Yggdrasill|managing system]] which eliminates bugs is causing its lifespan to shorten. This Chaosmon is believed to be born from the Jogress of [[Bancho Leomon]] and [[Darkdramon]], and the faces of each Digimon are visible on its arms. Its Special Moves are an unstoppable bisecting slash unleashed from the "{{EQ|BAN-TYO Blade}}" equipped to its "{{EQ|Bancho Arm}}" ({{AT|Haou Ryoudanken|Tyrant Bisection Sword}}), and firing off its own digital cells from the "{{EQ|Gigastick Cannon}}" equipped to its "{{EQ|Darkdra Arm}}" ({{AT|Dark Prominence}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} Uses its {{EQ|BAN-TYO Blade}} to slice the enemy in half with a single decisive stroke.{{DD|ka}} Uses the {{EQ|Gigastick Cannon}} to fire off its own digital cells.{{DD|ka}} Puts the {{EQ|BAN-TYO BLADE}} between the jaws of its {{EQ|Darkdra Arm}} and fires a beam from the two arms.<ref name=DSAM>''[[Digimon Savers: Another Mission]]''</ref> Slashes the foe using the {{EQ|BAN-TYO Blade}}.<ref name=DSAM/>

name: Chapmon
raw_text: A Lesser Digimon that only lives in clear, beautiful waters. For this reason, it is only seen in a limited number of areas within the [[Digital World]]. It spends most of the day on the water's surface, and when it sleeps, it sleeps with only its face poking out of the water. It has the sensitivity to detect the approach of opponents just from tiny movements of the water's surface, and will escape to a safe spot before it is found. Even when it is found, it spits its "{{AT|Foam Shower}}" from its mouth to confuse the opponent with the bubbles, then flees. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} Spits bubbles from its mouth to confuse an attacker.

raw_text: An Angel Digimon which has the appearance of a beast. It is one of the [[Three Archangel]] Digimon assigned the highest rank, just like the Seraph Digimon [[Seraphimon]]. Its primary duty is to defend the Digital World's "[[Kernel]]". Angel Digimon, which are positioned at the ultimate "Virtue", have the aspect of their being easily stained by its antithesis of "Vice" as a consequence of their extremity. It uses mighty lightning techniques, and their strike is thought to be divine punishment. Its Special Moves are firing a spear of lightning ({{AT|Lightning Spear}}), and summoning a gigantic thundercloud, then loosing innumerable thunderbolts on the opponent ({{AT|Heaven's Judgment}}). A Cherub Digimon that was one of the [[Three Great Angel]] Digimon, who are the highest rank of Angel-types, but became the ultimate evil for some reason or other. It is said that when this Cherubimon, who has turned into a black figure, appears, the balance of the [[Digital World]] collapses. Its Special Move is summoning a thundercloud, then loosing innumerable thunderbolts ({{AT|Heaven's Judgment}}). Throws a spear of lightning. name: Chicchimon
raw_text: A Chick Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft, yellow {{w|Down feather|down}}. Since it cannot fly yet, it moves around by jumping while desperately flapping its tiny wings. It is frequently seen diligently using its tiny beak to groom the long feathers growing from its head, which seems to be an important aspect of it that can be considered its trademark.{{br}}Its "{{AT|Piyopiyo|Chirping}}", which it emits when it senses that it is in danger, is an ultrasonic cry that could knock out even Childs if heard at close range. It quickly flees to protect itself while those who have heard its cry are incapacitated. A small Digimon which looks like a chick. It’s still physically weak and isn’t suitable for an actual fight, but even though it’s a Baby II Digimon, we can see how it’ll turn out to be after evolving. Emits an ultrasonic cry. Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.<ref name=DSSM/> Gathers light energy which explodes.<ref name=DSSM/>

name: Chikurimon
raw_text: A Digimon that lurks underwater or under the shade of rocks, it doesn't move around very much while it waits quietly in one place. Although it has a habit of attacking those that come near, it is never belligerent and won't attack those that stay away from it. Because it proliferates abnormally when the temperature exceeds 30°C, Chikurimon can often be seen thickly crowded into lakes or around rocks with the coming of summer, and Digimon that come to drink water are often attacked. Its "{{AT|Final Chikurimon}}", which sacrifices itself just as the name suggests, is the final Special Move of a Chikurimon that explodes itself together with its opponent.  {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Digimon that lurks underwater or under the shade of rocks, it doesn't move around very much while it waits quietly in one place. name: Chimairamon
raw_text: A Composite Digimon for which each part that composes its whole, such as its arms, legs, body, and tail, was put together by synthesizing various Digimon. How this kind of synthesis was performed is shrouded in mystery. In contrast to [[Mugendramon]], who was synthesized from the metal parts of several varieties of Digimon, it was combined from organic parts, and whether it is Mugendramon's [[Prototype Digimon|prototype]], or it was built to use against Mugendramon, is still uncertain. However, the one thing that is known is that, because of Chimairamon's terrifying combat instinct, it is nothing but a powerful force for destruction. The deadly heat ray it emanates from its four arms is "{{AT|Heat Viper}}". Getting hit by this heat ray is like Chimairamon's curse, a terrifying technique which is cruelly dispersed in every direction. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{S2Ep|ZT|19|e=Chimairamon, the Combined Beast}} {{MultiDesc Attacks with its four arms.<ref name=RPG>''[[Digimon RPG]]''</ref>

name: Chiropmon
raw_text: A Mammal Digimon whose appearance resembles a hood-wearing bat. Possessing remarkable information gathering and analytical capabilities, it is rumored to be a Digimon that was originally born from software used for intelligence gathering, analysis, and parsing by intelligence agencies. It is able to flap its wings almost soundlessly, allowing it to gather and analyze information without its target noticing. However, since Chiropmon bases its actions on things it has an interest in, the information it gathers is often no more valuable than a broad range of trivia. It has the ability to emit ultrasonic waves from its mouth, and uses both its "{{AT|Paralyze Echo}}", which is capable of paralyzing the target, and its "{{AT|Analyze Echo}}", in which it uses ultrasonic {{w|Animal echolocation#Bats|echolocation}} to grasp what is going on in its surroundings. Chiropmon's eyes have a feature known as "{{EQ|Curious Eyes}}", which enables it to "see" electromagnetic wavelengths up to ultraviolet and infrared, in addition to visible light, allowing it to obtain information that cannot be seen with the naked eye. Chiropmon has virtually no fighting spirit and is not a Digimon that would attack on its own, but when battle is unavoidable, it will use its attack technique "{{AT|Condensed Echo}}", in which it compresses ultrasonic waves to their utmost limit and then emits them from its mouth.  Paralyzes the target with ultrasonic waves. Uses echolocation to get a grasp of what is going on in its surroundings. name: Craniummon + Enbarrmon
raw_text: A select number of [[Royal Knights]] will sometimes recruit Digimon from where they are dispatched to as allies in order to execute their assigned missions. The way they obtain these allies varies depending on the nature of the mission, but [[Craniummon]] is said to acquire allies as its subordinates by challenging Digimon it recognizes as formidable to one-on-one combat and making them submit. This {{FM|Riding Mode}} is a form where Craniummon recruited [[Enbarrmon]] as its mount after defeating it during a certain mission. It seems that the perfectionist Craniummon had its eyes on Enbarrmon's mobility in order to carry out its missions more efficiently. Although they had a relationship where they waged fierce battles against one another, they acknowledged each other's strengths and built a strong, trusting relationship, which resulted in them gaining astounding mobility and offensive power. Its Special Move is a charging thrust from the {{EQ|w=Claíomh Solais}} with Enbarrmon running at full speed ({{AT|Ruthless Charge}}). raw_text: Cthyllamon inhabits the depths of the [[Net Ocean]], and is known by the alias "{{NN|w=Shiryō|Phantom}} {{NN|of the Ocean}}" due to the fact that only the skull pattern on its chest can be seen floating eerily in the dark sea. It has a crafty and cunning disposition; instead of actively fighting on its own, it employs aquatic Digimon of a lower Level than itself by brainwashing them. It shares many similarities with [[Marin Angemon]], such as its appearance and the fact that it is rarely ever seen, but the relationship between the two remains unknown.{{br}}Its Special Move "{{AT|Ocean Hell}}", in which it steals the opponent's fighting spirit with an aura of endless terror akin to the darkness of the ocean depths, sometimes reduces the Digimon that suffer this technique to being Cthyllamon's puppets. name: Cyclomon
raw_text: A one-eyed Dragon Man Digimon with an abnormally developed right arm. It was originally a stalwart dragon warrior, but its right eye was crushed by the warrior [[Leomon]], and it became an [[wikipedia:oni (folklore)|oni]] of revenge. In order to defeat Leomon, it has strengthened and enlarged its right arm, and it is on the lookout for a chance to take it down. For the sake of revenge, it has lost its pride as a warrior, leaving it as nothing more than a warrior obsessed with bloodshed. Its Special Move is its ultra-high-temperature "{{AT|Hyper Heat}}", which can melt anything. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Fires an ultra-high-temperature beam from its mouth that can melt anything.{{DD|sa}} {{--}}

It bundles up its innumerable, multiplying tentacles and takes on a humanoid appearance, but its true form is a strange evolution of a Mollusk Digimon. Its Special Move is throwing its trident with tremendous physical strength ({{AT|Forbidden Trident}}). name: Daipenmon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Ice that has transcended legend by inheriting all the might of one of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]] and acquiring unknown abilities. raw_text: Fires laser beams from the green jewels on its head and forelegs. Grabs Digimon with the capture device on its tail, and then eternally seals them within its body.  Amplifies its ultra-hot breath via its bone halo, incinerating everything except the enemy's [[Digicore]].

name: Damemon
raw_text: Damemon was born by coincidence when the waste data drifting through the Digital World randomly combined. Since {{j2|"No good, no good!"|Damedame!}} is its favorite phrase, it has a bad habit of criticizing anyone and everyone without reading the room, regardless of the situation. Although it is the most {{j2|"No good, no good!"|Damedame!}} itself, it somehow gets by with the help of its partner, [[Tyutyumon]]. It's only together with Tyutyumon that Damemon can finally be said to be a decent-performing Digimon. Tyutyumon stays in the "{{EQ|Tyutyu Tray}}" on the back of Damemon's head, and takes Damemon to various places to go play. When the two of them are together, every day is Priceless. Its Special Move, "{{AT|Bunbun Ken|Buzzing Fist}}", involves merely rotating its {{w|tonfa}} and rarely ever hits its target, making it more useful for intimidating enemies instead of dealing damage. Its "{{AT|Gun Vulcan}}", in which it fires small, black, mysterious objects that spread a foul smell from the hidden guns in its feet and tonfa, repulses enemies and causes them to lose their fighting spirit rather than actually inflicting damage. After firing them, however, it will have to clean up after itself or risk angering the Digimon residing in the area; hence, it is always careful with this move. With its "{{AT|Boo~st Attack}}"{{note|'Boost' is stylised as 'Boo~st' (ブー・スト ''bū-suto'') as a pun on 'boo' (ブー ''bū''), which is the onomatopoeia for farting.|n=N 1}}, it spreads a large amount of smelly gas as it charges forth, though not even Damemon knows where it will fly off to. The damage dealt to the opponent when it does hit, together with the smelly gas, is very large, emotionally. {{SameProfile|DRB|except for the inclusion of paragraphs}} ''{{fc|A no good, no good Digimon with {{fce|"No good, no good!"|Damedame!|#B3901A}} as its favorite phrase|#B3901A}}''{{br}}A Digimon that was accidentally born when the waste data drifting through the [[Digital World]] randomly combined. raw_text: Dark Knightmon is the fused figure of [[Skull Knightmon]] and [[Deadly Axemon]], who have exchanged cups of brotherhood. The skills of Dark Knightmon, who can use the "{{EQ|Twin Spear}}" it wields to thrust, slash, sweep, or throw as the situation calls for, are very advanced, and it is said there are few people powerful enough to fight Dark Knightmon fairly to its face and defeat it. raw_text:
A Cyborg Digimon which is believed to be the weapon of last resort for the mechanized "[[D-Brigade]]". Although this is information that stubbornly remains part of the rumor mill, it is said that a [[Tankdramon]], shot down during an operation to eliminate a "target" designated "Codename: [[BAN-TYO]]", was retrieved and evolved to Darkdramon at the [[D-Brigade]] research facility it was left at. It seems that on the verge of its evolution, a large quantity of "Dark Matter" was applied, and after its evolution it ran wild and broke out, so currently even the D-Brigade cannot secure Darkdramon's whereabouts. It is said that even now it is hunting "Codename: BAN-TYO"...

name: Darkness Bagramon
raw_text: The [[digixros]]ed form of [[Dark Knightmon]] and [[Bagramon]]. By uniting the dark knight and the fiendish demon lord it became the greatest emperor of evil. Its "{{EQ|Imperium Vicious}}", the evil power spilling out of its body, symbolizes that strength, and if a weak evil is bathed in it then it immediately becomes a grovelling subordinate. Even if you try to resist, it is considered difficult to maintain your sense of self if you are glared at by Dark Knightmon, who exists within its chest. According to one theory, it appears to be planning on destroying all good, in order to fill the world with evil and obtain a world that it can manipulate at will. Even though there are probably some Digimon whose strength is not outdone even by Darkness Bagramon itself, it is said that in order to designate its plan as something guaranteed, it expands its power by bringing useful Digimon under its control, and watches out for opportunities for the opposition. Even if the opponent seems to be keeping their distance, when it becomes aware of them it will rip their soul out with its "{{AT|{{NN|God of Death}} Snatcher}}", one of its Digimon-manipulating techniques. For an opponent whose existence has no worth, it instantly destroys all of their data with its "{{AT|Eternal Darkmare}}", in which it flaps its jet-black wings. The darkness held within the hearts of humans and Digimon is intensified and fused with Darkness Bagramon's own fathomless power. If that power is released from the red eyes in its chest with its "{{AT|Balefire-Eyes}}", then all of its surroundings will be transformed into nothingness. name: Dinobeemon
raw_text: A Mutation Digimon which [[Jogress]]-evolved from [[Stingmon]] and [[XV-mon]]. A {{w|chimera (genetics)|chimera}} of a dragon and an insect, this Digimon possesses the name {{NN|Terrible Bee}}. It is hard to classify its species as either a Dragon type or an Insect type, but its Insect nature is especially pronounced. It flies through the sky with its four wings and accurately perceives the opponent with the compound eyes on its head, enabling it to choke the life out of its opponent without fail. Also, Dinobeemon possesses a considerably ferocious personality. Its Special Move is the {{NN|Dance of Hell}} in which its nimble movements leave behind afterimages while it chops up the opponent ({{AT|Hell Masquerade}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Chops up the opponent in a "{{NNO|Dance of Hell}}," in which its nimble movements leave behind afterimages. {{--}}

raw_text: A Dragon Man Digimon with the appearance of a humanoid lizard. It lives in an area that has not yet become a modernised civilisation, where all of the tribesmen are valiant combat dragons who possess the makings of a warrior. It has great muscle strength, allowing its to swing its greatsword, {{w|Akinakes|{{EQ|Akinakes}}}}, with ease. Its Special Move is doing dance-like movements and cutting the opponent with the blades on its arms and {{EQ|Akinakes}} ({{AT|Lizard Dance}}). A young leader who commands the human Digimon and respects [[Darcmon]]. It has an honest, upright personality. It specialises in using its sword. A Dragon Man Digimon that excels in combat ability. Uses dance-like movements to cut the opponent with the blades on its arms and {{EQ|Akinakes}}.{{DD|ta}} Attacks the foe with a heavy swing from its largest sword, {{EQ|Akinakes}}. {{--}}
