name: Dinorexmon
raw_text: This carnivorous Dinosaur Digimon is named the "{{NN|{{w|Tyrannosaurus rex|King}} of {{w|Deinonychus antirrhopus|Terror}}}}" due to the strength it possesses far in excess of other Dinosaur Digimon, as well as the unparalleled ferocious nature it displays in battle. It seizes the opponent with its talons, which are almost half as long as its body, then snaps and brandishes its gigantic jaws at them to end their life. Its exceedingly brutal behaviour gives it a battle style that flourishes in a world where only the fittest survive, and is probably the reason it is called the "King". Also, partly due to it fighting with other Dinorexmon, it is said that their population is very small. Its Special Moves are seizing and killing the opponent with its talons ({{AT|Splatter Hunting}}), and firing extremely high-temperature grenades, with a semi-fluid form similar to magma, from its mouth ({{AT|Ogre Flame}}). Even if these extremely high-temperature grenades don't hit the opponent, they nevertheless raze the surrounding area the moment they land. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Fires super-high temperature shells in a semi-liquid state similar to magma from its mouth.{{DD|a}} Grasps the opponent with its claws and then brings them down.{{DD|a}}

raw_text: A Digimon that evolved via data studying the {{w|Swimming stroke|swimming styles}} of top swimmers. Although it has a merman-like appearance, it is capable of moving bipedally on land. raw_text:

raw_text: A Larva Digimon whose appearance is very similar to [[Kunemon]]. Its Special Moves are jumping and scattering a {{w|neurotoxin}} from its beak that paralyzes the enemy ({{AT|Worm Venom}}), and charging and then stabbing the enemy with the horn on its tail ({{AT|Poison Ride}}). name: Dominimon
raw_text: A Dominion Digimon also known as a phantom. It acts on its own accord without being bound by the angelic chain of command. name: Dorulumon
raw_text: A faithful Beast Digimon with a chivalrous spirit. It usually sticks to rocky, mountainous areas, and often acts alone without flocking with others.{{br}}The drill on its head is a hardened portion of its hairs, and its "{{AT|Drill Buster}}", which rapidly spins the drill and then shoots it, boasts unerring accuracy. It specializes in using "[[Hit and Away]]" tactics as its strategy, where it runs around while on land at high speed to confuse the opponent before inflicting a single blow.{{br}}Its "{{AT|Dorulu Tornado}}", which enlarges the drill on its tail and then raises a tornado, is a threat not only in ground combat but also to aerial Digimon, and since Dorulumon can cope against both ground-based and aerial enemies, it can certainly be said to be an {{w|all-rounder}} warrior. Furthermore, its "{{AT|Drill Blader}}", a risky move in which it rides the drill of its tail and spins itself, striking the opponent with its body, doesn't stop until it pulverizes the opponent.{{br}}Also, Dorulumon is able to fire its "[[Dorulu Cannon]]" in collaboration with another Digimon by changing into its "{{FMO|Bombardment Mode|Hougeki Keitai}}". {{SameProfile|DRB|except with the removal of paragraphs}} ''{{fc|A digimon whose specialty is "[[Hit and Away]]" tactics|#B3901A}}''{{br}}A faithful Beast Digimon with a chivalrous spirit. name: Doumon
raw_text: An {{w|onmyouji}} Digimon that is versed in {{w|Onmyoudou}} and freely uses every technique in battle. Its spellcasting ability is particularly high, and it specializes in attacks using talismans and spells. Like [[Taomon]], it is a being that lives and lurks within the darkness, but unlike Taomon, it specializes in death curses and assassinations. Not only that, it is able to turn its talismans into {{w|shikigami}} and command them. Its Signature Move is wreathing its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonating them ({{AT|Jugonsatsu|Exorcism Scrolls}}). Its Special Move "{{w|Qimen Dunjia|{{AT|Kimontonkou|Demonic Gates, Hidden Jia}}}}" is a terrifying technique in which it chants an incantation while painting a barrier in the air with its gigantic brush, confining the opponent in an eternal labyrinth from which they can never escape. {{SameProfile|DRB}} An {{w|onmyouji}} Digimon that is versed in {{w|Onmyoudou}} and freely uses every technique in battle. Its Special Move "{{w|Qimen Dunjia|{{AT|Kimontonkou|Demonic Gates, Hidden Jia}}}}" is a terrifying technique in which it chants an incantation while painting a barrier in the air with its gigantic brush, confining the opponent in an eternal labyrinth from which it can never escape. Chants an incantation while painting a barrier in the air with its gigantic brush, confining the opponent in a labyrinth. Wreathes its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonates them. Changes the enemy's perception of the magical labyrinth, such as by making another Digimon invisible to them.

name: Dracomon
raw_text: An ancient, pure-blooded Dragon Digimon that is said to be the "Progenitor" of all [[Dramon]]-type Digimon. It possesses physical ability to a degree that could not be imagined from its small build, and both its power and its quick wits are top class among Child Digimon. Although its personality is ferocious, Dracomon can show its gentle side only to the others it has recognized. It has wings, but it is unable to fly because they are not sufficiently developed. Also, it has a nature whose primary trait is wanting to collect "shiny things", with an especially strange attachment to gems and metals, and it eats and assimilates its favorite things. Its Special Moves are breathing out a high temperature sigh at the opponent ({{AT|Baby Breath}}), and spinning its whole body to deliver a blow with its tail ({{AT|Tail Smash}}). Amongst the scales that cover Dracomon's whole body, there is one scale that is called the "{{EQ|Gekirin|Imperial Wrath/Reverse Scale}}". If it is touched there, Dracomon loses its mind to an excess of anger, and indiscriminately fires its "{{AT|G Shurunen}}", a beam shot in which it makes the horns on its head glow intensely, then fires from its mouth. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} Blows high temperature breath at the opponent. Inflicts damage with its tail while spinning its body. Upon touching its Gekirin scales, it indiscriminately fires a beam shot from its mouth after it has intensely radiated the horns on its head.

raw_text: A surging combo attack in which it swings its chained head. Drags the opponent into a floating coffin with its ghostly hands.

name: Duramon
raw_text: As it continues to sprint forward, this Perfect level Digimon is a step closer to crossing into the world on the other side. Although it knows not what future awaits it, it continues training and tempering its swords to cut through any obstacles that stand in its way. When it transforms itself into a weapon, it uses the characteristic greatsword on its back to unleash countless varieties of attacks. Its Special Moves are slicing the enemy with the blades on both arms ({{AT|Grasslash}}), and firing a beam attack from its chest, which deals massive damage and carves a '20' mark into the enemy if it lands a direct hit ({{AT|Blindead}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} When it transforms into a weapon, the broadsword on its back exhibits unparalleled strength! A Weapon Digimon. Slices the enemy with the blades on both arms. Fires a beam attack from its chest, which deals massive damage and carves a '20' mark into the enemy if it lands a direct hit.

name: Durandamon
raw_text: A Digimon possessing the ultimate holy blade, it evolved by honing its sword to its best ability and attaining data on 'legendary swords' found in mythology and video games. Boasting strength that puts it among the strongest [[Legend-Arms]] capable of transforming into swords, it is said that wielding Durandamon in sword form will surely bring about victory. Its slashing attacks are fierce enough to cut through any sort of defense, although there have been records that only [[Bryweludramon|the strongest of the Legend-Arms Digimon capable of transforming into shields]] are able to withstand Durandamon's attacks.{{br}}Its Special Moves are focusing its fighting spirit into the blades on both arms and slicing the enemy with them ({{AT|Zwanglänze|Twenty-Sparkling}}), and spinning its body to slice multiple enemies in one fell swoop ({{AT|Thron Messer|Throne Knife}}). While both attacks are powerful enough to take enemies down in one hit, Durandamon's greatest appeal is still its ability to transform into a weapon and unleash slashing attacks. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Focuses its fighting spirit into the blades on both arms and slices the enemy with them. Spins its body to slice multiple enemies in one fell swoop.

name: Duskmon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Darkness which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]]. The regret of various extinct species of Digimon and the "Forbidden Data" on the [[Net]] transformed into intense dark energy, and coalesced into Duskmon. The dark energy exists in order to oppose the light of holy beings, and the one who possesses power over Light is the flip side of the same coin. It has a thoroughly evil personality, so it is both callous and cruel. It is the possessor of demon lord-like dignity that is overflowing with perfectionism and confidence. It is invincible in battle when wielding its swords, and does not hesitate with its inhuman attacks. Its Special Moves are making the eyes all over its body shine and placing the opponent under hypnosis ({{AT|Geist Abend|Ghost Evening}}), and absorbing the opponent's power with its two demonic "{{EQ|Blut Evolution|Blood Evolution}}" swords and making it its own ({{AT|Eroberung|Conquest}}). By the way, due to the ability of the three heads and seven eyes on its armor to act on their own as if they were separate creatures, true evil is sealed in them. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A humanlike Digimon that has the element of darkness. It is made of the gathering of the regrets of Digimon being transformed into dark energy. It is said that the true evil is sealed within its 3 heads and 7 eyeballs. {{MultiDesc {{MultiDesc Uses dark energy to sift through the memories of someone it has grabbed, causing them pain in the process.{{rfe|DF|27|''Double Spirit Miracle! Beowolfmon is Born''|b}} A rising spinning attack with its demonic "{{EQ|Blut Evolution}}" swords.{{ref|''[[Digimon Battle Chronicle]]''}} Uses dark powers to vanish and reappear somewhere else.{{ref|''[[Digimon Battle Chronicle]]''}} Fires beams from all the eyes on its armor.{{ref|''[[Digimon Battle Chronicle]]''}} Spins, radiating many rings of red energy in the shape of a tornado.{{ref|''[[Digimon Battle Chronicle]]''}} A joint attack with [[Wolfmon]]. Darkness and light become one, creating a space of 'chaos' that is impossible to escape from. A joint attack with [[Gigasmon]]. Gigasmon causes a crack in the ground, from which Duskmon causes darkness to rise.

name: Dynasmon
raw_text: One of the holy "[[Royal Knights]]", it possesses the powers of the {{w|wyvern}}. It is a unique being among the Royal Knights, in that it serves the lord who embodied its own sense of justice with deep, unquestioning loyalty. For example, for the sake of its own justice, it won't hate its lord even if they are called "Evil". For that reason, it has a strong spirit of {{w|chivalry}} and {{w|bushido}}, with a character that honors devotion, fidelity, and courtesy. With its tenacious, dragon-like power, and dragon armor made from high-purity [[Chrome Digizoid]], it boasts unparalleled strength. Its Special Moves are firing energy shots from the palms of its hands, with all the attributes of the [[Ten Warriors]] ({{AT|Dragon's Roar}}), and transforming its body's energy into an aura of a gigantic wyvern ({{AT|Breath of Wyvern}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Fires energy shots with attributes equal to those of the Warrior Ten from the palms of both its hands.{{DD|ra|dynasmon}} Transforms the energy throughout its body into a gigantic wyvern aura.{{DD|ra|dynasmon}} Releases all its energy in the form of phantom dragons that converge on the target in a vortex that reaches the temperature of a star's core in an instant, causing a huge explosion.{{ref|''[[Digimon Xros Wars - Chapter 19|Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Apocalypse!! name: Ex-Tyranomon
raw_text: A Puppet Digimon that sneaks around within a [[Tyranomon]]-shaped plush toy. The reason why it is a Tyranomon plush toy is unclear, but it is likely that the mysterious Digimon that is stealing away inside just broke into the plush toy that was closest. However, this plush toy possesses power rivaling that of [[Monzaemon]] at its limits and the defensive power of an impregnable fortress, so ordinary Digimon and the like are completely unable to oppose it. However, like Monzaemon, if nothing is pulling its strings, then it is nothing but an ornament. Its Special Moves are "{{AT|Pretty Attack}}", which emanates from its adorable body, and an evil orb unleashed by the Digimon hiding within it ({{AT|Black Matter}}). A Puppet Digimon that sneaks around within a [[Tyranomon]]-shaped plush toy. Fires pink hearts which emanates from its adorable body at the enemy. Unleashes an evil orb from the Digimon hiding within it.

name: Examon
raw_text: A Holy Knight Digimon which is one of the Digital World's sacred guardians, the "[[Royal Knights]]". As it is a Digimon which possesses an extraordinary data size, traditional digital tools were unable to completely render it, and its existence was discovered because it finally became possible to render it with the use of state-of-the-art digital tools. Though it belongs to the Royal Knights, it is simultaneously a being which stands at the top of all Dragon Digimon, and holds the alias of "{{NN|Dragon Emperor}}". It possesses the gigantic, sentient wings "{{w|Excalibur|{{EQ|Caledfwlch}}}}" and the gigantic lance "{{EQ|w=Ambrosius Aurelianus|Ambrosius}}". The {{EQ|Caledfwlch}} is a unique set of wings composed entirely of [[Chrome Digizoid]], and at {{EQ|Caledfwlch}}'s own will, it can at times change into wings for flight, or into a shield which defends Examon. The lance "{{EQ|Ambrosius}}" is loaded with special shells stocked with viruses which possess various effects, so Examon's attacks are quite diverse. Its Special Moves are stabbing the opponent with the {{EQ|Ambrosius}} and exploding all of its special shells, annihilating them from within ({{AT|w=Avalon|Avalon's}} {{AT|Gate}}), and rocketing up to the {{w|exosphere}} and conducting a high-powered laser firing ({{AT|w=Pendragon|Pendragon's}} {{AT|Glory}}). raw_text: A telepathic ability that manifests using its antennae as a medium. Touches the opponent with its palms, which act as {{w|anode|positive}} and {{w|cathode|negative}} electrodes, delivering an electric shock.

name: Eyesmon
raw_text: A Digimon capable of concealing itself in shadows. The more data it accumulates, the stronger it becomes, and its power surpasses even that of Perfects depending on how much it has stored. It possesses many eyes, and does not turn a blind eye to any of the enemy's movements. Its Special Moves are cursed beams fired from all of its eyes ({{AT|Janengan|Wicked Thought Eye}}), and transforming the data it has accumulated into objects and using them both offensively and defensively ({{AT|Gugen|Deceptive Illusion}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Digimon capable of concealing itself in shadows. The more data it accumulates, the stronger it becomes, and its power surpasses even that of Perfects depending on how much it has stored. Cursed beams fired from all of its eyes. raw_text: The scattered form of [[Eyesmon]]. It monitors {{w|social networking service}}s where large volumes of data flow, and consumes and accumulates larger data. Their power is weak due to them being scattered about, but once they sense that they are in danger, they will [[Eyesmon|converge into one]] and counterattack. Its Special Moves are cursed beams fired from its eyes ({{AT|Janengan|Wicked Thought Eye}}), and entering the enemy's shadow and controlling its movements ({{AT|Kageshibari|Shadow Bind}}) {{SameProfile|DRB|except for lacking the comma before 敵}} Cursed beams fired from its eyes. Enters the enemy's shadow and controls its movements.

name: Fairimon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Wind which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]]. It freely manipulates the atmosphere to display mirages to its opponents, and specializes in attacks that generate "{{w|Kamaitachi}}" made from vacuums. However, it is more proficient in information warfare than in actual combat ability. Although it has an innocent personality brimming with curiosity, and is a gossipy, talkative troublemaker, because it has no ill will for the person, it isn't really hated. It is thoroughly optimistic, and is the possessor of a strong heart that cuts its way through small difficulties with a smile. Its Special Moves are performing a handstand and unleashing a whirlwind kick ({{AT|Tornado Gamba|Tornado Leg}}), and rushing toward the opponent, then dispatching a back-flip kick after a barrage of kicks ({{AT|Roseo Temporale|Rose Storm}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Performs a handstand and unleashes a whirlwind kick. Stomps on the opponent twice while in mid-air. After {{AT|Astato Vespa}}, it unleashes a flip kick. Shoots up into the air after jumping. Hits the enemy with its bottom. After being hit, the opponent will fall into confusion. Unleashes a two-step kick on the opponent, then attacks with a somersault kick. Hits the enemy with its bottom; immobilizing the enemy for a while.

name: Falcomon
raw_text: A Bird Digimon that lives on 3000m-tall mountains. As its wings are not very developed, it's not so much able to fly as it is able to glide; to make up for that, it is able to run about craggy mountains at great speed with its powerful legs. Because it has a rough temperament, you must be careful because if you approach carelessly, you will get fiercely attacked. Its Special Moves are scratching the opponent with its wing claws ({{AT|Scratch Smash}}), and an attack it unleashes using its powerful leg strength ({{AT|Falco Rush}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Scratches with its wing claws.{{DD|sa}} Unleashes an attack using its powerful leg strength.{{DD|sa}}

name: Fenriloogamon
raw_text: Fenriloogamon is an imaginary Digimon born from the "Daydream of a [[Digicore]]". It is a form that had even the Digicore's own creativity miraculously released through the [[Digicore Interface|Interface]] on its brow, and evolved. Possibly because it naturally possessed the data of the {{w|warg}} from [[Real World|real-world]] mythology within its Digicore, the form created by its Digicore is an "Ultimate Demon Beast", clad in silver armor and wielding an inexhaustible supply of magical power. The magical blue flames that envelop its whole body are kept under control at its own volition, and despite having an extremely high burning temperature, they normally flicker silently and beautifully. Its Special Moves are causing the blue flames that cover its body to explosively combust in an instant while howling, incinerating its surroundings ({{AT|w=Ragnarök}} {{AT|Howling}}), and tearing the opponent to pieces with laser-like magical flames that spurt from its limbs ({{AT|w=Jötunheimr}} {{AT|Gale}}). In addition, it can also summon a duplicate of itself made of magical flames called "{{AT|w=Fenrir|Hróðvitnir}}", and since the duplicate uses the same techniques as Fenriloogamon, those who face it will struggle considerably. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Causes the blue flames that cover its body to explosively combust in an instant while howling, incinerating its surroundings.{{DD|ha}} Tears the opponent to pieces with laser-like magical flames that spurt from its limbs.{{DD|ha}} Summons a duplicate of itself made of magical flames.{{DD|ha}}

Its Signature Move is driving its fiery fists into the enemy ({{AT|Knuckle Fire}}). name: Flamon
raw_text: A Digimon that was transformed into a half-beast, half-man form when [[Agnimon]] lost its power. It is missing the "Combat Instinct" that Digimon naturally possess, and moreover, it has lost power. However, it is a being that has inherited a [[Spirit]] of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]] who possess ultimate strength, so although it has lost power, ordinary Adult-class Digimon aren't a match for it. If anything, it has kindness inappropriate for a Digimon and is similar to a Child Digimon, counterbalancing its mischievous part. Its Special Move is firing off an aura of flames ({{AT|Baby Salamander}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} The form [[Agnimon]] takes on when it has lost its power. It is quite strong, having inherited the power of the legendary [[Warrior Ten]]. However, because it is afraid of fighting, it has no will to do so. {{MultiDesc {{--}} A flaming uppercut.{{ref|''[[Digimon Battle Chronicle]]''}} Tosses a small fireball.{{ref|''[[Digimon Battle Chronicle]]''}}

name: Flare Lizamon
raw_text: A Flame Dragon Digimon whose entire body is wrapped in flames. It is a hot-blooded Digimon that possesses both a heart that burns like fire and the power of a dragon. Although the flames throughout its body are generated by its high-temperature skin combusting, its skin has remarkable regenerative abilities, and so Flare Lizamon is able to continue burning till its last breath. In addition, the claws on both its arms have become extremely hot from being scorched by the flames covering its body, so the opponents it tears apart suffer double damage from being both lacerated and burned. Its Signature Move is blasting the flames all over its body at the enemy in the form of an enormous pillar ({{AT|Flame Tower}}). Its Special Move is continuously firing high-temperature flaming shots ({{AT|Flame Hit}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Flame Dragon Digimon whose body is wrapped in flames. raw_text: A rare Digimon that evolved like a reptile but is categorized as a Plant type, much like [[Palmon]]. raw_text: A tiny Digimon strong only in competitive spirit, and in any case it barks a lot.{{br}}It is also quick to flee, and extremely swift. name: Garummon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Light which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Warrior Ten]]. It is capable of moving at extremely high speed, perhaps because it was discovered on an optical communication [[Net]], so it slips through the bullets to get close to the enemy, and then its sharply-pointed claws and fangs tear through those it considers evil without wasting its breath. As the possessor of a righteous heart becoming of the name of {{w|Garmr}}, who fights with the war god {{w|Týr}} at {{w|Ragnarök}} in Norse mythology, its feelings of hatred for evil are stronger than that of others. Although it will never obey those whose hearts are even slightly evil, once it has sworn its allegiance to someone it will never betray them. Its Special Moves are charging at extremely high speed, cutting the opponent to pieces with the {{EQ|Wing Blades}} on its back ({{AT|Speed Star}}), and absorbing light energy through its mouth, then spewing it out right at the critical point ({{AT|Solar Laser}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Charges at ultra-high speed and cuts its opponent to pieces with its {{EQ|Wing Blades}}.{{DD|ka}} Absorbs light energy through its mouth then, at the critical point, spews a laser beam.{{DD|ka}} Spins into the air, slashing the opponent with all the blades on its body.{{ref|''[[Battle Spirit: Digimon Frontier]]''}} Glides and uses its {{EQ|Wing Blades}} and tail to attack.{{ref|''[[Battle Spirit: Digimon Frontier]]''}} Charges the opponent while enveloped in light.{{ref|''[[Battle Spirit: Digimon Frontier]]''}} Spins its body and attacks with its {{EQ|Wing Blades}} from the air.{{ref|''[[Battle Spirit: Digimon Frontier]]''}} Uses its wings to leap and attack the opponent with its foreclaws.{{ref|''[[Digimon New Century]]''}}

name: Garurumon
raw_text: Covered in blue, white, and silver-colored fur, it is a Beast Digimon with an appearance resembling a wolf. That fur is as hard as "{{w|Mithril}}", which is said to be a legendary rare metal, and since the blades growing from the tips of its shoulders have sharp edges, anything that touches them is cut to pieces. As it possesses a furious combat instinct and muscles honed in freezing lands, as well as carnivore-like agility and the accuracy to reliably bring down its targets, it is a being feared by other Digimon. However, it is extremely intelligent, and it faithfully obeys those whom it recognizes as its master or leader. Its Special Move is blue, high-temperature flames spewed from its mouth ({{AT|Fox Fire}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Digimon that takes the form of a wolf. The fur all over its body is as hard as the rare metal, "{{w|Mithril}}". Other Digimon are afraid of it as it has enough strength to reliably bring down its prey. It has an extremely aggressive temperament despite its small size, and it never warms up to humans. Although the claws on its forelegs are very effective at attacking, they are also surprisingly suited to digging holes, which it always does as it enjoys watching other Digimon fall into its pitfalls due to its mischievous personality. Its Special Move is breathing poisonous gas ({{AT|Paralyze Breath}}).{{xab|Gazimon}}It now uses fighting styles that capitalize on its bipedalism more, such as making itself look bigger and more intimidating to Digimon that are smaller than it, looming over them and attacking. Breathes a paralyzing poisonous gas on its foes. Makes Digimon larger than itself fall into its specialty pitfalls, and spews out its "{{AT|Paralyze Breath}}" after it observes the situation.

name: Gekkomon
raw_text: A brightly colored Reptile Digimon that inhabits the tropical rainforests of the [[Digital World]]. Since the surface of its body acts as camouflage in its tropical rainforest habitat, it is difficult to find despite its gaudy appearance. Its fingers and toes have organs that allow it to stick to anything, and because it lives its life clinging to things such as trees or boulders, it rarely descends to the ground. Although personality varies from individual to individual, most of them are of a curious and cheerful nature. Its Special Move is striking with with its freely-extendable tongue ({{AT|Smash Beat}}). It can even knock out Digimon of a higher Level if it lands a clean hit. Also, it has various attack techniques where it utilizes its tongue such as "{{AT|Break Throw}}", in which it wraps its tongue around objects in its surroundings and then throws them, and "{{AT|Swing Tackle}}", wherein it wraps its tongue around things like the surrounding trees, and swings itself around using centrifugal force to perform a ramming attack. Gekkomon's tail is {{w|Autotomy#Reptiles_and_amphibians|autotomous}}, and when it falls into a predicament, it has a habit of severing its own tail and fleeing once it has attracted the opponent's attention. As a shortened tail is considered to be proof of cowardice, those with tails that are longer and have fewer defects are recognized as the stronger ones among fellow Gekkomon. A Digimon born from [[Tenma Tomoro|Tomoro]]'s [[Sapotama]]. It is always hungry, so satisfying its appetite is its top priority. It sticks its nose into everything, and rushes ahead without thinking of the consequences. Strikes with with its freely-extendable tongue. Wraps its tongue around objects in its surroundings and then throws them. Wraps its tongue around trees, and swings itself around using centrifugal force to perform a tackle.

name: Ghilliedhumon
raw_text: A Digimon that inhabits forested areas and specializes in sniping. Its skill as a hunter is very high, blending in with the forest using the {{EQ|w=Ghillie suit|camouflage suit}} that covers its whole body and sniping without revealing its location to its prey. Although it is a Digimon with a calm disposition, it has a strong attachment to its territorial hunting grounds, so those who carelessly step into Ghilliedhumon's hunting grounds will be sniped without warning. Since it prefers making slow movements that can mask its presence and the sounds it makes, it is poor at moving swiftly. Ghilliedhumon's eyes have a special function; it accurately locates the prey Digimon's [[Digicore]] with its "{{AT|True Eyes}}", which allows it see through their body, and then brings them down by shooting them clean through the Digicore with its "{{AT|Core Shoot}}", fired from its cherished rifle "{{EQ|Bellota|Esp: "Acorn"}}". raw_text: A four-legged Baby Digimon that grew from [[Jyarimon]]. Its physical features resemble those of [[Tokomon]], and powerful fangs also line the interior of its mouth. There are more than a few even larger Digimon who were deceived by its appearance and suffered a counterattack. Its Special Move is snapping at the opponent ({{AT|Hot Bite}}). Its body temperature is hot, just like Jyarimon, and it is said that it leaves burns on the areas it bites. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Attacks with a burning bite. Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

It warmly watches over even Kinkakumon's misbehavior, and if there is an unscrupulous fellow approaching its big sister, it throws them with enough power to shake a mountain. It broke through the limits on the speeds sought by Locomon, and so it rushes about within the [[Network]] at super-speeds. It has an extremely strong competitive spirit and the personality of reckless types, and since its power is also incomparable, those who suffer Grand Locomon's assault are smashed to smithereens. Although Locomon was not able to run when there wasn’t any rails, when Grand Locomon is in a place where there aren't any rails, it is able to just produce rails to run on itself. Its Special Move is crashing into the opponent with its spiked wheel at speed ({{AT|Destroyed Crash}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} An Ultimate Digimon that broke through the limits on the speeds sought by [[Locomon]], and rushes about within the [[Network]] at super-speeds. name: Grandis Kuwagamon
raw_text: Only the strongest few among the evil [[Gran Kuwagamon]], called the "{{NNO|Demon of the Deep Forest}}", have evolved into it, and if you come across Grandis Kuwagamon, you can call yourself lucky to some extent. Its presence is concealed like dense fog, and it is the rarest species among Insect Digimon. It takes pride in being a [[:Category:Virus Attribute|Virus]]-species, and according to one theory, it is said to be a warrior in league with [[Black War Greymon]], who preaches its own justice as a Virus-species. The "{{EQ|Gran Killers}}" on both of its arms are capable of damaging even the hardest of shells or metals, so it deepens the wounds and eventually brings down the enemy. Its Special Move is clamping the enemy with the enormous pincers on its head and cutting them to pieces ({{AT|Grandis Scissor}}). name: Grappu Leomon
raw_text: A Grappling-species Beast Man Digimon that took in the data of various fighting games, using their original secrets to crush the opponent. Although it rapidly spins the turbines on both of its arms and feet to unleash ever-changing techniques, the turbines rotate by being blown into all at once by the fighting spirit emitted by its [[Digicore]], and can't run on mediocre emotional strength. Grappu Leomon inherited the data of the "King of Beasts", [[Leomon]], and so that strong will to justice rapidly spins the turbines to their extremes. Its Special Moves are rapidly spinning the turbines on its arms to their highest limit, then driving forward a blow heavy enough to distort gravity ({{AT|Shishi Jūhazan|Lion Beast Wave Slash}}), and rotating its whole body for the ultimate barrage of roundhouse kicks ({{AT|Senpū Turbine Geri|Whirlwind Turbine Kick}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Spins the turbines on its arms at top speed and throws a punch heavy enough to distort gravity. Rotates its whole body for the ultimate barrage of roundhouse kicks. A series of kicks.

name: Gravimon
raw_text: The general of the Earth-god Army of the "[[Big Death-Stars]]". It is a tactician that has the ability to freely manipulate gravity, and with that ability it has the ingenuity to survey the entire situation and control the course of the battle at will. The beauty of its plots are even said to be "ingenuity, as if gushing forth", so it makes sport of the enemy army by weaving formulaic tactics together with creative schemes. God Beast Digimon account for the majority of its army, which has overwhelming strength in terms of military power. Because it enjoys stimulating tactics, it uses the battlefield as Gravimon's testing ground. It is an investigative Digimon which continues to zealously research questions like, how many casualties can be produced easily, which tactic lets it listen to a multitude of screams, what creative scheme will surprise the enemy or ally as they die, which method will cause all of the opponents to die without shedding blood, and so on. With its "{{AT|Octa Gravity}}", which manipulates the gravity on the battlefield using its eight tentacles, it controls the opponent's gravity based on the flow of the battle, and can make them lighter or heavier. It elastically extends both of its arms and burdens the opponent with its "{{AT|High Gravity Pressure}}", compressing the opponent to their limit. Its "{{AT|Gravity Bang}}", which is called a mythical bold move, places the [[Digital World]]'s gravity pressure upon Gravimon itself until it reaches its limit, then detonates the entirety of its energy all at once. Although it has enough destructive power to partially destroy a star, it is a forbidden self-destruction technique that might obliterate itself. Although it can regenerate if it waits for many long years, even Gravimon doesn't know how long it will suffer for until it regenerates. {{SameProfile|DRB|except with the inclusion of paragraphs}} It is a tactician that has the ability to freely manipulate gravity, and with that ability it has the ingenuity to survey the entire situation and control the course of the battle at will. name: Great Gryzmon
raw_text: Calling itself the strongest martial artist in the [[Digital World]], it is a Digimon whose motto is to "entertain spectators above all in battle". Its performance in combat captivates the surrounding Digimon watching on, livening up the battlefield. It is also a hard worker that always trains so that it can live up to its audience's expectations. In addition, a match against [[Pile Volcamon]], who is considered to be its eternal rival, is a big event that draws in many spectators.{{br}}Its Special Moves are tearing the enemy to pieces with its flaming claws ({{AT|Tōkonsō|Fighting Spirit Claws}}), and igniting the poison mist it spews from its mouth to trigger an explosion ({{AT|Bakugiri|Exploding Mist}}). Finally, the most popular bold move among its audience is "{{AT|GGS}}", in which it strikes the opponent with a sonic {{w|Professional wrestling attacks#Lariat|lariat}} in a special ring it summons from the earth. {{SameProfile|DRB|except for different paragraphing}} Tears the enemy to pieces with its flaming claws. name: Grottemon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Earth which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Warrior Ten]]. Various weapons and armor are brought to life from its large hands and thick fingers, and its craftsmanship is practical yet artistic. The {{EQ|Grotte Armor}} that it wears and its main weapon, the {{EQ|Grotte Hammer}}, are both of the handmade Grotte-brand. It prefers to act alone since it hates being ordered about, however its artisan pride is such that once it recognizes someone's true merit, it will obediently abide them, and immerse itself in its own work. Although it's not very intelligent, its pride towards its work is intensely high and it has a strong tendency to take the opponent lightly. In battle, it mainly uses its "{{AT|Snake Eye Break}}", in which it petrifies enemies touched by its {{EQ|Grotte Hammer}} and then smashes them, and "{{AT|Jack in the Box}}", where it burrows into the ground and ambushes the opponent from beneath them, but in fact it also has a technique which creates [[Golemon]] using the earth around it and orders them to attack. name: Groundramon
raw_text: An Earth Dragon Digimon with giant arms on its back. The arms on its back are said to be wings that mutated, allowing it to more efficiently dig through the ground. It usually lurks within the tunnels it carved deep underground, and seldom comes to the surface. Also, as Groundramon tends to prefer to inhabit veins of the rare [[Huanglong Ore]], it has been discovered that it is very likely to find the elements of Huanglong Ore comprising the scales covering its body. Its personality is extremely ferocious, and as most people lose their life when they encounter one, it is one Digimon for which the details of its ecology are not well understood. Its Special Moves are holding the opponent between the arms on its back and crushing them ({{AT|Scrapless Claw}}) and knocking them out with the iron sphere on its tail ({{AT|Megaton Hammer Crush}}). When it reaches the surface it uses "{{AT|Giga Crack}}", which drops the opponent into fissures it generates by striking its whole body against the ground. {{SameProfile|DRB}} An Earth Dragon Digimon with giant arms on its back. name: Gryzmon
raw_text: Contrary to its ferocious appearance, which its prominently massive body and potentially lethal fangs and claws contribute to, this Beast Digimon has the spirit of an honorable martial artist. In spite of its large body, it nimbly dodges the opponent's attacks or turns them aside, not needing to rely on its own attacks due to the exceptional grappling sense it possesses. Though Gryzmon never starts fights, the moment someone angers it, it will stand on its hind legs and knock them down with its heavyweight forelegs, "{{w|Bear claw (pastry)|{{EQ|Kuma Tsume|Bear Claws}}}}". Its power is such that it is able to inflict a mortal wound on most Digimon with just this single blow. These "{{EQ|Kuma Tsume|Bear Claws}}" appear to have been imitated in [[Waru Monzaemon]]'s "[[Waru Monzaemon|{{EQO|Bear Claw}}]]" equipment. Its Special Move is a bold move in which it utilizes the power from the enemy's attack to do a reversal, striking them in their vitals and knocking them out in one hit ({{AT|Atemigaeshi|Bodystrike Reversal}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Beast Digimon. name: Helloogarmon
raw_text: A Digimon in a chaotic state, overflowing with an enormous amount of magical power, whose form was released through the [[Digicore Interface|Interface]] on its brow by the sinister magic data of the mythical {{w|warg}}, which slept within the deepest parts of its [[Digicore]]. That enormous amount of magical power is transformed into magical flames, which keep spewing forth endlessly. The ultra-high-temperature magical flames have consumed even Helloogarmon itself, so nearly its entire body has been replaced by those flames. It has also lost its sense of self, and its sole governing principle is to incinerate everything around it. Its Special Moves are firing a blast of flames that spread from its mouth ({{AT|Howling Burst}}), and tearing the enemy to pieces with its claws enveloped in ultra-high-temperature magical flames ({{AT|Inferno Claw}}). The attack in which it unleashes "{{AT|Inferno Claw}}" with both hands, and crushes the opponent between its hands while tearing them apart is called "{{AT|w=Hati Hróðvitnisson|Hati}} {{AT|Embrace}}". Its Special Moves are firing a blast of flames that spread from its mouth ({{AT|Howling Burst}}), and tearing the enemy to pieces with its claws enveloped in ultra-high-temperature magical flames ({{AT|Inferno Claw}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Fires a blast of flames that spread from its mouth. Tears the enemy to pieces with its claws enveloped in ultra-high-temperature magical flames. Unleashes "{{AT|Inferno Claw}}" with both hands, and crushes the opponent between its hands while tearing them apart.

name: Herakle Kabuterimon
raw_text: An Ultimate Insect Digimon that evolved with the data of [[Kabuterimon-species|Kabuterimon-]] and [[Kuwagamon-species]] Digimon. It has a gigantic horn and scissors, and it can be said that its form perfectly compensates for the weaknesses of those two types of Digimon, which had opposing natures. Its body shines gold, and it has regained and strengthened the flying ability which [[Atlur Kabuterimon]] had lost, so it rushes about the [[Digital World]] at supersonic speed. Having now accomplished this Ultimate evolution, there are probably few beings who can rival Herakle Kabuterimon. Its Special Move is an enhanced version of "{{ATO|Mega Blaster}}" ({{AT|Giga Blaster}}). There isn't anyone who won't be annihilated by this technique. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} An Ultimate Insect Digimon. Its Special Move is an enhanced version of "{{ATO|Mega Blaster}}" ({{AT|Giga Blaster}}). There isn't anyone who won't be annihilated by this technique. Attacks with the giant pincers on its head. name: Herissmon
raw_text: It is brimming with curiosity and will lose sight of its surroundings once it finds something to fixate on, although it is also highly cautious and will make its hard, needle-like quills stand on end when it is afraid, curling up into a ball until no sign of danger remains. However, it gets very attached to those it has warmed up to, and will show them its favorite treasures that it keeps stashed in its fur. It seems to have a habit of going on guard whenever it spots a [[Tailmon]], due to having been bullied several times in the past. Its Special Moves are attacking the opponent by shooting lightning-coated quills ({{AT|Lightning Fur}}), and curling its body up into a ball and charging forth ({{AT|w=Kenzan}} {{AT|Dive}}). An innocent Digimon who appears before the player, it barely knows anything about the [[Real World]]. As it accompanies the player, it meets with all sorts of experiences and grows as a Digimon. {{SameProfile|DRB}} The evolved form of [[Pusurimon]]. It barely knows anything about the [[Real World]]. Shoots lightning-coated quills.{{DD|a}} Curls its body up into a ball and charges forth.{{DD|a}}

name: Hexeblaumon
raw_text: A legendary Magic Knight Digimon that only those who have mastered ice sorcery (a {{w|high-level programming language}}) are said to be able to evolve to. It protected other Digimon until the very end when the [[Digital World]] was visited by an {{w|ice age}} long ago, and was later rumored to have moved to another dimension, "[[Witchelny]]".{{br}}It excels in the art of manipulating the cold, and creates various things with ice. It starts with weapons such as swords and hammers, and then other tools such as restraints that restrict the enemy's movements, and is also capable of erecting a barrier to defend itself from attacks, so it is definitely an ice professional.{{br}}Its Special Moves are spreading cold air over a wide range, instantly transforming anyone that draws near into statues of ice ({{AT|Summon Frost}}), and causing countless ice swords to fall down like a blizzard ({{AT|Hecto Edge Blizzard}}). In addition, its final secret technique "{{AT|Absolute Blast}}" unleashes an {{w|absolute zero}} wave from the dragon jaws on its left shoulder which shatters everything. It excels in the art of manipulating the cold, and creates various things with ice. It is an ice professional. Unleashes a shockwave at the opponent with its lance. Spreads cold air over a wide area, turning nearby enemies into ice statues. Conjures an ice shield to boost the defense of nearby allies.

name: Hi-Commandramon
raw_text: A heavy infantry Digimon from the mechanized "[[D-Brigade]]". It is said that many of those that have not been chosen in "Selection-D", a special selection test that screens through 100 [[Commandramon]], evolve into Hi-Commandramon. Its main role is to act as a "shield", defending Commandramon assault troops with its enormous build and protective shield. The surface of its skin has been modified with a special texture similar to Commandramon's, and has the function of displaying its surrounding colors in real-time. Its Special Moves are firing from its multi-grenade launcher ({{AT|DCD Grenade}}), and performing a ramming attack with its protective shield ({{AT|Destroy Charge}}). {{AT|DCD Grenade}} is equipped with a special warhead, and is capable of instantly switching between high-explosive shells, smoke bombs, and {{w|stun grenade|sound grenade}}s. Its Special Moves are firing from its multi-grenade launcher ({{AT|DCD Grenade}}), and performing a ramming attack with its protective shield ({{AT|Destroy Charge}}). Fires from its multi-grenade launcher. Performs a ramming attack with its protective shield.

name: Hi-Vision Monitamon
raw_text: As the newest model of [[Monitamon]], it outdoes Monitamon in fighting strength, analytic power, and intelligence-gathering ability, and is an Ace of Monitamon that displays unique abilities. Due to the fact that it always has a grasp on all of the latest information in the Digital World, as well as governing the legion of Monitamon to always lead them to triumph, it holds the alias of "{{NN|Black Electromagnetic Wave}}", and the deep trust of the Monitamon. It performs detailed analysis of its collected information and transmits polished tactics to the Monitamon, but its sole flaw is that it sometimes gets too passionate and doesn't stop talking. The "{{EQ|Denji-maru|Electromagnet}}" it holds in its hand is a weapon that generally excels in both offense and defense, as it is able take the power of its opponent's blocked attacks and turn them into particles, then fire off its "{{AT|Deneireppa|Film Buster}}", which covers the {{EQ|Denji-maru|Electromagnet}} in those particles. The techniques of Monitamon that are struck by particles from the {{EQ|Denji-maru|Electromagnet}}, which it uses as both a weapon and as a conducting {{w|Gunbai}}, are able to be enhanced to the utmost limits of their power. The "{{AT|Koudensappou-no-Jin|Formation of Photoelectric Execution}}" emitted from the antenna on its head synchronizes the surrounding Monitamon with itself, so that it can operate the Monitamon as its own body. The movements of the perfectly synchronized Monitamon take the shape of a battle formation that makes sport of and brings down the opponent in perfect order. Also, it is a Digimon rich in variations like "{{AT|Goukadan|Hellish Fire Shot}}", "{{AT|Bakusuiryū|Explosive Water Dragon}}", "{{AT|Boufūsha|Storming Wind Wheel}}", "{{AT|Raidenjin|Thunderous Lightning Flash}}", and "{{AT|Shunsakuteki|Instant Reconnaissance}}", and aside from the healing technique "{{AT|Itenkou|Healing Sky Light}}", which is not from Monitamon, these are all enhancements of Monitamon's techniques. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Turns the power of its enemy's attacks into particles. Synchronizes surrounding Monitamon with itself, allowing it to use them as extensions of itself. A healing technique. Shoots a fireball from the tip of its {{EQ|Denji-maru}}. Shoots a small waterspout from its {{EQ|Denji-maru}}. Twirls its {{EQ|Denji-maru}} to create a tornado. Fires a lightning bolt from its {{EQ|Denji-maru}}. {{--}}

name: Hi Andromon
raw_text: An Ultimate Cyborg Digimon that was perfected by improving the incomplete [[Andromon]]. The percentage of [[Chrome Digizoid]] parts which compose its body has increased, and it is impossible to miss the extent of its gains in offensive and defensive power from this, compared to Andromon. Additionally, while the Bio-Synapse circuits which govern its thinking were incomplete when it was an Andromon, by adding Chrome Digizoid parts to them, it has become self-aware and thus capable of executing its objectives. Because it is both a Vaccine-species and a Cyborg, its attacks against Virus-types are not only scarily accurate but also intense. Its Special Move is taking the fission energy emanating from the blue neutron-control turbine on its right shoulder and the fusion energy emanating from the red atom-control turbine on its left shoulder, combining them at the tip of its hands, and then firing off a beam which annihilates the opponent ({{AT|Atomic Ray}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Combines neutron energy and nuclear energy from the regulatory turbines on its shoulders to form a beam that annihilates enemies.{{DD|ha|hiandromon}} Attacks with an energy blade.{{ref|''[[Digimon Championship]]''}} Attacks with the batons it carries on its back.<ref name=DRPG>''[[Digimon RPG]]''</ref>

name: Hippogriffomon
raw_text: A mythical beast Digimon which has the appearance of a {{w|chimera (genetics)|chimera}}. It is said it will become a [[Griffomon]] if it evolves, but the details are not clear. Its intelligence is not as high as Griffomon's, and since its being is closer to that of a beast, its personality is also ferocious. Its Special Move is spewing out an extremely high-temperature wind ({{AT|Heat Wave}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} Spews out an extremely high-temperature wind.{{DD|ha}} {{--}}

name: Hisyaryumon
raw_text: A Beast Dragon Digimon clad in thick, shining scalemail and who soars the skies unbounded, taking this form when the fierce combat data of the "dragon" and "general" that lay slumbering in the depths of its [[Digicore]] was released by the [[Digicore Interface|Interface]] on its forehead. It has great mobility, allowing it control over nearly the entirety of the vast Net airspace. Its demeanor is usually sagacious and calm, akin to a god; however, the moment the crystal-like orbs it holds in both hands are scratched, its wrath will be incurred, turning it into a god of anger that will attack with all its might. Not only that, it is said that the orbs in its two hands are in actuality the souls of its fallen comrades; the orb in its right hand is the soul of "{{EQ|Kinryū|Golden Dragon}}", while the orb in its left hand is the soul of "{{EQ|Kakuryū|Horned Dragon}}", and Digicore information lies hidden within each of them. Its Special Moves are transforming itself into gigantic {{w|katana}} made of steel and bisecting the enemy in a single stroke ({{AT|Seiryūjin|Dragon-forming Blade}}), as well as surrounding the enemy from all directions and attacking ({{AT|Jūouguruma|All-directional Wheel}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{MultiDesc {{MultiDesc Throws its crystal balls, which ricochet off of enemies and the surrounding environment.{{ref|'''''[[D-Cyber - Chapter 08|Digimon D-Cyber: "Partner and Digimon as One"]]'''''}}

name: Holy Angemon
raw_text: An Archangel Digimon with eight shining, silver wings. Holy Angemon's mission in the Digital World is to act as a law enforcement officer, and it has the duty of supervising and surveying the masses of Angel Digimon. Furthermore, while it usually takes the form of a {{w|Priesthood (Catholic Church)|priest}} and acts as the spokesperson for the essence of "Light", which tries to preserve the order of the Digital World, when the Digital World is shrouded by the essence of "Darkness", it changes into its {{FM|Battle Mode|Sentou Keitai}} to fight off evil. In its {{FM|Battle Mode|Sentou Keitai}}, it consigns the opponent to oblivion with the {{EQ|Beam Shield}} on its left arm and the holy sword {{w|Excalibur|{{EQ|Excalibur}}}} it wields with its right arm. Additionally, although Holy Angemon has a personality replete with gentleness and kindness when it is in {{FM|l=Holy Angemon: Priest Mode|Priest Mode|Shinkan Keitai}}, it takes on an austere personality when it is in {{FM|Battle Mode|Sentou Keitai}}. name: Honeybeemon
raw_text:
An Armor-level Insect Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Knowledge]]". It moves very quickly due to its tiny body, and its speciality is making sport of the enemy. If it suspects someone is coming at it, it will circle around behind them in the blink of an eye and inflicit a blow from its stinger. Because of its small size, its offensive power is weak, but it has the speed and skill to make up for this. However, it is extremely fond of sweets, and its weakness is that if they are placed in front of it, it can't see anything else but them. Its Special Moves are scattering a poisonous powder over the opponent's head ({{AT|Poison Powder}}), and a headbutt attack in which it pierces the opponent with the stinger on its head ({{AT|Paralyze Sting}}). name: Hookmon
raw_text: A pirate Digimon with one eye. It ventures the "[[Net Ocean]]" pursuing the phantom [[White Whamon]], and is a courageous man of the ocean that faces up even to rough seas. Its right hand has become a hook-shaped claw, and once it has ensnared its prey, it won't let go at any cost. Its Special Move is shooting the cannon on its left hand ({{AT|Captain Cannon}}). A Mutation Digimon which has an appearance like the captain of a pirate ship. It ventures the "[[Net Ocean]]" pursuing the phantom [[White Whamon]]. It is a warrior of the sea that faces up even to rough seas. Its arms have become a claw and a cannon.  As a Mutation Digimon, it has the appearance of a pirate. It bustles about the [[Net Ocean]] with dauntless courage, armed with the sharp claw on its right hand, searching for the phantom [[White Whamon]]. Fires a gigantic cannonball from its musket.  {{--}} {{--}}

raw_text: A Baby Dragon Digimon that evolved from [[Ketomon]]. Its entire body is covered in scales small enough to be invisible to the naked eye, and its body is sturdier than it looks. It has overcome its timid personality, and has a budding sense of justice that despises the crooked even at its young age. Its Signature Move is bouncing like a {{w|Super Ball}} and striking with its rear ({{AT|Hop Hip}}). [[Cyberdramon]]'s Baby form. Like [[Monodramon]], it has a horn that is integrated in its head. name: Hououmon (X-Antibody)
raw_text: A holy Digimon that possesses four wings that shine gold. It is the head of all Bird Digimon, and is said to be the one that presides over Holy-species Digimon. While [[Holydramon]] is the ultimate form of Beast Digimon, Hououmon is the ultimate form of Bird Digimon. As proof that it is a Holy-species Digimon, it draws holy power from where it holds its two "{{EQ|Holy Rings}}", and it is understood that the power possessed by Hououmon is unfathomable. Its Special Move is solemnly flapping its four wings, causing it to rain golden grains ({{AT|Starlight Explosion}}). It is said that those who suffer this technique have all of their wickedness purified.{{xab|Hououmon}}It now has twelve "{{EQ|Holy Rings}}", and gives off power so sacred that not even ordinary Angel-species Digimon are a match for it. The divine aura covering its body is the largest defensive "[[Firewall]]", and so it is immune to all viruses. It is said that if a Digimon touches one of its falling feathers, they will be protected from the clutches of evil.{{br}}Its Special Move "{{AT|Starlight Explosion}}" has become even more powerful due to the increase in its holy power. Possessing twelve {{EQ|l=Holy Rings}}, it gives off tremendous holy power. It is enveloped in the largest firewall and is immune to all viruses. Rains golden grains from its wings that purify evil, or explodes with light.

name: Hover Espimon
raw_text: Having succeeded in multiple investigations, [[Espimon]] has become highly mobilized so that it can obtain more accurate information. It can now navigate over long distances, fly, and dive, and its field of activity extends to the depths of the "[[Net Ocean]]" and altitudes of up to 20,000m, making it possible for it to investigate hidden Digimon. Its "{{EQ|Divanish}}" {{w|optical camouflage}} has also been updated. It masks the sounds it makes along with its appearance, and is capable of infiltrating or causing a disturbance without being noticed, even when maneuvering at high speeds. Thanks to the {{EQ|VR Goggles}} on its brow, the target's movements several seconds into the future are predictively displayed, allowing it to act with precision.{{br}}Its Special Moves include "{{AT|Stamper Missile}}", in which it fires missiles from its two rear launchers, "{{AT|Breast Cannon}}", in which it shoots the {{w|M167 VADS|vulcan}} cannons on its breast, and "{{AT|Doronger}}", in which it spreads a smokescreen from both its hands to hide its allies; it has prepared techniques suited for {{w|reconnaissance-in-force}}. Also, it is rumored to be used by the [[Crack Team]] for intelligence operations in various locations. {{SameProfile|DRB|except for different paragraphing}}  Fires missiles from its two rear launchers. Shoots the {{w|M167 VADS|vulcan}} cannons on its breast. Spreads a smokescreen from both its hands to hide its allies. Presses the switch on its abdomen to apply optical camouflage to its body.

name: Huanglongmon
raw_text: Ruling over the "[[Four Holy Beasts]]" who protect the east, west, south, and north of the [[Digital World]], it is an emperor Digimon who is enshrined in the center and rules the "land (world)". An [[Lucemon|angel Digimon that descended in the distant past]] had sealed it in the deepest, darkest place within the earth. The Four Holy Beasts lost their ruler because of this, causing a struggle for hegemony among them, but an equilibrium is maintained at present. It is a being of both good and evil, and is called the {{NN|"{{w|Taiji}}" of light and darkness}}. It has eight eyes and twelve external [[Digicore]]s, and its gigantic body is covered in scales of the special "[[Huanglong Ore]]" that boasts of absolute hardness, so inflicting even a single wound upon it is impossible. Its Special Moves are continuously disassembling everything in the Digital World into the two extremes of light and darkness throughout eternity, until eventually it turns all to nothingness ({{AT|Taikyoku}}), and generating a gigantic typhoon of an earthflow on the scale of a natural disaster ({{AT|Oukai}}).{{br}}'''Huanglong Ore'''{{br}}As the ore from which "[[Chrondigizoit]]" is derived, it is a virtual ore that boasts of absolute hardness. Only Huanglong Ore is able to actually scratch Huanglong Ore, and because there is no method available to compare it with other minerals and metals, it is impossible to measure its hardness. Despite this extreme hardness, its weight is extremely great, so it is not suitable for things like weapons or armor. It is also highly scarce, and can only be found deep underground. Not only that, it is said that it requires many, many years—far more than since the age of myth—to unify Huanglong Ore with living things, and at present no other Digimon has been discovered to have unified with this super-hard ore besides Huanglongmon. As Chrondigizoit resolves these downsides, one could say it is an excellent rare metal. {{SameProfile|DL}} Ruling over the "[[Four Holy Beasts]]" who protect the east, west, south, and north of the [[Digital World]], it is an emperor Digimon who is enshrined in the center and rules the "land (world)". name: Huankunmon
raw_text: A giant Aquatic Digimon whose whole body is covered in scales boasting a hardness rivaling that of [[Chrome Digizoid]]. It has a gentle personality, prefers clear water, and protects the areas around lakes from environmental pollution. When feeding, it will jump out of the lake, move as if it is swimming in the air, and swallow flying Digimon whole to satisfy its appetite. Also, because its large build makes it an easy target, it often blends in with flocks of [[Xiquemon]] to travel around. For that reason, whenever it moves, it will surround the flock with a large amount of bubbles to protect itself. Since the bubbles refract light, the entire flock, including Huankunmon itself, become transparent and cannot be seen from their surroundings.{{br}}Its Special Moves are enveloping the enemy in a bubble produced from its fin to restrict their movements ({{AT|Korōhō|Solitary Confinement Bubble}}), and spitting out countless sharp icicles from its mouth ({{AT|Hyōran Kettotsu|Ice Clutter Charge}}). In addition, it generates a whirlpool from out of nowhere, forming a pillar of water that slams into the enemy ({{AT|Chōryū Senka|Tidal Vortex}}). name: Hudiemon
raw_text: A humanoid Insect Digimon with the wings of a butterfly. It is cautious at first, but once it gets to know someone, it will reveal its cheerful, innocent countenance. It travels all over the [[Digital World]] while dancing gracefully in well-lit places. It is said to be like a backup of the Digital World, accessing records throughout the world and storing vast amounts of record data within itself. Even if a strange phenomenon occurs in the Digital World and records and memories are lost, the lost data will be restored if Hudiemon is around.{{br}}Its Special Moves are soaring into the air and dishing out a flying kick ({{AT|Flying Kick}}), and flapping its wings to stir up a gust that spreads its {{w|Scale (insect anatomy)|scale}}s ({{AT|Infinity Dream}}). While it is capable of poisoning or paralyzing the enemy when using "{{AT|Infinity Dream}}" on them, its main function is to ease the pain of its wounded allies and make them feel better. name: Hydramon
raw_text: A gigantic Plant Digimon that primarily takes root in swampland. It constantly secretes a highly-toxic liquid from its whole body, which it mercilessly uses to dissolve anyone that touches it, and preys on them. Also, it has a habit of expelling large amounts of that liquid from its abdomen, melting the ground and creating swamps to expand its nest. These swamps disturb the surrounding ecosystem, so if you see ominous flowers that have grown abnormally, it is a sign to be cautious.{{br}}Its Special Moves are spewing a poison gas from the mouth on its abdomen that has the same components as its highly-toxic liquid ({{AT|w=Toxin#Biotoxins|Biotoxin}}), and randomly firing beams from its three heads ({{AT|w=Iolaus|Intense Lamptḗr|Grc: ''Intense Torch''}}). It completely destroys the enemy as well as the earth with its "{{AT|Division Break}}", in which it causes the vines that it spreads into the ground to shake violently, creating fissures. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Spews a poison gas from the mouth on its abdomen that has the same components as its highly-toxic liquid. Randomly fires beams from its three heads. Causes the vines that it spreads into the ground to shake violently, creating fissures that completely destroy the enemy along with the earth.

name: Hyemon
raw_text: A Beast Digimon with sharp fangs and claws. Despite being a Child, it has a large build and is strong too. Hyemon have a habit of grouping together, and many of them catch food efficiently by hunting in packs. Because they use their cunning intellect and remarkable stamina to relentlessly pursue their prey, the hunts performed by packs of Hyemon have a very high success rate. Their jaws are incredibly strong, and can even chew and devour things as hard as metal. Its Special Move is a biting attack using its powerful jaws and sharp fangs ({{AT|Cur's Bite}}). Also, its roar, known as "{{AT|Release Howling}}", has the effect of temporarily enhancing the physical abilities of nearby Hyemon, and when Hyemon in a pack roar in unison, the effect is amplified, allowing them to gain immense offensive power. A Beast Digimon with sharp fangs and claws. Despite being a Child, it has a large build and is strong too. It is characterized by the scar on its face.  A Beast Digimon with sharp fangs and claws. Despite being a Child, it has a large build and is strong too. It wears a large earring. A biting attack using its powerful jaws and sharp fangs. name: Hyokomon
raw_text:
A Chick Digimon that evolved via data related to samurai. It works hard training day and night, developing secret fencing in order to master swordsmanship. Although it shows confidence in its sword abilities, its true strength is still lacking. It is said that once Hyokomon has undergone repeated sword training and is able to break out of its shell, it will be the moment of its next evolution.{{br}}Its Special Move is using its wings and leg strength to jump, and then swinging its sword straight down on the opponent from above ({{AT|Karatakewari|Cleaving Cut}}). Opponents that are still standing are met with its "{{AT|Hiken Piyopiyo-giri|Secret Sword: Chirping Slash}}", which it devised at the end of its training, stunning them. An evolved form of [[Chicchimon]]. It is a Bird-type chick samurai that went wandering in order to master swordsmanship. A Digimon in the form of a baby bird like a chick. It has just started training with a sword and is full of confidence, but it hasn't noticed that its eggshell hasn't been removed yet. A Chick Digimon that evolved via data related to samurai.

name: Iguneetmon
raw_text: A Reptile Man Digimon that peacefully spends its daily life relaxing. It often hangs out with its friend [[Monitamon]], and bursts out laughing while watching comedy DigiTalk shows played by Monitamon whenever it has free time. Aside from fun things, it is very lazy. If there's a battle nearby, it will quickly flee and hide itself. Despite its laziness, every weapon it wields is powerful. Other than being thrown to slice the enemy apart, the "{{EQ|w=Galápagos}} {{EQ|w=Navy blue|(Navy)}}" in its right hand and the "{{EQ|Galápagos}} {{EQ|w=Army green|(Army)}}" in its left concentrate energy and unleash its "{{AT|Galápagos Field}}" slashing wave. Also, its "{{AT|w=Timon (genus)|Timoniniser}}", which is invoked after loading the "{{EQ|Gunsword}}" on its head with bullets that have different effects, exhibits various effects depending on the combination. Although Iguneetmon avoids the battlefield, it will become enraged when someone interrupts its fun time (especially while it's watching television). By detonating the [[McField|McField brand]] "{{EQ|w=Fernandina Island|Fernandina}}" hanging from its chest, both itself and its opponent will be caught in its "{{AT|Final Traveler}}", and be blasted away without leaving a trace. However, it does not wish for its enjoyment of life to end there, so it prefers not to get involved in conflict. A Reptile Man Digimon that peacefully spends its daily life relaxing. name: Ikkakumon
raw_text: A Marine Beast Digimon that was discovered in the computer of an Arctic exploration base. Its thick fur and stout body are structured so that it can endure even freezing lands. Its sharp horn is made of "{{w|Mithril|{{EQ|Mithril}}}}", one of the rare metals, and the skin under its fur is just as hard. The portions of its soles where its claws attach are heat tops that are able to give off high temperatures at will. As such, it's able to maintain a tight footing when on ice, but it isn't able to move very nimbly. When in battle, it will intimidate the opponent with an impressive roar similar to a lion's. Its Special Move is shooting its regrowable horn ({{AT|Harpoon Vulcan}}). Shoots its regrowable horn{{DD|a}}, which can then split open to reveal a missile.{{rfe|DA|07|Roar! Ikkakumon|b}} {{MultiDesc {{MultiDesc An upward slash with its horn.<ref name=DBC/> Breathes out a blast of chilly air.<ref name=DWDCA/>

raw_text: A Perfect Digimon whose appearance resembles a long-legged spider. raw_text:

By observing and learning from the {{EQ|Hinukamuy|Fire God}} of its mentor [[Gankoomon]], Jesmon also acquired the trio "{{w|Athos (character)|{{EQ|Atho}}}}", "{{w|Aramis|{{EQ|René}}}}", and "{{w|Porthos|{{EQ|Por}}}}" as part of its ascetic training. They are able to move and act independently under Jesmon's instructions, and boast formidable behavioral abilities such as landing direct attacks on the enemy, the protection of Jesmon, and the rescue of other Digimon. Its Special Moves are slicing the enemy to pieces with the blades on its arms while moving at high speed ({{AT|Tekken Seibai|Furrow-sword Judgment}}), and an omnidirectional counter technique alongside "Atho", "René", and "Por" that meets every enemy attack with their nine blades ({{AT|Schwertgeist|Sword Ghost}}). Its "{{AT|Aus {{w|generic programming|Generics}}|Over Generics}}" enables it to temporarily rewrite its own data and perform actions that transcend the laws of nature, leaving its physical abilities unbound by the laws of the Digital World and thus allowing Jesmon to overpower any enemy without taking a single scratch. name: Jet Mervamon
raw_text: An Enhancement type that resulted when [[Mervamon]], for whom the land was its main battlefield, gained the flight abilities of [[Sparrowmon]] and the ability to sprint through both land and air. Its battle strategy has also undergone a complete change; it specializes in executing disruptive tactics that not only utilize its charm, but also its hit-and-run attacks that make use of its high-speed flight ability, and are powered up as it accelerates. Jet Mervamon gives of an air of grace as it soars calmly, emitting a lovely aroma that can be felt for an instant by those it flies past. However, that elegance vanishes once it increases its flight speed; another side of it surfaces as it becomes unstoppable due the thrill gotten from gaining speed... Its Special Moves are firing beams with great piercing power ({{AT|Heartbreak Shot}}), drawing a circular trail by spinning at high speed and summoning the "{{w|Ouroboros|{{EQ|Jashin Ouroboros|Wicked God Ouroboros}}}}" from it to sink the opponent into hell ({{AT|Ouroboros Gate}}), as well as its trump card for its disruptive tactics, "{{AT|Spicy Hard Love}}", in which it fires a "{{AT|Random Laser}}" barrage all over and does a sweep with its "{{w|Medullia|{{EQ|Medullia}}}}" to break through the enemy lines. Furthermore, its "{{AT|Sexy Dynamites}}", in which it forcefully slams its bottom into the enemy, is powerful enough to cause a great explosion, and any enemy that is hit by this attack will collapse on the spot in bliss. Hunts the enemy down with its scythe, which can hurl energy blades.{{DD|sa}} Activates a magic circle beneath the enemy that fires a beam upwards, erasing them completely.{{DD|sa}}

name: Jougamon
raw_text: A God Man Digimon that contains the data of a {{w|Chang'e|Chinese moon goddess}}. It is a calm and beautiful Digimon that usually lives in solitude on its ship known as the {{EQ|Kōkankyū|Moon Palace}}, which resembles the moon. Although it seldom has the chance to show it off, Jougamon is a master of {{w|Chinese martial arts|Ch'uan Fa}}, and uses its specialty kicking techniques and high mobility to make sport of the opponent in battle. When faced with a powerful opponent, it summons its huge-bladed, crescent-shaped weapon called "{{EQ|w=Moon Rabbit|Gyokuto|Jade Rabbit}}", and fights boldly while wielding it freely. The way it fights with its Ch'uan Fa and {{EQ|Gyokuto|Jade Rabbit}} is both feared and lauded as being chilling and beautiful, like the moonlight in winter.{{br}}Its Special Moves are jumping up while equipping {{EQ|Gyokuto|Jade Rabbit}} to its foot, and then delivering a {{w|flying kick}} ({{AT|Tsui Getsu Shō|Falling Moon Rush}}), and making {{EQ|Gyokuto|Jade Rabbit}} spin rapidly to send out slashes into its surroundings ({{AT|Gabi Seppa|Crescent Moon Slash Wave}}). Its "{{AT|Taiin Kōkō|Lunar Radiance}}", which emits light from a raised-up {{EQ|Gyokuto|Jade Rabbit}} to heal its comrades, boasts of unrivaled healing power, but since it often spends its time alone, it has few opportunities to use it. Jumps up while equipping {{EQ|Gyokuto|Jade Rabbit}} to its foot, and then delivers a flying kick. Makes {{EQ|Gyokuto|Jade Rabbit}} spin rapidly to send out slashes into its surroundings. Emits light from a raised-up {{EQ|Gyokuto|Jade Rabbit}} to heal its comrades. {{--}} {{--}} {{--}}

name: Jumbo Gamemon
raw_text: A gigantic Cyborg Digimon that added beam cannons to its entire body until the strength of its {{EQ|Metal Body}}'s shell was compromised. Its Special Moves are shooting an extremely high-speed water stream from its mouth cannon, which is capable of penetrating everything ({{AT|Megaton Hydro Laser}}), and strafing with all of its beams cannons simultaneously ({{AT|Jumbo Crater}}). In addition, because this technique has 360° coverage, a crater is left in the ground after the firing. It is a Special Move that definitely embodies "{{w|The best defense is a good offense}}." Also, it can retract its legs and fire beams backwards from both of its arms, accelerating itself to perform a spinning charge towards the opponent ({{AT|Jumbo Jetter}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Shoots an extremely high-speed water stream from its mouth cannon, which is capable of penetrating everything. name: Junomon: Hysteric Mode
raw_text: Another form of [[Junomon]], it was an evil personality sleeping within the innermost depths of its heart, but was awakened. The forces opposing its beloved [[Jupitermon]] are never-ending, and if their time together diminishes, it begins drowning in the darkness of its jealousy. Its vitality gradually drains from its countenance, and when it is entirely filled with darkness, a mask of another face manifests.{{br}}The surrounding Digimon that it sees through this mask are all perceived as evil, so it runs the whole gamut of slaughter. However, this form is never noticed by Jupitermon, so it never suffers the judgment of good and evil.{{br}}Its Special Moves are continuously stabbing the opponent with the lances on both its arms, destroying their life-force ({{AT|Welcome Lost}}), and crushing the enemies it captures with the chains covering its whole body after they spit out words of confession ({{AT|Lingrudge}}). Its "{{AT|Liar Banishment}}" causes a hologram of Jupitermon to appear, and enemies that lay their eyes upon it are vaporized in an instant. name: Jupitermon
raw_text: One of the [[Olympos XII]], it is a Digimon that rules over thunder and weather as the god that presides over the skies. It is always judging good and evil on the battlefield, and metes out divine punishment to those who choose evil. It makes the decisions dispassionately, wholly excluding any emotion from its judgments. It is said that if someone who continues to disagree with Jupitermon's judgment challenges Jupitermon and wins, the judgment will be overruled, but it said that none yet exist who could overturn it. If it exchanges blows with the opponent using the hammers in both of its hands, it is able to summon tiny thunder clouds. Its "{{AT|Mabolt}}", which constructs an array of these thunder clouds, automatically looses thunderbolts at those it judges as evil or those who hinder its arbitration. Its "{{AT|Punish Judge}}" engraves a seal on the bodies of the opponents struck by its hammers and bestows a reprieve to their punishments. If it decides to carry out the sentence, they are smote with the thunder of an immense electric current, and the punishment is executed. Its "{{AT|Wide Plasment}}", which converts its body into extremely high-voltage plasma, is Jupitermon's greatest Special Move. It inflicts divine punishment all around Jupitermon, and all those who are touched by it are completely disintegrated. name: Jupitermon: Wrath Mode
raw_text: [[Jupitermon]], who usually makes judgments without any emotion, undergoes a complete about-face when confronting those who have committed sins that cause it to be unable to restrain its anger. It summons its great divine sword "{{EQ|Keraunós|Grc: "Lightning"}}" with an angry roar, and its body grows several tens of times larger, turning into a form clad in armor and lightning. The violent lightning surrounding it is the embodiment of its anger, and while it behaves calmly, each of its movements are brimming with awe, driving enemies into a corner from the pressure.{{br}}Its Special Moves are slashing even distant enemies with a single swing of the "{{EQ|Keraunós|Grc: "Lightning"}}" it wields with both hands ({{AT|Keraunós Divide}}), and loosing thunderbolts to where it points ({{AT|Lightning Bee}}). It drops the "{{EQ|Keraunós|Grc: "Lightning"}}" from high in the sky to cast its final judgment upon defeated sinners ({{AT|Dios Thunder|Grc: "Zeus Thunder"}}). If it hits them, then they are guilty, and if it misses them, it serves as proof of being falsely accused. name: Justimon: Accel Arm
raw_text:
A "Hero of Justice"-type Digimon wearing a flapping red muffler. Its sense of justice burns hot, and as it is a Digimon that never overlooks unjust acts or evil deeds, it is an existence which Baby Digimon aspire to. It comes along like the wind, swings down its hammer of Justice, and leaves like the wind. Also, it seems to like taking a decisive pose atop a cliff while facing the setting sun. By switching out the three plugs on its right shoulder, which are equipped to the "{{EQ|Extend Transmitter}}" on its back, it can make its arm transform into the power-type "{{AT|Accel Arm}}", the lightning-type "{{AT|Blitz Arm}}", or the cutter-type "{{AT|Critical Arm}}". name: Jyagamon
raw_text:
A mimicking Digimon which is able to hide itself from opponents with its potato-like appearance. Although it has a timid personality and doesn’t much like to fight, its hidden combat abilities are extremely great. In fact, with its peaceful personality it loves to eat and sleep. Since its rind is several orders harder than it looks, it can curl up its limbs and head to allow it to endure the opponent’s attacks. The visible part of its sprout serves as radar which can perceive the motion of enemies above and behind it, so even if its head is hidden it can take in the conditions of its surroundings, and understand them. name: Jyarimon
raw_text: An extremely scarce Digimon, whose population is small. The Babies of Dragon-species Digimon are small in absolute number, and it is said that most of them are captured or die before they grow up. You wouldn't know it to look at it, but there are tiny, closely packed fangs growing within its mouth, and it is foreseen that it will grow into a powerful Dragon-species Digimon. Although it is powerless, it has the disposition to face those with bodies larger than its own, and that becomes the reason for its low survival rate. It attacks with bubbles heated by the constant high temperatures within its body. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A rare Digimon that is predicted to grow into a powerful Dragon Digimon. Although it is powerless, it has the property of being able to move onwards to something bigger than itself. Spits bubbles heated by its high body temperature.

name: Jyureimon
raw_text: [[Woodmon]] evolved further, and as Jyureimon, it is a Digimon that has acquired extreme intelligence and power. Called the "{{NN|Lord of the Deep Forest}}", it is a terrifying Digimon who tempts Digimon who have gone astray in the dark deep forest to go further and deeper into the woods, so that they will never break out of that forest. The fog it generates from its body displays illusions, tempting the opponent into the forest depths, where it uses its branches like tentacles and ivy to capture the opponent for its own nutrition. If you notice a Woodmon that has lived a long life, it is probably wise to fell it before it evolves to Jyureimon. Its Special Move is the forbidden fruit that grows from the branches on its head ({{AT|Cherry Bomb}}). It tempts with its fragrant smell, but certain death awaits if this fruit is eaten. {{SameProfile|DRB}} [[Woodmon]] evolved further, and as Jyureimon, it is a Digimon that has acquired extreme intelligence and power.
