name: Kabukimon
raw_text: An Armor-level Mutation Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Purity]]". It has large flowers blooming from its head and hands, and walks on two feet. It normally absorbs nutrients by planting both feet firmly into the ground while squatting to {{w|Mie (pose)|cut a ''mie''}}. It dislikes being under the sun, which is unusual for a Plant-species; instead, it usually prefers to hide in the shadows, but it also loves artificially illuminated spaces. It is characterized by its peculiar appearance and actions, which tend to draw attention to it, and its behaviour is both bizarre yet extravagant. When it comes to battle, its colourful motions and the way it cuts a ''mie''—as if knowing how exactly to steal the spotlight—display such beauty to make even its adversaries momentarily falter. Its Special Moves are captivating the enemy with a beautiful blizzard of petals blowing from the back of its head, then emitting a blinding, stinging light from the faces on its hands to knock the enemy out while they are still entranced ({{AT|Sakura Fubuki|Cherry-blossom Blizzard}}), and drawing circles with its head to generate centrifugal force that tapers and sharpens the petals on its head, which it then thrusts into the enemy like shuriken ({{AT|w=Renjishi|Renjishi|Lion Dance}}). {{SameProfile|DRB|except for the following highlighted differences}} It has large flowers blooming from its head and hands, and walks on two feet. Its Special Moves are violently sweeping the back of its head, then emitting a blinding, stinging light from the faces on its hands that knocks out the opponent while they're fascinated by the beauty of that storm of petals ({{AT|Sakura Fubuki|Cherry-blossom Blizzard}}), and making a circle with its head, sharply tapering the petals on its head where the force accumulated due to the centrifugal force, then piercing them into the opponent like shuriken ({{AT|w=Renjishi|Renjishi|Lion Dance}}). name: Lavogaritamon
raw_text: A Dragon Digimon with large wings that lift even its heavy body effortlessly into the air, and well-trained leg strength that allows it to stand imposingly. It dwells in the magma beds of active volcanoes around the [[Digital World]], and it is theorized that it may live nearby [[Volcdramon]]. Its fighting style involves scattering mineral dust, covering the enemy with it, and causing it to explode by freely manipulating its {{w|fire point|ignition point}}. If the enemy moves, it will result in ignition, so once they are covered in mineral dust, they will drown in terror as soon as the dust explodes.{{br}}Its Special Moves are firing a laser-shaped heat ray from its mouth ({{AT|Merudainā}}), and scattering mineral dust by flapping its wings and causing an explosion ({{AT|Wild Blast}}). name: Lavorvomon
raw_text: A Digimon whose entire body is made out of lava, and spouts mineral dust as it goes about its activities. It is poor at flying despite having wings, so it mainly moves about by crawling on the ground. Contrary to its sluggish appearance, its crawling speed is extremely fast, and it closes in on the enemy in an instant. Although it has a friendly personality and will let those it trusts near it without any reservations, others tend to stay as far away as they can from it out of fear that the flammable mineral dust it spouts may cause an explosion.{{br}}Its Special Move is taking a deep breath and spitting out the largest fireball it can make ({{AT|Great Flame}}). Not only that, it can also use its forearms to lunge at and slam onto the opponent ({{AT|Earth-stamp}}). name: Leafmon
raw_text: A Slime Digimon which has a breath of fresh greens (a tiny leaf) on its tail. It has many of the elements of a plant and the composition of its body includes {{w|chlorophyll}}, so it {{w|photosynthesis|photosynthesizes}} to grow. It possesses a leaf-shaped tail, and the leaf protects it from intense sunlight or when it is raining. Due to its pure nature, it doesn't distrust others even if they are frightening. However, it is just a little bit shy. As it was just born it is unable to battle, but its innocent spirit, overflowing with vitality, can make the surrounding people remember pure feelings that were forgotten, wrapping them in a calm air. However, if one tries to mess with it too much, it will spit acidic bubbles to intimidate them. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Spits acidic bubbles from its mouth.

raw_text:

name: Liamon
raw_text: A Holy Beast Digimon that exudes the style of a "King", even though it is only an Adult. It is said to be a Digimon that evolved from [[Liollmon]], but there are even fewer surviving individuals than those of Liollmon, so its existence is becoming an "illusion". It tends to prefer capturing prey that is stronger than itself, and it has often been observed commencing an attack against an Ultimate Digimon without even flinching. Its Special Moves are charging and then releasing electricity generated in its mane ({{AT|Thunder of King}}), and reliably aiming at the opponent's vitals with its fangs ({{AT|Critical Strike}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} Charges and then releases electricity generated in its mane. name: Lianpumon
raw_text: A Mutation Digimon that wears a distinctive mask. It has a cheerful personality that loves the festive atmosphere, and will switch between various masks to try to liven up the mood. If a mask is removed, another one will immediately emerge from beneath, so no one has seen its true face behind the mask.{{br}}Also, Lianpumon hardly ever speaks, but instead expresses its emotions to others through gestures and changing masks. According to one theory, Lianpumon has masks in its cape resembling the Digimon that it gets along with.{{br}}In battle, it displays technical tactics, demonstrating various abilities by changing its masks.{{br}}Its expressionless mask "{{EQ|Teppeki-no-Sō|Iron Wall Phase}}" drastically raises its defensive power, and its body becomes as hard as ore. When an ally is injured, it puts on its "{{EQ|Kenshin-no-Sō|Devotion Phase}}", a mask that shows a loving expression. This allows it to share its own data and quickly heal the wounds it touches.{{br}}Its Special Move is putting on its mask of anger, and hurling the masks it has on-hand like shuriken ({{AT|Kyūshu Kyūmen Geki|Nine Kinds of Nine-Faced Strikes}}). name: Liollmon
raw_text: A Holy Beast Digimon with a golden coat. There seem to be very few surviving individuals, so its existence was not confirmed until recently. It is a Digimon with very intense {{w|territory (animal)|territoriality}}, so it doesn't show mercy to those who enter its territory, even if they are the same species of Digimon. It is said that when it is on alert, the hair on its head becomes tinged with static electricity, producing a threatening sound. name: Loader Leomon
raw_text: A Machine Digimon that was produced when {{w|computer-aided design|CAD}} data for construction machinery leaked onto its server, then fused with the configuration data of a Beast Digimon. Its mane has become a {{w|pneumatic drill}}, and it works primarily in tunnel construction and in the [[Chrondigizoit]] mines. The Chrondigizoit mines are often surrounded by a solid layer of bedrock, so it boasts both power and stamina, as well as top-class performance among Machine Digimon. There are many Loader Leomon with a stubborn personality due to their pride in their work, but there are many people with the viewpoint that states, "Loader Leomon is just quarrelsome." It seems that one mine, which had the best deposits in the world, was blown away by a fight between Loader Leomon. Its Special Moves are an attack produced by the extremely high-speed rotation of its mane ({{AT|Boring Storm}}), and striking with the iron sphere on its tail ({{AT|Loader Morning Star}}). {{SameProfile|DL}} A Machine Digimon that was produced when {{w|computer-aided design|CAD}} data for construction machinery leaked onto its server, then fused with the configuration data of a Beast Digimon. name: Locomon
raw_text: A Machine Digimon with the appearance of a steam locomotive, its purpose in life is to keep running. It is a being that transports the data within the [[Network]] across the [[Digital World]]. Within the Digital World, where a large quantity of information comes and goes, the purpose in life for Locomon and other Vehicle-species Digimon is in how quickly they can transport that information. However, there are times when old models of Locomon have run completely wild as a result of seeking to go too quickly. Also, although its range of movement is confined because it can only run on rails, there are occasions when it has generated spatial distortions by continuously running in circles. Its Signature Move, "{{AT|Steam Bomb}}", are bombs of steam that it blows from its smokestack. Its Special Move is spinning and then throwing spiked wheels ({{AT|Wheel Grinder}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{MultiDesc Uses bombs of the steam blowing from its smokestack.{{DD|ra}}

name: Loogamon
raw_text: A Demon Beast Digimon that is, because of the outdated [[Digicore Interface|Interface]] on its brow, presumed to be an experimental "[[Prototype Digimon]]" from before Digimon were discovered. It is said that the data of the {{w|warg}} from [[Real World|real-world]] mythology is embedded within the deepest parts of its [[Digicore]], and it exhibits behavior so violent you would not expect it from a Child. It may look like a cute puppy at first glance, but those who approach it carelessly will find themselves on the receiving end of a fierce counterattack. Its nature is such that it will recognize those who can control it as its master, and despite being difficult to tame, it can become a reliable companion if one is able to build a relationship of trust with it. Its Special Moves are shooting flames imbued with magical power from its mouth ({{AT|Howling Fire}}), and biting with its sharp fangs as it spins ({{AT|Spiral Bite}}). raw_text: A Demon Beast Digimon that generates an enormous amount of magical power within its body. name: Lord Knightmon
raw_text: A Holy Knight Digimon which is the monarch which presides over all [[Knightmon]] and is one of the "[[Royal Knights]]". name: Luminamon
raw_text: A Digimon that shines the light of hope on humans and Digimon. It is said to possess a "{{AT|Lightening Feel}}", in that if it is approached and touched by a pure heart, that person's immediate future will shine brightly in any difficulty. However, Luminamon cannot be seen unless one has a pure heart, and because it has the ability to make itself vanish further from view, it is spoken of as a [[Digital World]] {{w|urban legend|legend}}. It does not possess attacks, so it escapes somewhere while they are dazzled by its "{{AT|Lumina Flash}}", which flashes the {{w|lumen (unit)|lumen}}s it has accumulated in the ring on its head. Makes the immediate future bright for anyone with a pure heart in its vicinity. Dazzles the enemy with the lumens it has accumulated in the ring on its head.

name: Luxmon
raw_text: An Angel Digimon with a small, child-like body that belongs to the lowest rank among angels. It is often teased by [[Impmon]] and [[Pico Devimon]], possibly because of its pure, innocent nature which makes it incapable of seeing through lies. It does not possess much power due to it being a Child, but once in battle, it is able to demonstrate its true strength in fighting against superior opponents by working together with other Luxmon.{{br}}Its Special Move is a fist technique where it imitates [[Angemon]], whom it aspires to be, to the best of its ability ({{AT|Pico Knuckle}}). Its "{{AT|Cloud Barrier}}", in which it deploys a circular shield of light around it, increases its defensive power manyfold when deployed by several Luxmon at the same time. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A fist technique where it imitates [[Angemon]], whom it aspires to be, to the best of its ability.{{DD|ra}} Deploys a circular shield of light around it which increases its defensive power manyfold when deployed by several Luxmon at the same time.{{DD|ra}}

name: Lynxmon
raw_text: An Armor-level Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of "[[Digimental of Courage]]". It has the appearance of a lynx shrouded in blazing fur, and inhabits tropical jungles. It is the polar opposite of [[Garurumon]], who lives in cold regions, and has a free-spirited personality. Although it hates being tied down and never swears allegiance to a master, Lynxmon and Garurumon recognize each other as good rivals. Its Special Move is detonating the thermal energy within its body to its maximum, generating bursting flames ({{AT|Thermal Mane}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Beast Digimon that evolved due to the [[Digimental of Courage]].{{br}}Special Move - Detonates the thermal energy within its body to its maximum, generating bursting flames ({{AT|Thermal Mane}}). name: Löwemon
raw_text: A Digimon that truly inherited the "[[Spirit of Darkness]]" of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]]. The "Spirit of Darkness" was changed into its [[Duskmon]] form due to [[Cherubimon]]'s spell, but Löwemon is its true form released from this magical power. This form is by no means a baleful one, and is called the battling "{{NN|Valiant Jet-black Warrior}}" that becomes the shadow of the other Ten Warriors. Even on its own, its power is comparable to "[[Fusion-species]]" like [[Aldamon]], and it is said that it conceals its power that puts the others to shame within the "{{w|Der Ring des Nibelungen|{{EQ|Neebelnge Ring}}}}" placed on its right index finger. As a master of spearmanship, it is an "{{NN|Executor of Darkness}}" that pierces evil with the "{{EQ|Danzai no Yari|Spear of Judgement}}", and purifies it with the "{{EQ|Shokuzai no Tate|Shield of Atonement}}". Its Special Moves are blasting the opponent with an intense spear attack ({{AT|Ewig Schlaf|Eternal Sleep}}), and firing a golden energy wave from the lion on its chest ({{AT|Endlich Meteor|Finite Meteor}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Blasts the enemy with a powerful spear attack. Launches a wave of golden energy from its chest. Stabs the enemy with its spear.<!--槍で突く技。--> A rapid triple thrust with its spear.<!--槍から3段突きをくらわす技。--> Uses {{AT|Endlich Meteor}} in midair.<!--上空からエントリヒ・メテオールを放つ技。--> A flying kick.<!--鋭い爪を使っての飛び蹴り。ドイツ語で暗いナイフと言う意味。--> Kicks off the ground with its spear while dashing to kick the opponent.<!--ダッシュから飛び込み蹴りをあびせる技。ドイツ語で暗いロケットと言う意味。--> Transforms into a dark aura that wraps around the enemy.<!--黒いオーラで敵を包み込む技。ドイツ語で暗い棺桶と言う意味。--> A more powerful, charged-up version of {{AT|Endlich Meteor}}.<!--エネルギーを溜め強化されたエントリヒ･メテオール。--> An aerial version of {{AT|Intensiv Endlich Meteor}}.<!--上空からインテンズィーフ・エントリヒ・メテオールを放つ技。-->

name: Mach Gaogamon
raw_text: A Cyborg Digimon that carries rocket engines with enormous propulsive power on its back. Although its flight duration is limited, it momentarily exploits its maximum thrust, and is most skilled in "{{w|Hit and Away}}". Its Special Moves are circling the opponent with maximum thrust and unleashing an extremely high-speed barrage ({{AT|Gaoga Tornado}}), and a blow of its fist boasting supreme impact strength ({{AT|Winning Knuckle}}). A stronger version of [[Gaogamon]]'s Spiral Blow.

name: Mad Leomon: Armed Mode
raw_text: The "{{FM|Weapon-frenzy Mode|Kyoukiranbu Keitai}}" of [[Mad Leomon]], who gave itself a chainsaw as well as even more modifications. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Shakes its arm so violently it seems as if it is trying to shake its chainsaw off, cutting through anything in its way no matter organic or not. name: Magna Garurumon
raw_text: A [[Hybrid#Forms|Transcendent-species]] Digimon that possesses power over Light which is said to have surpassed even the might of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]]. It specializes in moving at {{w|light speed}}, and when its aviation unit is equipped it is able to fly at {{w|subluminal}} speeds. Also, its chest armor, its long-range firing "{{EQ|Sniper Phantom}}" on its right arm, and its mid-range firing "{{EQ|Strike Phantom}}" on its left arm are capable of being detached, although this decreases a portion of its firepower. By spinning at high altitudes, the "{{EQ|Laser Sights}}" on its chest are capable of {{w|radar lock-on|locking}} onto all {{w|anti-air}} and {{w|anti-ground}} targets, so as soon as it spins at an extremely high altitude and confirms its targets, it commences a full-scale attack. It seems that it's already too late to escape from Magna Garurumon. Its Special Moves are conducting a simultaneous firing of all its guns at all the locked targets, then violently pulverizing the main target at high speed ({{AT|Machine Gun Destroy}}), and after detaching its chest armor, accelerating to speeds that exceed the subluminal and reach the {{w|Faster-than-light|superluminal}} level, then erasing everything that comes in contact with any of the bands of light ({{AT|Starlight Velocity}}). {{SameProfile|DRB|except that 帯 (obi, meaning "bands") is spelled as 帯び}} In its Detached state, slashes repeatedly with the light sword hidden in its arm.<!--武装解除し左手で光速で切りつける技。--><ref name="BSDF" /> Fires energy bullets from its {{EQ|Sniper Phantom}}.<!--右腕のスナイパーファントムから閃光のエネルギー弾を放つ技。--><ref name="BSDF" /> In its Detached state, performs {{AT|Magna Blade}} in mid-air.<!--上空でマグナブレードを放つ技。--><ref name="BSDF" />

name: Magna Kidmon
raw_text: A Dragon Man Digimon which has firearm mechanisms equipped throughout its body. As a wanderer traveling across the Digital World in search of the comrades it was separated from, it is a troublemaker who causes trouble and gets tangled up in scandal wherever it goes. Although it has a self-centered personality and is often indifferent of its surroundings, it's passionate about things like friendship or gratitude, misinterpreting the local [[Revolmon]] it comes across as members of its own species and becoming friends with them. As it loves single combat, it is so severely triggerhappy that it fires off bullets indiscriminately once it wins or loses. Its Special Moves are stabbing the opponent with the tiny machineguns connected to the magazines extending from its hips, immediately destroying the enemy's body from within ({{AT|Bind Red Trigger}}), and the high-altitude annihilation fire which is Kidmon's greatest Special Move, in which it soars high into the sky with its wing-like muffler, then aims at the opponent with its arms folded and weaves together live ammunition and plasma shots fired from the gun muzzles on its legs and the fingers of its hands, which pound away like falling rain ({{AT|Happy Bullet Showering}}). Also, there is a Special Move called "{{AT|Chaos Triangular}}" it invokes when special conditions are met. Fires bullets from all of its guns alongside the other [[Three Musketeers]].{{ref|''[[EX7-066 (DCG)]]''}} Stabs the opponent with the tiny machine guns on the ends of the magazines extending from its hips, immediately destroying them from within. Soars into the air and showers the opponent with live ammunition and plasma shots from the guns of its legs and fingers.

raw_text: Uses magnetic force to accelerate the ore on its body, and fires it at high speed.{{DD|ma}} Confines the opponent within a powerful, condensed magnetic field, compressing and crushing them with rocks.{{DD|ma}} Emits an electromagnetic pulse over a vast range, temporarily halting the opponent's [[Digicore]] and rendering them unconscious.{{DD|ma}}

name: Mail Birdramon
raw_text: A {{w|Bird of prey|Raptor}}-type Flying Digimon. It performs reconnaissance on the status of the battle from the sky, and specializes in performing {{w|air support}} strikes that inflict precise amounts of damage to the opponent using {{w|hit-and-run tactics}}. Its movements are lightning-fast and its vision, eagle-eyed. In particular, its "{{AT|w=Lockheed F-117 Nighthawk|Nighthawk}}", in which it covertly approaches the opponent and then performs an aerial bombing, is a tactic that fully capitalizes on Mail Birdramon's characteristics. Its "{{AT|Plasma Cannon}}", in which it shoots the opponent at point-blank range with an extremely high-energy {{w|plasma (physics)|plasma}} shot from its mouth, is also powerful enough to exterminate the opponent, so its comprehensive fighting strength is far greater than that of Digimon who only possess close combat abilities.{{br}}Because it is always analyzing the status of the battle from the sky and acting accordingly, its personality is calm and calculating, and it excels at making judgments. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} ''{{fc|A cool-headed Flying Digimon that rules the sky!|#B3901A}}'' Shoots the opponent at point-blank range with an extremely high-energy plasma shot from its mouth. Covertly approaches the opponent and then performs an aerial bombing or fires an explosive beam from the port on its breast. Attacks the opponent with its tail.

As one would expect with the massive Knightmon riding it, Maildramon is also of an exceptional size, and both its power and stamina are worthy of mention. It is very much a "{{NN|Moving Fortress}}". name: Maquinamon
raw_text: A half-beast, half-machine Composite Digimon with both bestial and mechanical traits. Digimon with mechanized bodies are not uncommon, but in Maquinamon's case, it has a rare form where its body is evenly split into machine and beast halves.{{br}}Although it possesses two traits, it lacks emotional expression due to each of them being completely unbalanced and unstable, and rarely shows hostility towards opposing Digimon. Its combat strength is low as well, and so it is vulnerable in the [[Digital World]] where the {{w|survival of the fittest|weak are food for the strong}}.{{br}}While it lacks emotion, it is faithful to its instincts, and its appetite, if anything, is simply huge. It is thought that this is due to its unstable nature, making it very energy inefficient. The only thing it excels at is skillfully finding food, using its two excellent senses—its animal sense of smell and the sight of its {{EQ|Machine Eye}}—and constantly roaming around in search of food. Since it is capable of changing its physiology by taking in data from its surroundings, it is also omnivorous regardless of its habitat. Its Special Move is "{{AT|Twin Bubble}}", in which it spits out bubbles with the attributes of electricity and fire in two rapid bursts; however, the power of these bubbles is not much different from those spewed by Baby Digimon, and can only be used in battle as a distraction.  A new species of Digimon that appeared in [[LACUNA]].{{br}}{{br}}Since it is unable to speak, all of its details are unknown. Spits bubbles of fire and electricity in rapid bursts.{{DD|ma}}

name: Marin Bullmon
raw_text: A Mollusk Digimon whose whole body is covered in a mucus-like veil, it is often seen coexisting with Digimon such as [[Shellmon]] and [[Sangomon]], who are also classified as Mollusk-types. Although it has an extremely strong sense of territoriality, and is merciless towards invading enemies that enter its territory, it also has a side with a strong sense of kinship, in which it tries to protect the Digimon it is in a {{w|symbiotic relationship}} with.{{br}}The mucus that covers its entire body is slimy, and reduces friction to the utmost limits. Since strikes and slashes are all hindered by its mucus, it boasts high defensive power despite its soft body surface. In exchange, its movements are very sluggish, so it camouflages itself by slipping into the sand beneath the sea, and making only the tentacles protruding from the device on its back be visible. It preys on enemies that enter its territory by dragging them into the sand with its tentacles that extend from the ocean floor, so if one spots Marin Bullmon's tentacles, they should be cautious of its surprise attacks.{{br}}Its Special Moves are shooting a high water pressure stream from its mouth ({{AT|Hydro Demolisher}}), and spraying a viscous, poisonous liquid from the tubular organs concealed within its arms ({{AT|Toxic Spread}}). raw_text: A member of the enigmatic "[[Olympos XII]]", it is a Digimon "{{NN|God of War}}" with the appearance of a {{w|Panther (legendary creature)|panther}}-man. The Olympos XII lie in the shadows and possess ability rivaling that of the guardian deities of the [[Net]], the "[[Royal Knights]]", and each protects its own domain while maintaining a position of neutrality regarding the incidents which arise in the [[Digital World]]. Marsmon is well-versed in all sorts of combat techniques known throughout the world, including underhanded techniques, and has absolute confidence in battles against others in the same weight class. While Marsmon typically uses wrestling techniques, it is so fixated on victory and glory that when push comes to shove, it will not hesitate to use concealed weapons such as its "{{EQ|Tria Knuckle}}" or "{{w|Cothurnus|{{EQ|Metal Cothurnus}}}}". However, its true power is exhibited when it uses its bare hands and feet. Its Special Move is a magnificent aerial assault performed while clad in flames ({{AT|Corona Sanctions}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Attacks with a magnificent aerial assault while clad in flames.{{DD|ma}} {{MultiDesc

name: Mastemon
raw_text: An Angel Digimon that is said to have appeared when the [[Digital World]] was visited by an unprecedented crisis, and an [[Angewomon|Angel Digimon]] and [[Lady Devimon|Fallen Angel Digimon]] in conflict with each other united and achieved [[Jogress Evolution]]. It links with gates and controls the forces of the Angel and Fallen Angel families it summons from another Digital World to overcome any predicament. It is because of the nature possessed by Mastemon, known as the "{{NN|Tactician from Another World}}", that it unifies both families who are usually hostile to each other. Although it is a Jogress Evolution of two conflicting Digimon itself, it has a one-track mind, and helps out Digimon in various situations by freely manipulating the energies of light and darkness, and also attacks formidable enemies on its own.{{br}}Its Special Moves are destroying evildoers with arrows of light fired from its right arm ({{AT|Holy Desire}}), crushing and deleting captured opponents with its left hand including their [[Digicore]]s ({{AT|Dark Despair}}), and creating a gate by fusing the energies of light and darkness from both of its arms together, and consigning the enemy to oblivion within another dimension ({{AT|Chaos Degrade}}). name: Master Tyranomon
raw_text: A Dinosaur Digimon that evolved from a [[Tyranomon]] that overcame many fierce battles. The scars covering its body act as proof of the numerous battles it has survived. It takes on a master-like role, coaching its Tyranomon followers and raising them to become full-fledged warriors. Its Special Move is razing the enemy with the high-temperature flames it breathes from its mouth ({{AT|Master Fire}}). An evolution achieved only by Tyranomon that have overcome harsh training. The Tyranomon around it refer to it as 'Master Tyrano' as a form of admiration. Breathes high-temperature flames from its mouth.{{DD|ma|mastertyranomon}} Slashes the enemy with its huge claws.<ref name=DWDCB>''[[Digimon World: Digital Card Battle]]''</ref> Radiates a fiery heat wave from its body.<ref name=DWDCB/> Returns its status or an ally's status to normal.<ref name=DW2/>

raw_text: A Mythical Dragon Digimon! V-dramon's final form, having awakened to true power. Spews a high-temperature V-shaped heat ray from its mouth.{{ref|''[[Digimon Adventure 02: D1 Tamers]]''}} {{--}}

name: Matadrmon
raw_text: A bloodsucking martial artist Digimon that performs a magnificent dance. It is said that it was born from the folk-dance database of a certain museum, and that it has mastered the unique steps of the "{{AT|Bulldog|War-dance of a Single Spin}}". It uses its fluttering garment to deceive the opponent, and when the opponent drops its guard from a glance at the soft-colored cloth, it falls upon them with the countless rapiers stocked on its arms. Because it is a vampire, it can't survive unless it sucks a Digimon's blood, but as not just anyone will do, it seeks only the blood of strong Digimon and seems to constantly be moving from place to place. Its Special Moves are its "{{AT|Thousand Arrow}}", unleashed from rapiers stocked on its arms, and a mighty kicking technique drawn from its unique martial art, the "Bulldog" ({{AT|Chouzetsu Rappashū|Butterfly-breaking Trumpet Kick}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} A bloodsucking martial artist Digimon that performs a magnificent dance. name: Medieval Dukemon
raw_text: In "[[Witchelny]]", the [[Digital World (concept)|Digital World]] of another dimension, it is a Warrior Digimon praised as the "{{NN|Legendary Hero}}". It suddenly appeared and drove out the invaders in ancient Witchelny, which was on the road to ruin because Sorcery ({{w|high-level programming language}}) was still immature and there were no means for it to defend itself from foreign invasions, and although it's not certain, it is said that it transcends time and is still in existence. It battles using armor made by Sorcery, it holds the alias of "{{NN|Whirlwind General}}" due to it governing the Digimon known as the "[[Vortex Warriors]]", who, among all the magical systems of Fire, Earth, Water, and Wind, battle using weapons made by Wind Sorcery, and it possesses the mightiest magical lance, "{{EQ|Dynas}}", which conceals the power of the {{w|wyvern}}. Although there are almost none who have seen its form in the "[[Digital World]]", it is a Digimon called the "{{NN|Warrior of Fantasy}}" in the "Digital World", as gaudy ornamentation is applied to the armor over its whole body, and a coat of arms is affixed to its solemn form. Its Special Moves are "{{AT|Rage of Wyvern}}", fired from {{EQ|Dynas}}, and "{{AT|Final Crest}}". {{SameProfile|DRB}} Fires a sharp, knife-like gust of wind to attack the enemy.<ref name=DMO/> Fires energy in the shape of a dragon from the crystal on the end of {{EQ|Dynas}}. Attacks the enemy by swinging "Dynas", the strongest magical lance that contains the power of the wyvern.<ref name=DMO/>

raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Steel which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Warrior Ten]]. It acts as an advisor among the [[Evil Warriors]], to whom it imparts its wisdom. name: Monarch Lizamon
raw_text: A Cyborg Digimon remodeled for assault. The giant {{w|vernier thruster}}s mounted on Monarch Lizamon's back have high propulsive power, which enable its enormous body to move quickly. Its left arm is equipped with "{{EQ|Risanautr|Nrs: ''Giant's Gift''}}", an assault armament with a double-headed axe and a plasma cannon, allowing it to unleash a variety of attacks—thrusts, slashes, and shots. Its "{{AT|Annihilate Edge}}", a slash attack unleashed by charging {{EQ|Risanautr}}'s blades with plasma energy, inflicts severe damage to the opponent due to it "melting and slicing” them at a super-high temperature. Also, its "{{AT|Monarch Ordinance}}", in which it uses the high propulsive power of its vernier thrusters to rapidly move in on the opponent, pierces them with {{EQ|Risanautr}}, and then fires its plasma cannon at maximum power at point-blank range, is powerful enough to vaporize an opponent in a single blow, provided they are not that big. The characteristic crescent-shaped horn on its brow is a plasma energy-generating organ, and the plasma energy produced by its crescent horn is used as a propellant for its vernier thrusters or as energy for {{EQ|Risanautr}}. Its Special Move is tearing the opponent to pieces with a plasma blade generated by charging its crescent horn with plasma energy to its utmost limit ({{AT|Final Judgment}}). This slash attack, in which it performs a huge jump with its vernier thrusters, followed by a high-speed vertical spin in midair using the thrust of its verniers, and then a ramming attack that adds the energy of its descent, is truly its "deadly" greatest move. Charges {{EQ|Risanautr}}'s blades with plasma energy, and slashes. Pierces its opponent with {{EQ|Risanautr}} and fires its plasma cannon at point-blank range. Uses a full charge of the plasma from its crescent horn to create a blade that tears its opponent to pieces.

raw_text: Existing within [[Millenniumon]]'s inner world, it is a soul Digimon. As a result of Millenniumon's dark spirit becoming a Digimon, it does not possess a fixed form. Although it often takes the shape of a crystal, it seems that, due to its hatred and anger against the enemies who oppose it, that shape can be changed. Also, as a soul it does not have substance, and so it is immune to physical attacks. To defeat Moon Millenniumon, one must first defeat Millenniummon, its true form, but it's likely there are virtually no Digimon who are up to that task. raw_text: An Armor-level Ancient Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Hope]]". Moosemon is revered as the "{{NN|Guardian Deity of the Mountains}}", and should someone show up and defile the mountain it lives on, Moosemon will try to defend it until the very end, even at the cost of its own life. name: Murasamemon
raw_text: There is a style of swordsmanship that has been passed down since ancient times in the [[Digital World: Shambala|Eastern Digital World]]. Rooted in vast mountainous regions with steep mountains, this style is known as "{{EQ|Meidou-ryū|Blind Rage Rain-style}}" and is characterized by sword techniques that contain "{{j2|rain|雨}}" in their names. Digimon who have mastered {{EQ|Meidou-ryū|Blind Rage Rain-style}} after intense training are said to evolve into Murasamemon as proof of {{w|Menkyo#menkyo kaiden|menkyo kaiden}}. There are likely few Digimon that can fully withstand the surging sword techniques it unleashes through its physical strength, with which it freely wields its enormous greatsword, and skill. During battle, it uses three secret techniques depending on the situation. Its "{{AT|Gō-no-zan: Murashigure|Forceful Slash: Fall Rain}}" is a bisecting slash attack unleashed from an overhead stance, and the "forceful" blade that cuts through the enemy's defenses, no matter how fortified they are, its "{{AT|Jū-no-zan: Tsukishigure|Flexible Slash: Lunar Rain}}" is the "flexible" blade that can deflect any attack from a low stance, and its "{{AT|Tsui-no-zan: Kokuu|Final Slash: Wailing Rain}}" is the deadly "final" blade in which it leaps toward the enemy while carrying its sword on its right shoulder, and enhances its sword attack by spinning its body vertically in the air. Legend says that the those defeated by {{EQ|Meidou-ryū|Blind Rage Rain-style}} sword techniques see visions of thunderous rain in their dying moments. Unleashes a bisecting slash attack from an overhead stance. Deflects any attack from a low stance. Leaps toward the enemy with its sword on its right shoulder, and enhances its sword attack by spinning vertically in the air.

name: Nezhamon
raw_text: A Cyborg Digimon with control over flame, born from the data of a certain {{w|Nezha|young god}} from Chinese legend. It possesses three treasure tools, and has the ability to wield them skillfully.{{br}}Despite its short appearance, it is an arrogant ruffian with a belligerent personality. Because of this, once Nezhamon starts acting violently, the only way to stop it is to get along with it in battle until it is satisfied. It fights while using the "{{EQ|Fukanirin|Wind Fire Wheels}}" attached to its feet to soar through the air, brandishing the "{{EQ|Kasensō|Fire-tipped Spear}}", which jets out flames, and freely wielding the "{{EQ|Kontenryō|Armillary Sash}}" wrapped around its neck.{{br}}At first glance, it is a troublemaker, but for better or worse, it also has a heroic nature and is sincere, so it has a somewhat likeable side as well.{{br}}Its Special Moves are a slash attack in which it fires a ring-shaped energy wave from the ring on its right wrist ({{AT|Kenkonken|Universe Ring}}), and using the {{EQ|Fukanirin|Wind Fire Wheels}} to accelerate at full power, and then piercing the opponent with the {{EQ|Kasensō|Fire-tipped Spear}}, accompanied by flames, while charging at high speed ({{AT|Bakujin Engekiha|Rapidly Exploding Flame Halberd Breaker}}). A slash attack in which it fires a ring-shaped energy wave from the ring on its right wrist.{{DD|na}} Uses the {{EQ|Fukanirin|Wind Fire Wheels}} to charge at high speed, piercing the opponent with its flaming {{EQ|Kasensō|Fire-tipped Spear}}.{{DD|na}} Freely wields the sash wrapped around its neck.{{DD|na}} Brandishes its spear, which jets out flames.{{DD|na}} Uses the wheels attached to its feet to soar through the air.{{DD|na}}

raw_text: A form that the once-boisterous [[Nezhamon]] transformed into upon realizing that it should properly utilize its power. It has gained two pairs of adjustable {{EQ|Cyber Arms}}, becoming a Cyborg Digimon that uses six arms.{{br}}As with its form prior to transformation, it skillfully wields a variety of powerful treasure tools. It uses its six arms to freely wield its treasure tools that include the two swords, "{{EQ|Zanyōtō|Demon-slashing Sword}}" and "{{EQ|Kanyōtō|Demon-hacking Sword}}", the "{{EQ|Bakuyōsaku|Demon-binding Rope}}", which captures the target and restrains them, the "{{EQ|Kōyōsho|Demon-subduing Pestle}}", which knocks the opponent down, and the "{{EQ|Shūkyū|Embroidered Spheres}}", which chase the opponent to the ends of the earth and incinerate them, and fights to carry out justice with flawless tactics from any distance.{{br}}Nonetheless, as its belligerent nature remains the same, its only weakness is that it will often try to resolve things through fighting, even if its cause is just.{{br}}Its Special Moves are "{{AT|Zankan Sōjingeki|Hack-and-slash Double Sword Attack}}", in which it minces the enemy in the blink of an eye with its two swords, and "{{AT|Hōshin Rokurenge|Six Deified Lotuses}}", its ultimate secret technique where it unleashes its six treasure tools and channels all of its energy into a combo attack. name: Night Chiropmon
raw_text: A Beast Man Digimon whose whole body is covered in a high-stealth suit. Although it is a Digimon that specializes in nighttime reconnaissance and information gathering, it also excels at close combat using {{w|taijutsu}} unleashed through its high agility. The suit covering its whole body stops light from being reflected and produces virtually no sound, and since it also prevents its body heat from escaping, it is difficult to catch sight of Night Chiropmon, who operates at night. The helmet on its head is equipped with ultrasonic {{w|Animal echolocation#Bats|echolocation}} functions and a sensor that can detect the full electromagnetic spectrum, allowing it to "foresee" all kinds of events in its surroundings. Because Night Chiropmon's abilities have features that are intended for military use, it is suggested that it may have taken in leaked developmental data from [[D-Brigade|a certain mechanized brigade]] in the [[Digital World]] as it evolved. When attacking, it uses its "{{AT|Providence Scan}}", where it demonstrates the features of its helmet to their fullest, to analyze the target in advance, which includes seeing through their insides, and once the analysis is complete, it destroys the target's weak points with pinpoint accuracy by means of a long-range slash attack using the huge "{{EQ|Giant Rang}}" boomerang on its back, or its "{{AT|Shadow Arts}}" close-range attack, which is composed of ultra-quick blows and kicks. Also, its "{{AT|Mesmer Burst}}", ultrasonic waves emitted from its fingertips, has the effect of temporarily paralyzing the target, and can be fired from all fingers on both its hands. The Adult form of [[Chiropmon (Beatbreak)|Chiropmon]], [[Kuonji Makoto|Makoto]]'s [[Partner Digimon|Partner]]. name: Nyokimon
raw_text: A Seed Digimon whose body surface is covered in transparent tissue. Its real body can be confirmed to be within the transparent skin, and seems to be a variant of [[Botamon]]. It is thought that it is perhaps a species of Botamon whose appearance transformed into this herbaceous body. For that reason, it is not only a Plant-species Digimon, but it also has the potential to evolve to Dragon-species Digimon and the like. Its personality is extremely gentle, so it has a timid face. Its offensive ability is nonexistent, so it flings the popping seeds of its "{{AT|Seed Cracker}}", then while the opponent is surprised, it quickly flees. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Seed Digimon whose body surface is covered in transparent tissue. name: Oblivimon
raw_text: Whenever a Digimon loses their memories or their behavior becomes erratic, those around it should beware of Oblivimon's presence. Covered in a flying saucer-like shell, this Cyborg Digimon vanishes as it silently draws near. After drawing nearer until it is directly above its target, it captures them by freely manipulating its tentacles, and takes them into its body.{{br}}The tips of its tentacles are equipped with multipurpose {{w|Manipulator (device)|manipulators}} capable of hacking and performing attacks. The Digimon captured and taken in with its tentacles have their memories absorbed from within, and the data is stored in the biological storage on the upper part of its body. Digimon who have had information extracted from them are then expelled from the opening on the lower part of its body, but lose all of their memories.{{br}}Also, Oblivimon can send the hemispheric remote terminals equipped to its lower body into narrow spaces that it cannot penetrate. They are each capable of operating independently, and are excellent pieces of equipment responsible for reconnaissance, intelligence, and even assisting in attacks. When employed by the [[Crack Team]], it is often in charge of leading intelligence operations teams with [[Espimon]] or [[Hover Espimon]].{{br}}Its Special Moves are sending huge amounts of trash data into the enemies it seizes with its tentacles, causing an overflow in their thinking and rendering them incapacitated ({{AT|Waste Abduction}}), and firing a laser beam from the opening on its lower body at the enemy from above ({{AT|w=Unidentified flying object|Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon}}). Seizes an enemy with its tentacles and overloads their minds with trash data, incapacitating them.{{DD|a}} Fires a laser beam from the opening on its lower body.{{DD|a}}

name: Oboromon
raw_text: An Undead Digimon that lives in graveyards like a ghost, it is a berserker that fights by any means necessary without ever backing down against superior opponents. It is thought that the reason it has an unusually intense obsession with victory is because it has taken in a large amount of hatred data from the Digimon it has defeated. On the other hand, it has virtually no sense of self, and when it isn't fighting, it wanders around graveyards sluggishly, and has occasionally been seen conversing suspiciously with the beast skull fused to its left arm. Although the blade protruding from the skull is brittle and breaks easily, it has the characteristic of regenerating over and over again each time it breaks.{{br}}Its Special Moves are a slash attack from its blade ({{AT|Chiyorozu-no-tachi|Countless Tachi}}), and detaching its {{w|onibi}} lower body to burn a vast area with flames ({{AT|w=Rajōmon|Rashōmon|Outspread Burning Gate}}). name: Ordinemon
raw_text: A Digimon with gigantic, jet-black wings whose true identity is unknown, it is theorized by some [[Digimon researcher|researcher]]s to appear when the [[Digital World]] has been plunged into chaos and is meeting its end. raw_text:

The blades of the wings on its back are called the "{{EQ|Gaiba Daimeijin|Armored Horse Famous Blades}}". Its Special Moves are firing from the swords in both hands ({{AT|Eiseiryūoujin|Eternal Dragon King Blades}}), and rampaging like the {{w|earthflow}} of a mighty river, cutting everything apart while charging ({{AT|Ougai|Yellow Armor}}). name: Owlmon
raw_text: An Armor-level Bird Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Love]]". It excels in reconnaissance and primarily specializes in nocturnal activity. Its night-vision scope eyes have the ability to detect opponents up to 1 km away in the dark, allowing it to approach and ambush them from behind. Because Owlmon's characteristics generally align more with 'reconnaissance' rather than "combat", its offensive power is not great, but it excels in ninja-like strikes that utilize the darkness. Its Special Move is approaching the opponent from behind under the cover of darkness, then swooping down on them with its talons ({{AT|Midnight Clutch}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Approaches the opponent from behind under the cover of darkness, then swoops down on them with its talons. {{--}} {{--}}

name: Pafumon
raw_text: A Spirit Digimon that possesses a translucent body. Since its body is light as {{w|Down feather|down}}, it is constantly drifting through the air. It has the habit of moving upon the winds, and it is said that if the wind's condition is suitable it will migrate a considerable distance. Although it dislikes fights and has a gentle personality, when it gets in a pinch it surprises the opponent by opening its mouth wide, sucking in air, and swelling its body up to three times its usual size ({{AT|Puff Balloon}}), then seizes the opportunity to expel the air and escape. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Spirit Digimon that possesses a translucent body. Since its body is light as {{w|Down feather|down}}, it is constantly drifting through the air. Opens its mouth wide, sucking in air, and swells its body up to three times its usual size then seizes the opportunity to expel the air and escape.

name: Pagumon
raw_text: A small-sized Digimon capable of flying at low altitudes using the ear-like parts growing from its head. It is able to move those ears skillfully and use them like hands, performing gestures such as pulling its eyelid and sticking its tongue out, or slapping its rear to mock the opponent. It has a prank-loving personality. It will bully Digimon such as [[Koromon]] or [[Tunomon]] by chasing them around. Sometimes, it also bullies others by spitting out "{{AT|Doku no Awa|Poison Bubbles}}" from its mouth. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{S2Ep|DA|15|e=Etemon! The Stage Mounting of Evil}} {{--}} Shoots bubble-like substances from its mouth. Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth. name: Pajiramon
raw_text:
One of the "[[Deva]] Digimon", it is a Perfect Digimon with a form resembling the {{w|Goat (zodiac)|Sheep}}. As a follower of the [[Four Holy Beasts]] Digimon [[Zhuqiaomon]], it is a powerful figure who rules the world of dreams. It doesn't befriend the other Deva and is always calm, never changing its mind. Among the Deva, it has surprisingly many secrets whose truth is not divulged, and it is also known as the {{NN|Dark Deva}}. Its personality is cruel, and lacks feelings of consideration for others. The arrows of light fired off from its {{EQ|Bǎo Gōng|Treasure Bow}}, which it never parts with even for a moment, have the power to knock out the opponent. name: Paledramon
raw_text: A Digimon that evolved from [[Blucomon]]. Its large wings of ice allow it to fly at high speed, even in foul weather. Changes in temperature due to the environment no longer affect its body, but when facing hot Digimon such as [[Meramon]], its body will melt just like its Child form, causing its power to decrease.{{br}}It has a strong sense of camaraderie, so if a Digimon who it has teamed up with falls into a crisis, it will try to help them out regardless of the risks.{{br}}Its Special Moves are freezing the enemy with its breath ({{AT|w=Ice Age}}), and charging from the sky as if it were a giant block of ice ({{AT|Meteor Hail}}). The evolved form of [[Blucomon]]. It can freely manipulate and use its large wings of ice to fly at high speed, even in foul weather. Changes in climate resulting in temperature differences usually do not have much effect on Paledramon. However, when facing Digimon such as [[Meramon]], its body will start melting and shrinking just like its Child form, causing it to weaken. It cares very greatly for its comrades; if a comrade it has fought together with finds themselves in trouble, it will drop everything to rush to their aid. Its Signature Move is spewing out its {{AT|Congelation Breath|凝结吐息}}, which freezes foes solid. name: Paomon
raw_text: Paomon, unlike other Digimon that developed naturally, is an artificial Digimon that was created through human effort for the purposes of appreciation and rearing. Although there is no shortage of Digimon at the Child stage whose configuration program is remodeled through human effort, Digimon artificially created from the Baby stage are rare. According to one theory, it was developed jointly by research groups in {{w|Shanghai}}, {{w|Taiwan}}, and {{w|Okinawa, Okinawa|Okinawa}}, but its birthplace is not certain. It will sometimes spit highly acidic bubbles to intimidate the opponent. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Shoots bubble-like substances from its mouth.

name: Parallelmon
raw_text: A Mutation Digimon that can freely travel back and forth between the [[Digital World (concept)|Digital World]]s of other dimensions. It is a fiendish being that devours the data of Digimon in worlds it has crossed into, and its goal is unclear. As the world always falls into chaos whenever the elusive Parallelmon appears, research teams have identified its arrival as a disaster.{{br}}Its Special Move is absorbing Digimon with a beam fired from its eye ({{AT|Absorbent Bang}}). When something besides a Digimon gets hit directly by the beam, they are sent flying into another dimension. In addition, it has "{{AT|Endless Trance}}", in which it launches a unilateral attack from the countless gates it opens around the enemy. Absorbs targets with a beam fired from its eye.{{DD|ha}} Launches attacks from the countless gates it opens around the enemy.{{DD|ha}}

name: Parasaurmon
raw_text: A gentle Dinosaur Digimon that lives in a warm climate. The fruit-like organs around its long neck sprinkle a sweet scent into its surroundings. This scent has the role of informing the herd of their position, and it seems that the scent differs slightly depending on the individual.{{br}}It is often attacked by other Digimon that are drawn in by its scent, but it deprives invading enemies of their freedom with the numbing gas "{{AT|w=Palsy}} {{AT|Sweet}}" that it spews out of its mouth. In battle, it emits its "{{AT|Wavy}} {{AT|w=Basso profondo|Oktavist}}", a super-low-pitched cry that crushes even rocks, at a loud volume, and engulfs several tens of meters around it in a whirlpool of destruction. name: Parasimon
raw_text: A special Digimon that can't survive without leeching off of other beings, even though it is an Ultimate. Parasimon is powerless when by itself, but when it gathers in numbers, it can easily defeat Adult-level Digimon. When Parasimon leeches off of another, it can draw out the host Digimon's abilities to their utmost limit, exhibiting a terrifying power. Also, it can amplify the host's desires, and it is capable of taking advantage of those weaknesses. The existence of Parasite Digimon types other than Parasimon has been confirmed, and the influence of Parasite Digimon, in addition to viralization, is considered the cause of berserk Digimon. name: Penmon
raw_text: A Bird Digimon discovered within an Antarctic base's computer, it is similar to a {{w|penguin}}. Because it lives in an ice-covered region, it has a fault of being weak in the heat, but as it has an affable personality, it will follow after you with a waddling walk. Also, its wings have degenerated, and although it is unable to fly and its walking speed is slow, it is able to move with a speed of more than 60 kph by sliding across the ice on its belly. Also, in the water it is even able to swim using its small wings. Its Special Move "{{AT|Mugen Binta|Endless Slap}}" is a technique in which it approaches the opponent without them noticing, then uses its hands to slap them in the cheeks with vehement force. Slaps away the the foe with wings.   Slides along the ground to collide with the enemy. Causes a trail of icicles to appear along the ground to slam the enemy.   {{--}}

name: Petaldramon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Wood which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Warrior Ten]]. Countless buds sprouted from [[Arbormon]]'s surface and grew suddenly, and it changed into a form resembling a giant lizard with plants over its surface. Although it's just like Arbormon in that you can't tell what it's thinking due to its lack of expression, it possesses a great appetite that is the exact opposite of Arbormon, who doesn't require food. When it opens its mouth, it sticks out its ivy-like tongue and swallows anything. Once it swallows its prey, the branches on its back grow and it grins eerily just at that moment. Its physical attacks involve using its branches and tail-whip. It scatters sleep-inducing spores from its moss, which acts as its skin. Its Special Moves are rotating the leaves around its head and firing them ({{AT|Leaf Cyclone}}), and making innumerable roots lurking in the ground pop up onto the surface all at once, skewering enemies in the area ({{AT|Thousand Spike}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Digimon that possesses power over Plant. name: Petermon
raw_text: A Digimon which has the appearance of a boy that dances freely in the sky. It tempts young and childish Digimon that refuse to evolve with, "Let's make a country just for children," calling them to the children's world of "[[Never-Ever Land]]" that it built. It's said to have a naive and innocent personality, but thanks to its purity there a brutality lurks within. In particular, although it calls it a "Pretend Punishment", it mercilessly beats Digimon who break their promises. With Petermon's first-class handling of its sword, it delicately manipulates the knife on its hip to punish the opponent. It relentlessly chases its opponents while smiling scornfully with the dazzling swordplay of its "{{AT|Snipe Sting}}", whose blows hit the vitals precisely, or its "{{AT|Twinkle Shoot}}", which if it's thrown, pursues the opponent until it hits. Also, Petermon's breezy whistling melody, "{{AT|Midnight Fantasia}}", is able to freely manipulate the young Digimon sleeping nearby while they remain asleep. A Digimon which has the appearance of a boy that dances freely in the sky. The "{{AT|Midnight Fantasia}}" melody of Petermon's breezy whistling is able to freely manipulate the young Digimon sleeping nearby while they are still asleep. Precisely attacks the opponents vitals with its sword. Throws its sword, which seeks out the opponent until it lands a blow. Manipulates young, sleeping digimon nearby by whistling.

It has a wild temperament for its small size, causing its Digicore to burn intensely, but it cannot fight properly despite its aggressive personality as its offensive power is still low. Not only that, it is extremely weak to water and Ice-Snow type Digimon, so it will flee the moment it encounters them. Incidentally, any relation between it and [[Meramon]] has not yet been made clear. name: Pickmon
raw_text: Digimon which are enrolled in the "Starmons" corps, where they make up most of the members. The "[[Starmons]]" are composed of a corps of several Pickmon with a Starmon at their heart. For that reason, there are more than a few Pickmon who have given up midway on becoming a Starmon, then left and gone back home, but nevertheless, Pickmon that work hard, aim at independence, and stand out from the crowd will succeed in being promoted to Major and becoming a Starmon. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Digimon which are enrolled in the "[[Starmons]]" corps, where they make up most of the members. raw_text: A Puppet Digimon with a body made from a soft fabric material. It uses its drills and excavators to break through bedrock and move underground, but each time it does so, it triggers earthquakes, causing hollows in the ground and the ground to collapse. Sand-dwelling Digimon sometimes take up residence in the left-behind shell.{{br}}Its Special Moves are using its rapidly spinning claws to pulverize the opponent, along with their armor ({{AT|Tricone Bit Demolisher}}), and firing the drills on its shell like missiles ({{AT|Drill Emission}}). raw_text: A Digimon with no sense of self that was artificially remodeled to execute missions as ordered. name: Proximamon
raw_text: A mysterious Digimon that is said to govern over destruction and creation, and possess immense power. Since it is a Digimon whose "theoretical" manifestation was predicted in a simulation on a high-speed computing device, it is unknown whether it exists in the real [[Digital World]]. It has the ability to generate the opposing forces of holy energy and evil energy, and is said to be capable of disassembling every constituent substance in the Digital World with evil energy, and reconstructing the disassembled substances with holy energy to create new ones. Because it disassembles and recreates everything such as the Digimon in its surroundings and the environment merely by existing, there is a risk that the Digital World will be completely rewritten in the blink of an eye as a result of this Digimon manifesting. For that reason, in order to prevent any possible abuse, the simulation data on the evolution requirements for manifesting Proximamon is strictly kept secret. It constantly invokes its "{{AT|Extinction Cloud}}", in which it disassembles everything into its smallest units with black particles, and its "{{AT|Light of Re-creation}}", where it uses its huge battleaxe imbued with holy light to recreate what was disassembled into a new existence. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Disassembles everything into its smallest units with black particles.{{DD|ha}} Uses its huge battleaxe imbued with holy light to recreate what it disassembled into a new existence.{{DD|ha}}

name: Pteromon
raw_text: A Bird Dragon Digimon that flies about freely through the skies over vast forests. The horns on its head are soft, and serve more as sensory organs than they do for offense. It can acutely perceive changes in climate by reading the wind striking against its horns.{{br}}It has a strong interest in other species, and often flies through the sky alongside them in attempt to make contact; this includes Child Digimon such as [[Piyomon]] and [[Falcomon]], and occasionally larger Adult and Perfect Digimon. Also, it has the ability to instantly regrow its feathers to heal its wounds when injured.{{br}}Its Special Moves are a slash attack where it flaps its arm-wings to send out a blade of wind ({{AT|Wind Slicer}}), and piercing the enemy with the talons on its feet while flying ({{AT|Rumble Claw}}). {{fc|Even in a pinch, don’t forget to have fun!！|#54139e}}{{br}}A new type of Digimon who loves freedom and thoroughly enjoys being unbound by anything.{{br}}It was supposed to be a wild Digimon not part of Digimon Liberator, but after meeting Shoto, it decided to become his partner.{{br}}Convinced that it is the elder brother figure in their relationship, it frequently attempts to establish its seniority. It possesses a unique set of values stemming from its nurturing nature and self-confidence, and believes that "the strong must protect the weak". Flaps its arm-wings to send out a blade of wind. Pierces the enemy with the talons on its feet while flying.

Although it is supported by a large number of readers due to the content that it publishes, there are many readers who detest it. However, those who harm its readers will fall victim to its forced coverage of them vigorously.{{br}}Its Special Moves are sandwiching the enemy between two giant {{w|Window (computing)|window}}s with great force ({{AT|Dual Presser}}), and sending its windows flying like paper airplanes to pierce them ({{AT|Juke-crack}}). name: Pumpmon
raw_text:
A plush toy Digimon with a pumpkin head. There's an urban legend that says Pumpmon came to be when mutations developed in a [[computer virus]] created during the season of the Western holiday of "{{w|Halloween}}". However, though it doesn't inflict any harm at all because it was not a malignant virus, its external appearance belies its possession of powerful offensive ability. As you can tell even from looking at its blank face, a rare expression of emotions is characteristic of Puppet Digimon. Its Special Move is manifesting a gigantic pumpkin in the air, and then {{w|squash (plant)|squash}}ing the opponent with it ({{AT|Trick or Treat}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Plush Toy Digimon that has a surreal head that is said to be a pumpkin with an axe stuck in it. Its personality is wrapped in mystery, and as you can tell from looking at its blank face it rarely expresses emotion, so what it's thinking can't be figured out. Because it was never a malignant virus, it rarely inflicts any harm on purpose, but its external appearance belies its possession of a powerful offensive ability. name: Pusurimon
raw_text: A quadrupedal Lesser Digimon with yellow spines growing from its back. It is always running around energetically, though it will sometimes appear to stop in its tracks when in reality it has just fallen asleep on the spot. Its Signature Move is causing the fur covering its body to stand and harden, then curling itself into a ball and doing a jump-tackle while spinning ({{AT|Chikuchiku Rolling}}). A Baby-level Lesser Digimon with yellow needles growing on its back. Curls itself into a ball and does a jump-tackle while spinning.

name: Puttimon
raw_text: It is a sacred Digimon Baby who is the template for all Angel-type Digimon. On the other hand, it has poor self-judgment between good and evil, and can be quite adorably mischievous. If anything, it's popular for bringing about euphoria, good fortune, and such. Though as a newborn it's rare for it to do so, it can fly skillfully about the sky with the two wings growing from its back. When it flies about in the sky, it is able to place its opponent in a happy mood with a mysterious powder called "{{AT|Angel Dust}}". {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} Sprinkles a mysterious powder over its opponent that puts them in a happy mood. Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

name: Puwamon
raw_text: A Chick Digimon covered in soft feathers. Its eyesight is extremely great, and because it is able to survey a vast range, it can react instantly to surrounding movements. Its personality is intensely curious, and it began gaining popularity because it lacks shyness and easily makes attachments. However, it extremely dislikes when its tail is touched, and so if its tail is touched carelessly, caution will be necessary, since it will shower you down in blinding feathers ({{AT|Fuwā Feather}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{AnalyzerDub|That's Puwamon. He's an In-Training Level Digimon that's covered in soft feathers. It's very curious and easily bonds with people.|Digimon Savers - Episode 12|Digimon Data Squad: "The Digi-Egg That Fell to Earth"|{{hdr2|Thoma H. Norstein|Thomas H. Norstein}}}} Shocks whoever touches the Fuwa Feather on its tail.

name: Puyomon
raw_text: Emits a tingling static electricity.

name: Puyoyomon
raw_text: Sends out a bursting streak of electricity.

name: Pyocomon
raw_text:
A Bulb-type Lesser Digimon with a large flower blooming from its head. It is able to move by skilfully manoeuvring its root-like tentacles, and it can even float upwards into the air, albeit only to a small height. It is brimming with curiosity, and its restless movements make it look downright adorable. It has a habit of living together in flocks, and they may number from a few to even a few hundred depending on the flock. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Bulb-type Lesser Digimon with a large flower blooming from its head. It is able to move by skillfully operating its root-like tentacles, and with its lightness, it can rise into the air, but only to a small height. As it is brimming with curiosity, it is restlessly stirring and its appearance seems very cute.
It has a habit of living together in flocks, and it is said that due to grouping, the flocks will grow from a few to a few hundred. {{--}} {{--}}

name: Pyonmon
raw_text: Slaps the opponent with its large ear.

name: Pyramidimon
raw_text: A Digimon with an enormous figure that some Digimon evolve into by taking in data from ancient ruins scattered throughout the [[Digital World]]. Its body is comprised of sand data, and because it is constantly surrounded by a sandstorm, it keeps ordinary Digimon at bay.{{br}}As a result of absorbing ruins and the ancient data stored within them, it possesses extremely high intelligence and the power to hold its own, even when facing large armies. Since it consumes a lot of energy when active, it often sleeps camouflaging itself as a pyramid.{{br}}Even if it suffers heavy damage, it can instantly regenerate by taking in sand from its surroundings, so it is difficult to stop Pyramidimon in its tracks unless one attacks its [[Digicore]] directly.{{br}}Its Special Moves are spinning its pyramid-shaped fingers and pulverizing the opponent ({{AT|Zofr Kabus|Ara: "Claw Nightmare"}}), smashing the opponent from overhead with the pyramids on its shoulders ({{j2|{{AT|w=List of Egyptian deities#Minor deities|Apesh}} {{AT|Eiqab}}|Ara: "Apesh Punishment"}}), and unleashing a sandstorm from the eye on its chest which erodes everything ({{j2|{{AT|Laena}} {{AT|w=Khamsin}}|Ara: "Curse Khamsin"}}). Spins its pyramid-shaped fingers and pulverizes the enemy. Smashes the enemy overhead with the pyramids on its shoulders. Unleashes a sandstorm from the eye on its chest which erodes everything.

name: Qinglongmon
raw_text: One of the [[Four Holy Beasts]] who protect the Digital World, it guards the East and releases intense lightning strikes. It is a legendary being like the other Four Holy Beast Digimon, and its strength is said to equal that of a god. Also, it is counted as one of the [[Four Great Dragons]] alongside [[Holydramon]], [[Goddramon]], and [[Megidramon]], and is the most deified existence among them. However, although it is a divine being, it will not easily cooperate with humans and the weak, and it is not likely to lend help to its allies unless there is something serious. Its Special Move is loosing intense thunderbolts from the sky, with divine fury ({{AT|Sourai}}). {{SameProfile|DL}} {{SameProfile|DRB|except that the counter "匹" is used instead of "体"}} Looses intense thunderbolts from the sky, with divine fury. Strikes its enemy with lightning from the sky. {{--}}

name: Quantumon
raw_text: An Ultimate Digimon enshrined in the aerial city of "Larc", which floats above the vast "[[Net Ocean]]", shrouded by enormous clouds. Quantumon extracts huge amounts of data from the Net Ocean using the expansion devices installed on Larc, and runs millions upon trillions of simulations of the future. Together with its Digimon followers, Quantumon implements the best measures it has formulated against disasters that are predicted to occur in the [[Digital World]].{{br}}Its Special Move is transforming space into a gate via quantum processing, and forcefully sending the enemy into another dimension ({{AT|Unlimited Journey}}). This technique can also be used to forcibly evade other Digimon, or send them to another dimension for their own research and analysis. In addition, it can also manipulate the flow of time, causing quantum decay at specific coordinates with its "{{AT|Hazy Time}}". An Ultimate Digimon enshrined in the aerial city of "Larc", which is shrouded by enormous clouds. It extracts huge amounts of data, and runs millions upon trillions of simulations of the future. Manipulates time and shatters the target's timeline. From the floating city "Larc", time energy is bombarded onto the ground.

name: Quartzmon
raw_text: A colossal Digimon that keeps absorbing data to amplify its power. The {{EQ|Great Evil Globe}}, which makes up most of its body, is a fusion reactor that generates "{{EQ|Gypt Particles}}", Quartzmon's power source, from the data it has absorbed. Quartzmon's true form is situated at the very top, and can act independently of the {{EQ|Great Evil Globe}}, and furthermore, it is also capable of altering its appearance. It hungers for the data of the entire world, and will swallow even Digimon whole and absorb them. Its Special Move is emitting the {{EQ|Gypt Particles}} generated within the {{EQ|Great Evil Globe}} into its entire surroundings ({{AT|Gypt Ryūshi Hou|Gypt Particle Cannon}}), and if you touch them even the slightest bit, they will spread throughout your whole body and completely erase you without leaving any data behind. Also, in its "{{AT|Ruin Blast}}", where it injects {{EQ|Gypt Particles}} into the body of an enemy it seizes with its tentacles, the enemy explodes from within. A colossal Digimon that keeps absorbing data to amplify its power. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Emits the {{EQ|Gypt Particles}} generated within its large wicked sphere to the entire surroundings, and if anyone touches them even slightly, they will spread throughout their entire body and completely erase them without leaving any data behind. Quickly creates copies of itself or Digimon it has absorbed. Pours {{EQ|Gypt Particles}} inside a seized enemy's body through its tentacles, and causes them to explode from within.

name: Queen Chessmon
raw_text: The strongest Digimon of the [[Chessmon-species|Chessmon]] series which possesses extreme range and offensive ability. It is a reliable being that defends the cowardly [[King Chessmon]]. That superior offensive ability is a power that sometimes seems rather inhuman. Its catchphrase is, "God of Chess, bestow pardon!" Its Special Moves are impaling the opponent's vitals with the swords on its armor ({{AT|Heart Breaker}}), "{{AT|Queen Stamp}}", and "{{AT|Queen Stick}}". Also, it can give the opponent a hard time with its "{{AT|Hime no Wagamama|Princess's Whim}}". {{SameProfile|DRB}} The strongest Digimon of the [[Chessmon-species|Chessmon]] series which possesses extreme range and offensive ability. Also, it can cheer up Digimon without fighting spirit with its "{{AT|Queen Stamp}}". name: Queenbeemon
raw_text: Produces the most effective poison against its opponent and launches it at them from the {{EQ|Royal Throne}}'s arm unit. Fires a beam of light from the turret on the underside of the {{EQ|Royal Throne}}.

name: Rafflesimon
raw_text: An Ultimate-level Fairy Digimon said to be the largest flower in the [[Digital World]]. While its appearance is so beautiful that it enraptures all who lay eyes upon it, the stench it emits is out of this world. There are a number of people who fell for Rafflesimon's beauty at first sight and sought to find it again after a single glance. However, Rafflesimon's lifespan is short, and its life processes will cease after just several days have passed. Because of the extremely low likelihood of being able to catch sight of a Rafflesimon, it is also known as the "{{NN|Miraculous Flower}}". Despite its circumstances, Rafflesimon never expresses any pessimism about its looming death, constantly yearning to live a normal life and dancing elegantly till its very last.{{br}}Its Special Move is firing its sleeve like a cannon ({{AT|Ballet Gun}}). It utilizes the large flower petals that dance around it as reflectors, reflecting its shots so that no enemy can escape. Not only that, it can also shed scales from its body ({{AT|Wisselen|Dut: Change}}). These scales cause anyone whose body they have latched onto to lose consciousness and turn into Rafflesimon's servants. Not only that, it can also shed scales from its body ({{AT|Wisselen|Dut: Change}}). These scales cause anyone whose body they have latched onto to lose consciousness and turn into Rafflesimon's servants. {{MultiDesc Sheds scales that latch onto the opponent, making them lose consciousness and become Rafflesimon's servants.{{DD|ra|rafflesimon}} Enthralls an opponent with a pink gas and absorbs its life-force.<ref name=DMO/>

name: Ragna Lordmon
raw_text: Bisects the enemy in a single stroke by cleaving its sword down from a high altitude. Spews extremely high temperature flames from its shield, turning its surroundings into a sea of fire. Impales the enemy with its sword wreathed in its shield's flames, completely incinerating and erasing the enemy.

name: Ragnamon
raw_text: An Ultimate that boasts the largest size among Digimon. Having taken in the data of an artificial satellite, it possesses a variety of satellite weapons that are enough to annihilate vast areas of ​​the [[Digital World]] from high above. However, it requires a large amount of resources to operate, necessitating the support of proficient [[hacker]]s, so there are few records of it appearing on the battlefield.{{br}}Its Special Moves are "{{AT|w=Gimlet (tool)|Gimlet}} {{AT|Gun}}", in which it pierces with its tail, "{{AT|Spaser}}", in which it fires an enormous laser from its head, "{{AT|Shuttle Scissors}}", in which it seizes the enemy with its right arm and severs them, "{{AT|Satellite Buster}}", in which it picks off distant enemies with the gun barrels on its shoulders, and "{{AT|w=Ragnarök}} {{AT|Cannon}}", which is fired from its chest, providing maximum offensive power. In addition, whenever it receives an attack from the enemy, it analyzes it, and is capable of unleashing that attack's power back at them. name: Raguelmon
raw_text: An [[Ultimate]] level Digimon who observes all Angel Digimon with eyes of distrust, in order to prevent the fall of other Angel Digimon. The moment it detects an Angel Digimon that has begun to fall, it will attack and destroy them before they would have fallen completely. However, because it was shunned for its role as an observer, it began to be filled with nihilistic thoughts until its sole line of thought was to reject everything. At that stage, it no longer discerns between friend and foe, turning into a fearsome Digimon that carries out destruction indiscriminately.{{br}}Its Special Move is mutilating the enemy using the claws on its arms and the tip of its tail ({{AT|Form Taranis}}). Once it impales the enemy, it injects destructive data that eat away at and corrode the enemy from the inside. It can also fire laser bullets from the gemstones situated on its arms and chest ({{AT|Purhorus}}). An Ultimate level Fallen Angel Digimon that evolved from [[Meicrackmon Vicious Mode]] when it sought to further reject the world from itself. A form that resulted when [[Meicrackmon Vicious Mode|Meicrackmon]] underwent a further mutation! Slams its claw armor together and fires a barrage of thorns from their gemstones.<!--Footage: https://youtu.be/1VYE9Y9y46U?t=240-->{{ref|''[[Digimon Linkz]]''}} Shreds the opponent with its claws and the tip of its tail, injecting impaled opponents with corrosive data.{{DD|ra}} Fires laser bullets from the gemstones on its claw armor and chest armor.{{DD|ra}}

name: Raidenmon
raw_text: A heavyweight-class Machine type Digimon equipped with electromagnetic weapons. It was created as a shooting-type, unlike [[Raijinmon]], who similarly uses lightning as its energy. Although it is not as adept in close combat, it defends itself using its thick armor, and counterattacks with its left arm. Its Special Moves are causing a {{w|corona discharge}} brought upon by a 45000-volt electric attack ({{AT|w=Kirlian photography|Kirlian}} {{AT|Brand}}), and firing ultra-high temperature spheres from the gun barrels on both of its shoulders ({{AT|Rising Sun}}). An ultimate battle fortress that is not afraid to do a life-risking tackle to take down its target. A heavyweight-class Machine type Digimon equipped with electromagnetic weapons. name: Raihimon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Darkness that has transcended legend by inheriting all the might of one of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]] and acquiring unknown abilities. There are none who have seen this hero, and due to the fact that it doesn't leave behind so much as evidence of the opponents it has confronted, it is called the "{{NN|Guardian Emperor of Darkness}}". Its Special Moves are disabling all of the laws of physics in the surrounding region and bringing down the opponent ({{AT|Schwarz Lehrsatz|Deu: Black Theorem}}), and an attack fired from the eyes of the lion on its head ({{AT|Rot Kreuz|Deu: Red Cross}}). {{SameProfile|DRB|except for the following highlighted differences}} Disables the laws of physics in the area and brings down the opponent.{{DD|ra}} Fires an attack from the eyes of the lion on its head.{{DD|ra}}

name: Raiji Ludomon
raw_text: The evolved form of [[Tia Ludomon]], it has been further mechanised and attained the ability to fly. By sacrificing its agility, it gained durability that allows it to withstand even an attack from an Ultimate level head-on. The shields attached to its shoulders and arms automatically put up an electric barrier which cannot be seen, causing enemies to be confused as to why their attacks are not working. Not only that, it is also able to increase the area covered by its barrier in exchange for being unable to move, allowing it to protect entire regions to a certain extent.{{br}}Its Special Moves are generating electricity at high output from its head and using it to strike the enemy ({{AT|Lightning Buster}}), and firing its ({{AT|Rocket Messer|Deu: Rocket Knife}}) from both arms. A Perfect level Armor Digimon. Through mechanisation, it has gained the ability to fly, as well as erect a barrier over an area to protect it. Generates electricity at high output from its head and uses it to strike the enemy. Fires energy blades from the claws of both arms.{{ref|''[[Digimon New Century]]''}} Generates an invisible electrical barrier around itself and allies.{{ref|''[[Digimon New Century]]''}}

name: Raijinmon
raw_text: A Cyborg Digimon bestowed with the name of the {{w|Raijin}} of Oriental folklore. A fighting-type that is strong in close combat, its Signature Move is "{{AT|Blitz Arm}}", in which it dishes out a barrage of punches with the same lightning-type arm as [[Justimon]]. Its Special Move is charging with the connector on its tail, and firing intense lightning from its shoulders into its surroundings ({{AT|Elekugel|Deu: 'Electro-ball'}}). A Cyborg Digimon known as the {{NN|Thunderclap General}}. Its lightning, which is powerful enough to pierce the sky, conceals sufficient power worthy of the name "{{w|Raijin}}".
