name: Ranamon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Water which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Warrior Ten]]. It has a sharp intuition and an unstable mood, possibly because it had been in an area that was mostly active in a section of the ocean within a weather forecasting system. Its emotions are erratic; when it is in good mood, it shows off how graceful and {{w|lady}}-like it is, but when it gets upset, it cries hysterically like a baby. In battle, it rarely attacks directly, and mainly does so indirectly by manipulating rain. However, since its combat abilities are intense when it is emotionally overwrought, its attacks are especially uncontrollable while it is crying. Its Special Moves are concentrating heavy rain over an enemy and crushing them ({{AT|Rain Stream}}), and dissolving all enemies with {{w|acid rain}} ({{AT|Jealousy Rain}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}}  Concentrates heavy rain over an enemy and crushes them.{{DD|ra}} Dissolves all enemies with {{w|acid rain}}.{{DD|ra}} {{--}} Conjures and manipulates waterspouts to attack its foes.{{rfe|DF|15|''Cool Beast Evolution! Calamaramon''|b}}

name: Rapidmon (X-Antibody)
raw_text: A Holy Knight Digimon that Armor Evolved from [[Terriermon]] with the "[[Digimental of Fate]]". [[Rapidmon Perfect|Rapidmon]] is normally a Perfect which evolves from [[Galgomon]], but thanks to the "Digimental of Fate", it is able to shine gold and sublimate power up to the Ultimate Level. Its Special Moves are rapid-firing homing missiles from both of its arms and the revolver equipped to its back ({{AT|Rapid Fire}}), and "{{AT|Golden Triangle}}", which is similar in power level to [[Magnamon]]'s Special Move, "{{ATO|Extreme Jihad}}".{{xab|Rapidmon|Rapidmon Armor}}The power contained within the Digimental of Fate has been drawn out even further by the [[X-Antibody]], and it is now capable of constantly exhibiting power at the Ultimate Level. The armaments on both of its arms and back form the "{{EQ|Armed Arms}}"; it rapid-fires its "{{AT|Rapid Blaster}}", which has a low attenuation rate, at long-range, and its "{{AT|Laser Gatling Arm}}", where it switches from the {{EQ|Armed Arms}} on its back, at close-to-mid-range. In addition, a booster function has also been added, allowing it to dive into the enemy's chest at high speed, and slash them with its claws.{{br}}Its greatest Special Move is detaching all of the {{EQ|Armed Arms}}, cornering the enemy by operating them remotely, and shooting them up with a billion bullets ({{AT|Billion Bullet}}). While it excels in tactics such as hit-and-run and disrupting the battlefield, it still retains its temperamental personality and often makes blunders.

name: Raptordramon
raw_text:
Using a feral Digimon with predatory instincts as a base, modifications were made to allow it to reliably bring down its prey (targets), resulting in this Cyborg Digimon. Because it possesses too powerful an organic body and an uncontrollable ferocity, it was modified with [[Chrome Digizoid]] of considerable weight in order to restrain its mobility. However, its spontaneity and flight capabilities are still extraordinarily high, largely due to the organic body the feral Digimon possessed even before modification. Despite its small size, if it gradually releases those abilities, it has the capability to easily bring down even a massive Digimon in a single blow. Its Signature Move is a charging attack that capitalizes on the sharpness of its Chrome Digizoid armor ({{AT|Crash Charge}}). Its Special Move is leaping at the opponent and instantly biting and rending their vitals with its sharp teeth ({{AT|Ambush Crunch}}). name: Rasenmon
raw_text: Rasenmon's true form, which it attained after accepting its negative emotions without fearing them and regaining the courage it needed to believe in itself. raw_text: An Evil Dragon Digimon that plots to rule through rage and fear. name: Relemon
raw_text: A mysterious Digimon that is said to only be born on moonlit nights. name: Rhamphomon
raw_text: A Pterosaur Digimon with large, membranous wings. Possessing remarkable flight capabilities, Rhamphomon is able to seize even Digimon that are bigger than itself with both its feet while flying. It soars from the ground to the skies in one swoop, and spends most of the day in the air, circling around riding air currents. If it spots prey as it circles around, it will fold its wings, perform a nosedive, and swoop down on them. When it brings down its prey, it stuns them with its "{{AT|Crystal Cannon}}", in which it fires an ultrahigh-speed crystal cannonball from its mouth, or its "{{AT|Hammer Strike}}", in which it swings the crystal on the tip of its tail to strike them. After that, it finishes them off by slamming them into the ground with its "{{AT|No Hope Fall}}", where it seizes stunned prey with both its feet, soars, and then throws them down from high in the sky. Depending on the individual, there are some that use a derivative technique called "{{AT|Crystal Rain}}", wherein it fires its {{AT|Crystal Cannon}} twice in a row, causing the crystal cannonballs to collide in mid-flight and shatter, turning them into pellets. name: Rhino Kabuterimon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Thunder that has transcended legend by inheriting all the might of one of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]] and acquiring unknown abilities. It has such a gigantic body and a heavy shell that it could be mistaken for a Dinosaur. It has the ability to generate a special magnetic field with ultrahigh voltage electric current, and is able to freely manipulate it using its gigantic horn. Although rushing techniques are its specialty, it doesn't actually come into contact with the opponent, but instead tosses them away with that special magnetic field. Its Special Moves are dynamically wielding its horn and liberating all of the electricity accumulated within its body all at once, swallowing up the opponent in a lightning storm ({{AT|Condenser Storm}}), and firing all the electricity accumulated in its horn like a laser ({{AT|Thunder Laser}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Dynamically wields its horn and liberates all of the electricity accumulated within its body all at once, catching the opponent in a lightning storm. name: Rhinomon
raw_text: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Miracles]]". raw_text:

name: Scourge Chiropmon
raw_text: A Machine Digimon with an aircraft-like appearance. It is presumed to be a form that evolved by taking in the design data for a [[Real World|real-world]] stealth bomber. It has a habit of primarily operating at night, but because it has a body color that makes it hard to see at night, and an airframe shape that makes it difficult for various types of sensors such as radar to detect, it is difficult to catch glimpse of Scourge Chiropmon. As there have only been three sightings to date, it is a Digimon that is rarely encountered, but it is unclear whether it is a Digimon with a small population, or whether it has a large population simply because its high stealth makes it impossible to see. It deploys the "{{EQ|Clingy Brothers}}" sensor drones stored atop its wings, locks onto the target with "{{AT|Triangulation Scan}}", which Scourge Chiropmon and the two drones use to scan the target's coordinates with high precision, and then launches the smart guided missiles suspended beneath its wings for its most powerful attack technique, "{{AT|Despair Blast}}". Since these smart guided missiles set off {{w|Dust explosion|fuel-air explosions}}, they are capable of blowing up a vast area, including the target. In addition, it can also clear the ground with its "{{AT|Eliminate Rain}}", in which it carries out a carpet bombing using bat-shaped cluster bombs. While it is a Digimon that specializes in mass slaughter, it also has non-lethal techniques, and occasionally uses its "{{AT|Silent Scream}}", where it stuns the target by emitting high-power, ultra-short waves from its ears. There is a space resembling a cockpit in its head that can be entered, and although it seems to be capable of housing a Child-sized Digimon, no instances of Digimon being on board were confirmed in the past three sightings. name: Seiten Gokuwmon
raw_text: The end of a long journey in search of truth doctrines. What it acquired during that journey was a power that embodies unity.{{br}}Seiten Gokuwmon is a Tathāgata Digimon that evolved when [[Sanzomon]] used its sutras to elevate the bonds it had with [[Cho·Hakkaimon]] and [[Sagomon]]—whom it traveled alongside and grew up with—into a new power.{{br}}Although its inherently belligerent nature remains unchanged, it is no longer as arrogant as it used to be, and has grown into a warrior who combines combat instinct with composure.{{br}}Its spirit is not the only thing that has grown. The golden decorations on its back are "{{EQ|Kintoun|Somersault Cloud}}", which it transforms into a thundercloud to use. The "{{EQO|Nyoikinkobō|Will-Obeying Golden-Banded Staff}}", which it used regularly, has taken in the power of its companions and combined it with [[Gokuwmon]]'s abilities, which enhanced it into the "{{EQ|Nyoitenjinbō|Will-Obeying Divine Staff}}", a weapon capable of freely changing shape that harnesses three attributes—thunder, fire, and water.{{br}}Freely wielding sorcery and martial arts, it has become a powerful Digimon who is truly worthy of being called a mighty warrior.{{br}}While it is a Digimon of the strongest class, rivaling the guardians of the [[Digital World: Shambala|Eastern Digital World]], the [[Tentei Hachibushu]], it is a free being who is neither bound by destiny nor constraints, so [[Erlangmon]] has been keeping a close watch on its every move.{{br}}Its Special Moves are making its eyes glow with flame-like light, temporarily increasing its strength ({{AT|Kagan Kinsei|Fiery Eyes, Golden Pupils}}), sending out flames from the {{EQ|Nyoitenjinbō|Will-Obeying Divine Staff}} and striking while preserving their power ({{j2|{{AT|w=Zhu Bajie|Hakkai}} {{AT|Entengeki}}|Hakkai Fire and Sky Attack}}), and similarly, generating a violent whirlpool to engulf the opponent ({{j2|{{AT|w=Sha Wujing|Gojō}} {{AT|Suitensō}}|Gojō Water and Sky Funeral}}), and transforming the {{EQ|Nyoitenjinbō|Will-Obeying Divine Staff}} into a bazooka, concentrating lightning, and then firing it ({{AT|Chōtai Seirai Tenhō|Colossal Holy Thunder and Sky Cannon}}). After a long journey in search of the ultimate truth, it finally discovered the power of unity.{{br}}Seiten Gokuwmon is a Tathāgata-type Digimon that evolved by using the power of the sutras of [[Sanzomon]] to transform the deep bonds formed with [[Cho·Hakkaimon]] and [[Sagomon]] during their journey into a new power.{{br}}It still retains its combative nature, but is no longer as reckless as it used to be. It has grown into a warrior who combines fighting instincts with a cool head.{{br}}Seiten Gokuwmon has matured not just spiritually. The golden decorations on its back can transform into the "{{EQ|Jīndǒuyún|Somersault Cloud}}" that it can ride. name: Shagaramon
raw_text: A Holy Dragon Digimon that resides in [[Ryushogu]], an oceanic area in the [[Digital World: Shambala|Eastern Digital World]] where beautiful crystals grow. Using the cloth wrapped around its body and its ability to manipulate seawater, it is able to create ocean current gates that can transport anyone anywhere, and it is impossible to reach the secluded region of Ryushogu without riding the ocean currents generated by Shagaramon.{{br}}Since it has the duty of banishing any Digimon that disturbs the peace in Ryushogu upon arriving there, Shagaramon has been entrusted as the gatekeeper of Ryushogu by [[Ryugumon]]. The Digimon responsible for gatekeeping alongside it are [[Hangyomon]] and [[Mermaimon]], and Shagaramon has the additional role of supervising the other gatekeepers.{{br}}It also has the ability to fly in the air, and can occasionally be seen soaring gracefully through the skies above Ryushogu's waters.{{br}}Its Special Moves are creating a huge wave-like fan and hurling it at the opponent ({{AT|Rōtō Sen|Wave Fan}}), and detonating small spheres of compressed seawater ({{AT|Kankai Sakusōjin|Salt Sea Explosive Blue Formation}}). Finally, its "{{AT|Sōten Ryūjinga|Azure Dragon God Fang}}" devours the opponent with a dragon made from seawater. name: Shakomon
raw_text:
A Digimon shaped like a {{w|bivalve}} covered by a hard shell. Because its shell developed rapidly, its inner structure has become slime-shaped like that of a [[Baby]]. name: Shin Monzaemon
raw_text: A Puppet Digimon that evolved as a result of [[Monzaemon]] taking in nightmare-related analysis data. At first glance, it is shaped like a teddy bear, but it is actually a fluffy, amorphous Digimon with a mysterious nature, like a cross between slime and clouds. It is a moody Digimon that has a childish personality and does not act intelligently. It has a habit of liking and taking in simple and cute things, and chooses immature Digimon that are Child-level and below as its targets. On the other hand, since it considers Digimon that have gotten more mature to be "repulsive beings with impurities mixed in with their data", it hates even getting close to them. When it feeds, it extends its soft wings to envelop its targets. Because its whole body is made up of powerful energy, weak Digimon are said to completely lose consciousness just by touching it.{{br}}Its Special Moves are sending countless parts of its body flying to steal the opponent's consciousness ({{AT|Nightmare Rain}}), changing the shape of its right arm into a hammer and smashing the opponent with it ({{AT|Fancy Fantasista}}), and piercing the opponent's [[Digicore]] with a laser fired from its left eye ({{AT|Sweet Lovely Attack}}). [[Monzaemon]] took in nightmare-related analysis data and evolved, becoming an Ultimate Digimon. It has a childish personality, so it is quite a moody Digimon! Sends countless parts of its body flying to steal the opponent's consciousness. Changes the shape of its right arm into a hammer and smashes the opponent with it. Pierces the opponent's [[Digicore]] with a laser fired from its left eye.

name: Shivamon
raw_text: Fires unparalleled, orb-shaped light energy from its palms. Hurls the rings on its arms, which change shape at will, and blows the enemy away. A rainbow-colored barrier it covers itself with in its yoga poses that does not let most attacks pass through; it can only be penetrated by those who have acquired strength through the power of yoga, like Shivamon.

name: Shoemon
raw_text: A Puppet Digimon that wears the leather of shoes and the skin of plush toys. If someone tries to touch it, it will jump quickly and immediately flee. Due to its timid nature, it can acutely sense vibrations in the floor or ground it is in contact with, and quickly detect the presence of invading enemies. The sole of its shoe has a very strong grip, allowing it to move smoothly over any rough road, and climb even vertical walls and pillars with ease as well. Since it prefers cleanliness, it dislikes walking in sandy areas or on muddy roads.{{br}}Sweet fruits are its favorite food, and when the sole of its shoe opens like jaws, it heartily bites into and eats fruits along with their tough skins.{{br}}Its Special Moves are a two-step attack where it jumps high while detaching the sole of its shoe from its main body ({{AT|Wonder Stomp}}), and stitching the opponent up with a large amount of sewing needles it spits out of its mouth, preventing them from moving ({{AT|Petit Needle}}). These sewing needles, with the thread attached, are also used when traveling to distant locations. Jumps up high while detaching the sole of its shoe from its main body. Stitches the opponent up with a large amount of sewing needles it spits out of its mouth, preventing them from moving.

name: Shoeshoemon
raw_text: Presses down on the rapidly-spinning tires of its roller skates. Throws an acorn-shaped bomb taken out of the zipper on its abdomen that causes a large amount of acorns to fly off along with an explosion, dealing damage over a vast area.

name: Shonitamon
raw_text: The "{{FM|Armed-reconnaissance Mode|Kyoukouteisatsu Keitai}}" born from two Digimon's overflowing curiosity. It specializes in methods of concealing its appearance, freely uses {{w|ninjutsu}} to penetrate enemy territory, and can transmit the enemy info it has accumulated to its allies with [[Monitamon]]'s "{{EQO|Information Sharing}}" ability, and is able to withdraw whenever it likes without being noticed...however, although it has this potential, for some mysterious and specific reason, it is never seen exhibiting this ability. Because its curiosity easily gets the best of it, it frequently sneaks into areas differing from its objective, and performs the wrong armed reconnaissance against its better judgment. In particular, there are many eyewitness reports of it at hot springs or pools. It insists that it is a "scout", not a "voyeur".  {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{--}} {{--}}

raw_text: Shoots balls from its cannon at speeds exceeding 300 km/h. Charges into the enemy by utilizing its elastic, spring-like legs. Turns anything it touches into a ball without wasting its breath. Digimon who suffer this technique are mercilessly shot out of its cannon.

name: Shortmon
raw_text: Pierces the enemy with a large fork. Shoots the strawberry on its head.

name: Shoutmon
raw_text: A ferocious Digimon with extremely high aggressiveness due to its hot-blooded enthusiasm. However, it is friendly towards its comrades, and its friendship with other Digimon, surpassing species, can be deepened even further if they are recognized by Shoutmon.{{br}}There is a unique feature to Shoutmon's singing that converts its passion to energy, and it can perform an attack called "{{AT|Soul Crusher}}", which uses its mic to amplify the heated emotions blazing within its chest, then bash the opponent. Because passion is the very source of the attack, it will definitely inflict damage no matter the target, and since Shoutmon won't give up fighting unless its passion disappears, this is the reason Shoutmon is said to be a ferocious Digimon with high aggressiveness.{{br}}On one hand it seems ferocious, but on the other it is said to love music and songs, and it likes to hum songs with natural sounding {{w|background music}} like the sound of the wind, raindrops, the murmuring of a river, or the stirring of leaves on a tree. Therefore, you should never play a practical joke like hiding the mic. Incidentally, its "{{AT|Rowdy Rocker}}" lets it wield the mic as in {{w|bōjutsu}}, so it is excellent not only in scuffling matches but also in performances. {{SameProfile|DRB|except with the exclusion of paragraphs}} ''{{fc|It aims at becoming Digimon King with its heated rock spirit!|#B3901A}}''{{br}}A ferocious Digimon with extremely high aggressiveness due to its hot-blooded enthusiasm. Although it normally has a mild, kind, and friendly personality, once it gets into battle, it has a complete about-face to a warrior burning with fury. It becomes both cool and audacious enough for battles to get violent, and that appearance is fitting to the name of "{{FM|Crusade Mode|Kuruseido Keitai}}", as it seems to be one who acts as an agent of divine punishment.{{br}}The "{{EQ|Electric Buster Xros}}" bayonets equipped to its right arm demonstrate their power in both gun and sword attacks, and the gigantic "{{EQ|Trident}} {{EQ|w=Jazz-funk|JusFang}}" claws on its left arm not only release a powerful blow, but also use that sturdiness to function as a shield.{{br}}"{{AT|Brave Beat Rock Double Xros}}" is Shoutmon DX's Final Move. Omega Shoutmon's and Zeke Greymon's flames become one, clothing its body with the hellfire that purifies all corruption. Its appearance when it becomes an incarnation of flame and assaults the opponent looks like a meteor, and completely vaporizes all of the opponents. {{SameProfile|DRB}} ''{{fc|The DigiXros of Omega Shoutmon and Zeke Greymon!|#B3901A}}''{{br}}The "{{FM|Crusade Mode|Kuruseido Keitai}}", born when [[Omega Shoutmon]], who boasts the swiftest speed, obtained the fighting strength of [[Zeke Greymon]], who boasts unparalleled power. name: Shoutmon X4S
raw_text: The "{{FM|Weapons-fighter Mode|Busoutoushi Keitai}}" which [[DigiXros|digixrosed]] [[Spadamon]] with [[Shoutmon X4]]. By equipping the weapon that Spadamon transforms into, it can now use various sword techniques.{{br}}It fends off the opponent with "{{AT|Blaze Fire}}", bullets fired from its head, and fights with techniques such as "{{AT|Xros}} {{AT|w=RnB|Red & Blue}}", a slash attack unleashed from the weapons in both its hands. Its Special Move is covering the weaponized Spadamon in a blade aura and cutting the opponent to pieces ({{AT|Victory Brave}}).  The "{{FM|Weapons-fighter Mode|Busoutoushi Keitai}}" in which the [[Weapon Digimon]] [[Spadamon]] became a powerful weapon and joined with the "{{FMO|l=Shoutmon X4|Victory Mode|Vikutorī Keitai}}" which incarnated from four Digimon. Spadamon trusts in the comrade that it accepted as its master and changed its shape.{{br}}Shoutmon X4 has dramatically empowered its figure by equipping a weapon that, "if held by an angel will save the world, and if held by a demon will destroy the world," so it races across the battlefield using a dual-wielding combat style in which it freely manipulates its two weapons to mow down its enemies and seize victory. The source of its power is its single-minded, passionate desire that it "wants to defend someone," and it is a courageous fighter who demonstrates its maximum power when it fights to defend someone.{{br}}Its Special Move is extending an immense, dazzling-blue blade of light from the weaponized Spadamon's armament in its left hand, cutting everything to "{{w|V}}"-shaped pieces ({{AT|Victory Brave}}). It is told that when this blade is swung at its maximum power, it is able to cut a single [[Zone (Xros Wars)|Zone]] to pieces. Its "{{j2|{{AT|Xros}} {{AT|w=RnB|R & B}}|Xros Red and Blue}}" consists of it flinging a huge, red and blue "{{w|X}}"-shaped shock wave generated by swinging down its two weapons cross-wise, destroying the enemy lines with a storm-wave of energy. When this technique is invoked, it is necessary to cross the weapons with exact timing, and you can definitely say that it is a technique that can only be performed once it has reached understanding with the Weapon Digimon. Also, the firing of the {{w|M167 VADS|vulcan}}s on its head was sublimated into a Special Move due to Spadamon's power, and this "{{AT|Blaze Fire}}" has the power to inflict paralysis and neutralize the abilities of the enemies it hits, so it has obtained an ability greater than being armed to compensate for the weakness of having both its hands occupied with weapons. Fends off the opponent by firing bullets from the vulcans on its head.{{DD|sa|shoutmonx4s}} A slash attack with the weapons in both hands.{{DD|sa|shoutmonx4s}} Covers the weapon form of Spadamon in a glowing aura and cuts the opponent to pieces.{{DD|sa|shoutmonx4s}}

name: Shoutmon X5S
raw_text: The "{{FM|Cosmic-fighter Mode|Uchūtoushi Keitai}}" in which [[Shoutmon X5]] [[digixros]]ed with the weaponized [[Spadamon]]. It possesses both powerful sword techniques and high flying ability.{{br|i}}By utilizing cosmic energy, it has acquired techniques called "{{AT|Space Chakram}}", in which it launches a ring-shaped blade of light, and "{{AT|Helio Slasher}}", where it clads the {{EQ|l=Star Sword DX|Star Sword}} in scorching heat like that of the sun, and slashes the enemy. Its Special Move is concentrating cosmic energy within Spadamon's blade and attacking ({{AT|Cosmo Victory}}). The "{{FM|Cosmic-fighter Mode|Uchūtoushi Keitai}}" in which the [[Weapon Digimon]] [[Spadamon]] joined with and granted further power to the "{{FMO|l=Shoutmon X5|Finalist Mode|Fainarisuto Keitai}}" which was born when the hearts of five Digimon came together. Spadamon trusts in the comrade that it accepted as its master and changed its shape.{{br}}Shoutmon X5 has empowered itself to transcendence by means of a weapon which conceals power that, "if held by an angel will save the world, and if held by a demon will destroy the world." In particular, the flying ability possessed by the "{{FMO|Finalist Mode|Fainarisuto Keitai}}" increased in power dramatically, obtaining tremendous propulsive power and endowing it with the supreme flying ability to fly out past the distant {{w|stratosphere}} and up to space. It also awakened to the ability to absorb cosmic energy directly into its body by advancing into space, and acquired the power to freely manipulate the absorbed energy as techniques of marvelous power. Here the cosmic-fighter filled with cosmic energy was born, soaring through space at hyper-speed.{{br}}Its Special Move is the bold move "{{AT|Cosmo Victory}}" that exploits its supreme flying ability to its maximum. By flying at hyper-speed from the ground, it breaks through the stratosphere and reaches the void of space, then concentrates the explosive power it acquired gathering cosmic energy within its entire body, and all of the frictional force and heat that it acquired plunging through the atmosphere to return to the ground, within the Weapon Digimon, and puts it into a single blow that it fires at the opponent as destructive power. There will probably be consequences to opponents that suffer this technique, and there will also probably be consequences to the area surrounding where an opponent suffered this technique. For its "{{AT|Helio Slasher}}", after injecting solar energy to enhance the power of the {{EQ|l=Star Sword DX|Star Sword}}'s flames to their maximum, and cladding itself in scorching heat equaling that of the sun, it soars toward the opponent with its supreme flying ability, then cuts them to pieces while burning them to cinders with a single brandish in which it placed tremendous energy. When Shoutmon X5S commences {{AT|Helio Slasher}}, the radiance of the blazing {{EQ|Star Sword}} extends a tail at the speed of its flight, and it looks like a burning comet soaring through space. Also, it can launch a ring-shaped vacuum blade to cut the opponent to pieces ({{AT|Space Chakram}}), and because it is imbued with not only a sharpened cutting ability, but also the strength of the wave, possessed by Spadamon, that paralyzes the opponent and neutralizes their abilities, it has acquired more utility and advantage by firing off the technique than as a mere projectile, and has expanded the breadth of its strategies. Launches a ring-shaped blade of light that can paralyze the opponent and neutralize their abilities.{{DD|sa|shoutmonx5s}}{{DL|oJJ6eZJpL3k%3D}} Clads the {{EQ|Star Sword}} and itself in scorching solar heat and slashes the enemy.{{DD|sa|shoutmonx5s}}{{DL|oJJ6eZJpL3k%3D}} Concentrates cosmic energy within Spadamon's blade and attacks.{{DD|sa|shoutmonx5s}}

name: Shroudmon
raw_text: A Demon Man Digimon that evolved when a certain Digimon tempered its body beyond its limit during unimaginable training. As a result of it just fighting repeatedly like an {{w|Asura}}, it came to be known as the "{{NN|Fierce God}}". Its mind is already broken, and it has even forgotten the reason why it sought strength. It is a genuine combat enthusiast who loves fist fighting, and forces its defeated opponents to get back up.{{br}}Its Special Moves are using its iron fists, shrouded in an ominous aura, to dish out a combo attack too quick for the eye to see ({{AT|Kishungouken|Oni Instantaneous Roaring Fist}}), and reducing its surroundings to ashes with a {{w|roundhouse kick}} covered in flames ({{AT|Gokuen Hakaishū|Hellfire Destructive Turning Kick}}). Its "{{AT|Garaien Saiha|Devouring Thunder and Fire Breaker}}", in which it fires black flaming energy shots from its held-out palms, boasts the single greatest firepower generated by a Digimon. {{SameProfile|DRB|except for different paragraphing}}  Uses its iron fists, shrouded in an ominous aura, to dish out a combo attack too quick for the eye to see. Reduces its surroundings to ashes with a {{w|roundhouse kick}} covered in flames. Fires black flaming energy shots from its held-out palms, which boasts the single greatest firepower generated by a Digimon.

name: Shurimon
raw_text:
An Armor-level Mutation Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Purity]]". The "Digimental of Purity" has the attribute of "Plant", and those that don this Digimental have the ability to blend in with nature, conceal themselves within the wind like leaves fluttering, and land precise attacks by emerging from the enemy's blind spots. It can be said that its appearance is definitely that of a ninja. Its Signature Move is spinning the shurikens at the tips of its extendable limbs to attack the enemy ({{AT|Momiji Oroshi}}). name: Shutumon
raw_text: A Digimon that possesses power over Wind which bears the might of one of the legendary [[Ten Warriors]]. At a glance, it looks like a composed adult woman, but although it perplexes its opponents with its languid behavior, it actually has an impish personality that loves to capriciously embarrass people. It does things like purposefully telling its opponent unhappy fortunes or startling them. In battle, it seldom takes the initiative and helps out, but although you don't see its efforts, it will sometimes risk the possibility of getting into trouble. Once it feels so inclined, it glides freely through the sky, manipulating the wind and knocking out the opponent with a secret {{w|Mesopotamia}}n spell. Its Special Moves are cutting the opponent and the atmosphere around it to pieces with the claws on its hands and feet ({{AT|Gilgamesh Slicer}}), and flying up into the air and hurling the feathers of its hair and wings as pointed arrows ({{AT|Wind of Pain}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Cuts the opponent and the atmosphere around it to pieces with the claws on its hands and feet.{{DD|sa}} Flies up into the air and hurls the feathers of its hair and wings as pointed arrows.{{DD|sa}} Hits the foe with a powerful hook.{{ref|''[[Battle Spirit: Digimon Frontier]]''}} A joint attack between Shutumon and [[Agnimon]]. Agnimon charges into a tornado created by Shutumon, and unleashes its squalling fist of fire.{{rfc|St|752}}

raw_text: A Beast Man Digimon which [[Jogress]]-evolved from [[Aquilamon]] and [[Tailmon]]. It possesses tenacious leg strength, and its leaping power is said to reach great heights. Also, it is able to fly about by spreading both of its arms and soaring like a {{w|glider (aircraft)|glider}} after leaping high into the sky. Because it processes the information detected by the radar on its ears as images, and transmits it to the {{w|head-mounted display}} equipped to its head, it is able to accurately find the opponent regardless of day and night. Its Special Moves are firing off energy shots while extending both of its arms ahead of itself ({{AT|Top Gun}}), and gliding at super-speed from the sky above to crash a shock wave into the opponent ({{AT|Dual Sonic}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{S2Ep|ZT|31|e=Love Storm: Silphymon}} Fires off energy shots while extending both of its arms ahead of itself. Glides at super-speed from the sky above to crash a shock wave into the opponent. Creates a tornado and sends it against the opponent.

name: Sinduramon
raw_text:
One of the "[[Deva]] Digimon", it is a Perfect Digimon with a form resembling the {{w|Rooster (zodiac)|Rooster}}. As a follower of the [[Four Holy Beasts]] Digimon [[Baihumon]], it likes to quarrel and gossip above all else. With its provocative attitude, it will pick a fight with its opponent one way or another, but when they move to attack, it immediately draws its head and wings within its spherical armor. Its armor is the hardest among all of the Deva's equipment, and once it gets inside of the armor, it is absolutely protected. During battle, it is occasionally possible to cut through the breach when it rolls around in that state. Just like [[Kumbhiramon]], it carries the {{EQ|Bǎo Chǔ|Treasure Pestle}} on its back, and its Special Move consists of unleashing an intense lightning strike from it ({{w|Naraka (Hinduism)|{{AT|Púyaváha}}}}).''[http://www.sacred-texts.com/hin/vp/vp064.htm Internet Sacred Text Archive]'', retrieved 08/31/07; Vishnu Purana, Ch. Perfect level.{{S2Ep|DT|16|e=Protect the Light of the Town! Dangerous Camp of the Digimon}} {{--}} Unleashes an intense lightning strike from its Bǎo Chǔ.

name: Sirenmon
raw_text: A God Man Digimon which has an outward appearance like a blending of bird and fish. Its personality is cheerful, and it is always singing pleasant songs throughout the skies and seas. Its voice has a miraculously sweet sound and actually has an eight {{w|octave}} range from very high notes to very low notes, and it brings tranquility even to devastated battlefields with its singing voice. It is said that by healing its listeners and performing good deeds, it will continue on to a shining evolution. The notes of its ''{{w|Symphony No. 1|{{AT|Dai'ikkyoku|No.1 (''Polyphony'')}}}} {{w|Polyphony|{{AT|(''Polyphony'')|No.1 (''Polyphony'')}}}}'', sung in a high {{w|soprano}}, suffuse the listener's heart and numbs their free will, leaving them at Sirenmon's mercy. Its solemn ''{{w|Symphony No. 2|{{AT|Dainikyoku|No.2 (''Aria'')}}}} {{w|Aria|{{AT|(''Aria'')|No.2 (''Aria'')}}}}'', sung in a low {{w|bass (voice type)|bass}}, becomes a deep bass frequency wave which flattens the enemy through their {{w|semicircular canals}}, so that they are unable to even stand. ''{{w|Symphony No. 3|{{AT|Daisankyoku|No.3 (''Canon'')}}}} {{w|Canon (music)|{{AT|(''Canon'')|No.3 (''Canon'')}}}}'', a technique which attacks the enemy using its singing voice as note-shaped shots. The notes it hits are said to have the marvellous trait of ricocheting to always strike their targets, even separate enemies. name: Siriusmon
raw_text: An Ultimate-level Light Dragon Digimon that is affiliated with the group of justice, the [[:Category:Virus Busters|Virus Busters]]. Whenever it senses a voice crying for help or malice, even from far away, it will descend like a comet and bring down the enemy with the "{{EQ|w=87 Sylvia|Sylvia}}" composite cannon-blades equipped to both its arms. However, it is a kind-hearted being who brightens up everything around it such that if it senses a change of heart in its opponent during battle, it will lay down its arms and open up to them.{{br}}Its Special Moves are firing light beam shots from the {{EQ|Sylvia}} ({{AT|Photon Blaster}}), and a blade of order with which, using its blade deployed in the forward position, it bisects the enemy ({{AT|Cosmo Blade}}). In addition, it is said that the white flash from its "{{AT|Brea}}{{AT|w=quasar}}"—in which it slings a slash of starlight contained within its blade, as if chasing after the "{{AT|Photon Blaster}}" that it fired, causing the combined shot of light and slash to explode in range of the enemy—looks like a meteor from remote areas. Also, even if the {{EQ|Sylvia}} get destroyed, it has a trump card up its sleeve, "{{AT|Planet Knuckle}}", in which it packs its fists with life energy. A Light Dragon Digimon. Its Special Moves are firing light beam shots from the "{{EQ|w=87 Sylvia|Sylvia}}" ({{AT|Photon Blaster}}), and a blade of order that bisects the enemy with its edge extended forward ({{AT|Cosmo Blade}}). name: Sistermon Blanc
raw_text: A girl-shaped Digimon that looks like it's wearing a white rabbit, and whose elder sister is [[Sistermon Noir]]. In contrast to its elder sister Noir, it is slightly introverted, and it almost always hides behind its elder sister. It is caring for [[Hackmon]] just like its elder sister, and also acts as its escort. Although it is trying to diligently carry out [[Gankoomon]]'s request and assist in training with Hackmon, it frequently ends up reining in its elder sister's violent manner. In order to repay Gankoomon for saving it and its elder sister, it puts all of its effort into being a chaperone for Hackmon. The triple-pronged "{{w|Arrow Cross|{{EQ|Cross Barbée}}}}" lance that it carries as a weapon has both the offensive side of its "{{AT|Divine Pierce}}", which pierces the opponent, and the defensive side that guards itself using the "{{AT|Protect Wave}}" that it generates by stabbing the butt end into the ground. Furthermore, it has "{{AT|Grand Sister Cruz|Esp: ''Grand Sister Cross''}}", a coordinated technique with its elder sister. raw_text: Another form of [[Sistermon Blanc]]. The {{w|Stigmata|Holy Stigma}} appears at the center of the {{w|wimple}} on its head, and it awakens. name: Sistermon Ciel
raw_text: A Digimon wearing a veil modeled after a mouse, it is [[Sistermon Blanc]]'s elder sister as well as the twin sister of [[Sistermon Noir|Noir]]. Instead of traveling together with Noir and Blanc, it roams around the Digital World investigating unusual phenomena and reports its findings to [[Gankoomon]]. Despite its gentle personality, it is strong-willed and popular with the Digimon residing in the places it visits. While it is friendly and leads a peaceful life by day, by night it turns into an assassin who hunts down any troublemakers it receives word of. It has a cherished sword named {{EQ|Shirotsume-Ichimonji|White Clover Line}}, and its Signature Move is cutting down the enemy without making a sound ({{AT|Shirotsume-Ichimonji-giri|White Clover Horizontal Slash}}). Not only that, it also utilizes various assassination techniques such as rapid-throwing the two knives it hides within its sleeves ({{AT|Byakusai|White Murder}}), and luring the enemy in until they let their guard down, then stabbing them in their vitals at close range using the knives planted on its feet ({{AT|Tohhou|Piercing Wasp}}). Its calm and gentle demeanor  belies an unparallel mental fortitude, making it a favourite among the other Digimon that happen to meet it. name: Skadimon
raw_text: Summons a gigantic snow hand to beat down the enemy. Launches a large quantity of snowman-shaped missiles while skating. Breaks the globe on its head to engulf the opponent in an avalanche that releases a huge amount of snow.

name: Skull Baluchimon
raw_text: A gigantic Undead Digimon reproduced from the data of several counterfeit fossils, which were in the data of a fossil of what was thought to be the largest land mammal. It has no emotions or intelligence, and because its body operates by reflex with only the data of the nerves laid out within its body, it keeps mercilessly attacking until it can no longer move. It is said that it will plunge any Digimon into the terror of death, either from the curse which forcibly revived it from the data of its corpse, or the cold black vapors which flow unceasingly from its [[Digicore]]. Its Special Moves are trampling the opponent with its gigantic feet, burying them underground ({{AT|Grave Bone}}), and imprisoning the opponent in the space within its cold black vapors, then chasing them eternally until they die ({{AT|Deadly Fear}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} An Undead Digimon. However, its wickedness was refined even more, so that its dark powers are unfathomable. Its [[Digicore]], concentrated with mighty powers of darkness, is the characteristic of Demon-species Digimon called the "Darkcore". Its Special Move "{{AT|Nail Bone}}" is a terrifying technique which fires a powerful light from the jewel at the end of its staff, which disrupts and obliterates the opponent's data. {{SameProfile|DRB}} '''Skull Satamon'''
An Undead Digimon. It is the mere shadow of what was once a Fallen Angel Digimon that pursued strength and destructive power. Its Special Move is "{{AT|Nail Bone}}".{{S2Ep|ZT|43|e=Invasion of the Demon Army}} '''Skull Satamon'''
The Fallen Angel Digimon that pursued strength and destruction is a fallen figure. It is a subordinate of the [[Royal Knights (Frontier)|Royal Knights]] that acquired dark power with the "Darkcore", a [[Digicore|computer kernel]] filled with mighty power, in its hand. {{S2Ep|DF|43|e=Annihilation of the Hometown! Skull Satamon, the Messenger from Hell}} Fires a powerful light from the jewel at the end of its staff to disrupt and obliterate the opponent's data. {{--}}

name: Skull Seadramon
raw_text: An Undead [[Seadramon]] that swims on through the [[Net Ocean]] in search of Digimon prey, surviving on instinct alone despite lacking flesh. As a result of it being reduced to nothing but bones, it has decreased resistance, allowing it to pursue its prey to the ends of the earth with high-speed movements. Once it captures the enemy, it slowly chokes the life out of them with its "{{AT|Dead Roll}}", where it uses its long body to constrict them.{{br}}Its Special Move is firing a stinging lightning strike from the blade on its {{w|calvaria}} ({{AT|Thunder Javelin}}). The more it charges this technique, the more powerful it becomes. Bully of the Deep Sea{{br}}A Digimon that boasts the largest build among the "[[Titans]]".{{br}}With a ferocious nature that even its allies cannot control, it ravages the ocean depths. Bully of the Deep Sea{{br}}A Perfect [[Seadramon-species]] Digimon that boasts the largest build among the [[Titans]]. With a ferocious nature that even its allies cannot control, it ravages the ocean depths. Fires a stinging lightning strike from the blade on its calvaria. Constricts the enemy with its long body.

name: Slash Angemon
raw_text: A Power Digimon that commands the [[Angel Army|Powers]] and cuts through the vanguard in battle. As it persists in justice, it does not fear death. Along with the blades of its metal wings and hands, its entire body has gained a razor-sharp appearance, and it is surely an Angel Warrior created in order to battle wicked beings. Its Signature Move is "{{AT|Holy Espada|Esp: "Holy Sword"}}". Its Special Move is charging at the opponent with staggering momentum, cutting them to pieces with the blades covering its body ({{AT|Heaven's Ripper}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} Slashes the opponent with a cross-shaped energy blast. Charges at the opponent with staggering momentum, cutting them to pieces with the blades covering its body.

name: Slayerdramon
raw_text: A Dragon Man Digimon whose body is clad in [[Chrome Digizoid]] {{w|scale armour}}. It is said that its form is one that can only be attained by those who complete the training that is called the "Trial of the [[Four Great Dragons]]", which can only be challenged by Dragon Digimon. It carries the extensible greatsword "{{EQ|w=Fragarach|Fragarach}}", and has mastered its original ultimate fencing technique, {{EQ|"Ryūzanken"|Dragon Slashing Sword}}. There are three forms within Ryūzanken, from the first to the third, and the first form, "{{AT|Tenryūzanha|Heavenly Dragon Slash Ripper}}", is driving its sword, accelerated with a spin of its body, vertically through the opponent's skull, cutting them in half. The second form, "{{AT|Shouryūzanpa|Rising Dragon Slash Wave}}", is releasing a dragon wave refined by its sword and directed from the bottom part to the top, slaying the opponent just from the sword's pressure. The third form, "{{AT|Kouryūzanba|Biting Dragon Slash Blade}}", is stepping up close to the opponent and curling Fragarach around them, shaving off their whole body with the entwined sword blade. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Drives its sword, accelerated with a spin of its body, vertically through the opponent's skull, cutting them in half.{{DD|a}} Releases a dragon wave refined by its sword directed from the bottom part to the top, slaying the opponent just from the sword's pressure.{{DD|a}} Steps up close to the opponent and curls {{EQ|w=Fragarach|Fragarach}} around them, shaving off their whole body with the entwined sword blade.{{DD|a}}

name: Sleipmon
raw_text: A Holy Knight Digimon which is one of the Digital World's guardians, the "[[Royal Knights]]". While most of the Royal Knights are Human Digimon, it has a bestial silhouette which could be called bizarre. Its whole body is clad in an armor of the "[[Red Digizoid]]" which boasts great defensive power, so even Ultimate Digimon are unlikely to be able to easily damage Sleipmon. Its six legs possess unsurpassed mobility, and it is capable of instantaneous, high-speed movements that its thick build would not suggest. Sleipmon acts as a guardian of the super-ancient ruins which sleep below the thick ice of the Digital World's north pole, since it is said that essential program data which concerns the creation of Digimon is sealed within these ruins. Its Special Moves are incandescent arrows of light fired from the sacred crossbow {{w|Múspellsheimr|{{EQ|Múspellsheimr}}}} held in its left hand ({{w|Bifröst|{{AT|Bifröst}}}}), and using the sacred shield {{w|Niflheimr|{{EQ|Niflheimr}}}} in its right hand to lower the temperature of its climate and generate a blizzard ({{w|Odin|{{AT|Odin's}}}} {{AT|Breath}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{S2Ep|DS|41|e=Fists Prove it! Thoughts of my Father}} Fires incandescent arrows of light from the sacred crossbow {{EQ|Muspellsheimr}}.{{DD|sa}} Uses the sacred shield {{EQ|Niflheimr}} to lower surrounding temperatures and generate a blizzard.{{DD|sa}} Jumps high into the air and kicks the opponent with its hooves.<ref name=DSAM>''[[Digimon Savers: Another Mission]]''</ref> {{--}}

raw_text: A [[Goburimon]] that was brought up in a cold country of snow. Since it wears a warm hat and vest, the cold doesn't bother it in the slightest. name: Soloogarmon
raw_text: A Digimon that succeeded in controlling the sinister magic data of the mythical {{w|warg}}, which slept within the deepest parts of its [[Digicore]]. Program code written in a special language lines the inside of the armor that covers its whole body, suppressing its enormous amount of magical power, which is transformed into raging magical flames, as if it were sealed magic. Soloogarmon is able to freely manipulate the magical flames by modifying the program code, and these manipulated flames can be utilized for all kinds of actions, such as attacking, moving, and posture control. It can produce a focused, ultra-high-temperature magical flame called "{{AT|Prominence Laser}}" from the index and middle fingers of both its hands, and despite being a flame, it can shoot through distant enemies as if it were a laser beam. Its Special Move is making the magical flame of the "{{EQ|w=Fenrir|Vánagandr}}", the mace in its right hand, burn at its highest temperature, forming a blade and slashing with it ({{AT|Eruption Howling}}). It is said that when the ultra-high-temperature flame blade chafes against the air, it makes a sound like the howling of a wolf. In addition, it also uses "{{AT|w=Sköll}} {{AT|Rage}}", an attack where it uses the thrust of the magical flames spurting from both its shoulders to move at high speed, and then hurl the {{EQ|Vánagandr}} at the opponent. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Produces a focused, ultra-high-temperature magical flame from the index and middle fingers of both its hands, and uses it to shoot through distant enemies.{{DD|sa}} Makes the magical flame of its mace, {{EQ|w=Fenrir|Vánagandr}}, burn at its highest temperature, forming a blade and slashing with it.{{DD|sa}} Uses the thrust of the magical flames spurting from both its shoulders to move at high speed, and then hurl the {{EQ|Vánagandr}} at the opponent.{{DD|sa}}

name: Soulmon
raw_text: A Ghost Digimon constructed from a cursed virus program. As it was a [[Bakemon]] that took in data of mages that appear in fantasy stories, the black hat it wears raises its magical power. Because of that, its attacks that make use of curses or magic are tremendously powerful. Its Special Move is releasing the souls of the dead upon the enemy ({{AT|Necro Magic}}). A subspecies of [[Bakemon]]. A cursed Digimon, it is said to have wandered from the abyss of the [[Dark Side]]. It wears a hat large enough to conceal its face over the cloth shrouding its whole body. Releases the souls of the dead upon the enemy as a stream of glowing particles, a swarm of bats, darkness, or a monstrous ghostly hand. Drops a huge skull on the opponent. Drains the enemy's energy by striking them or inhaling. Extends a giant decaying hand from underneath its cloak to attack the enemy.   Karate chops the enemy.

raw_text: A Bird Digimon characterized by its speaker built-in wings. name: Spadamon
raw_text: One of the legendary "[[Legend-Arms]]" who, according to legend, "if held by an angel will save the world, and if held by a demon will destroy the world", it is a Weapon Digimon that transforms itself into a weapon. Although its personality is earnest and serious, it has a side that is weak to pressure. Its combat abilities are low, but it shows its true merit once it becomes a weapon. A survivor of the "[[Weapon Digimon]]", who carry out transformations into giant, peerless weapons based on the master they choose, and which according to legend, "if held by an angel will save the world, and if held by a demon will destroy the world." It is the last, and the strongest, of the Weapon Digimon in the [[LS-tou Zone]].{{br}}Since the LS-tou Zone kept being exposed to aggression from invaders, Spadamon was used as a trump card to pull them back from the edge of defeat, and it was released in a different [[Zone (Xros Wars)|Zone]] once its abilities were sealed along with its memories by its Weapon Digimon comrades...it seems. Because its memories surrounding the seal have also vanished, it does not remember the exact details of where its memories are hidden and how to recover its abilities. After Spadamon escaped, the Zone was occupied by the invading army, and all of the Weapon Digimon but Spadamon were defeated and went into stasis. Spadamon, who returned to the LS-tou Zone secretly, cannot currently remember how to recover its own true strength, but will fight against the invading force.{{br}}Although its personality is to be earnest and serious, it is weak to pressure and ad-libbing due to its obsessive type. name: Sparrowmon
raw_text: A Digimon specializing in aerial battles that soars soundlessly at high speed. It excels not only in speed but also in maneuverability, possessing the mobility to pull off sudden turns without any difficulty. It pretty much gets carried away easily due to its moodiness. Because the quality of its flight varies depending on its current mood, one can immediately tell whether its mood is good or bad from whether it looks like it is flying well or badly. If it is performing highly difficult aerial acrobatics without even being asked, it is unmistakable proof that it is in high spirits. Sparrowmon's many extraordinary feats, which are too quick for the naked eye, thoroughly capitalize on that maneuverability it possesses. Its "{{AT|Wing Edge}}", in which it slices the opponent with its wings as it passes them by, all while continuously altering its trajectory at high speed, is only made possible with high level flight technique. The guns it wields in its hands are a set of twin pistols named "{{EQ|Zanahoria|Esp: ''Carrot''}}", made by the same [[Vulcanusmon|craftsman]] who produced their sister-gun, the "{{EQO|Berenjena|Esp: ''Eggplant''}}" possessed by [[Beelzebumon]]. {{SameProfile|DRB}}   ''{{fc|Soaring freely, it attacks with extraordinary feats too quick to catch with the eyes!|#B3901A}}''{{br}}A Digimon specializing in aerial battles that soars soundlessly at {{w|Mach speed}}. name: Spinomon
raw_text: A Dinosaur Digimon that inhabits the green depths of the jungle. It boasts the greatest and strongest powers among the Dinosaur Digimon inhabiting the Digital World, and it is said that it possesses strength equal to that of [[Dinorexmon]]. Due to its extreme belligerence it leads a highly brutal existence, but the latest research has made it clear that it possesses astonishing intelligence. The blades on its back have become its greatest feature, and since they possess excellent defensive and offensive power, if it suffers a direct attack, the attacker is forced to suffer nearly fatal wounds. Its Special Moves are shooting off the blades on its back all at once ({{AT|Sonic Slash Rain}}), and converting the metal accumulated within its body into plasma by superheating it up to 15000°, then firing it off ({{AT|Blue Prominence}}). The blades on its back keep growing back in an inexhaustible supply, so don't count on it running out of ammo. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Shoots off the blades on its back all at once. Converts the metal in its body to superheated plasma and fires it from its mouth.

name: Splashmon
raw_text: The general of the Water-tiger Army of the "[[Big Death-Stars]]". By changing itself into a liquid and moving from liquid to liquid, it is able to take the shape of a human or Digimon at will. For this reason, spying is its specialty, and it puts all the information it acquired together, then relays it to its Cyborg Digimon to implement its strategies. No matter the tactics, it always puts being beautiful as its top priority, and its personality is such that it will reject tactics that sully its own beauty. Although it leads an army, its faith is only in its own beauty, so it doesn't have even an iota of anything like mutual trust, even for the Digimon in its army. The cute, multi-colored "[[Drippin]]" water-spirits composed and formed within its body, in contrast to their appearance, each possess an offensive ability of frightening degree, including close-combat, abnormal condition, and detonation abilities, according to their color. It has become a word-of-mouth rumor that among "Drippin" there exists one packed with Splashmon's obsession, the "Miraculous Beauty Fluid" that turns the skin glossy. The army of Drippin that are fired with its "{{AT|Poisonous Force}}" paralyze the enemy force's chain of command, causing the battlefield to fall into chaos. Furthermore, with its "{{AT|Hydro Pressure}}", which shoots water of high pressure and speed from its fingertips, and its "{{AT|Bead-drown}}", which instantly gathers trace elements and converts them to liquid around the opponent's head, it possesses techniques that can cause abnormal conditions. When Splashmon gets wounded and is driven into a corner, it unzips the zippers all over its body and reveals the true form of Splashmon lying within. Those who saw this form, let alone the one who wounded it, are driven to death with its "{{AT|Tiger Typhoon}}", which consumes everything. However, because its true form is, against its will, simply hideous, it absolutely hates exposing this form. The general of the Water-tiger Army of the "[[Big Death-Stars]]". For this reason, spying is its specialty, and it puts all the information it acquired together, then relays it to its Cyborg Digimon to implement its strategies. No matter the tactics, it always puts being beautiful as its top priority, and its personality is such that it will reject tactics that sully its own beauty. Although it leads an army, its faith is only in its own beauty, so it doesn't have even an iota of anything like mutual trust, even for the Digimon in its army. The cute, multi-colored "[[Drippin]]" water-spirits composed and formed within its body, in contrast to their appearance, each possess an offensive ability of frightening degree, including close-combat, abnormal condition, and detonation abilities, according to their color. It has become a word-of-mouth rumor that among "Drippin" there exists one packed with Splashmon's obsession, the "Miraculous Beauty Fluid" that turns the skin glossy. The army of Drippin that are fired with its "{{AT|Poisonous Force}}" paralyze the enemy force's chain of command, causing the battlefield to fall into chaos. Furthermore, with its "{{AT|Hydro Pressure}}", which shoots water of high pressure and speed from its fingertips, and its "{{AT|Bead-drown}}", which instantly gathers trace elements and converts them to liquid around the opponent's head, it possesses techniques that can cause abnormal conditions. When Splashmon gets wounded and is driven into a corner, it unzips the zippers all over its body and reveals the true form of Splashmon lying within. Those who saw this form, let alone the one who wounded it, are driven to death with its "{{AT|Tiger Typhoon}}", which consumes everything. name: Stegomon
raw_text: An Armor-level Stegosaur Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Friendship]]". It has countless blades on its back. These blades are used for performing counterattacks as well as defending itself from the enemy's attacks, and Stegomon is able to will them to move in its desired direction. It sometimes attacks with the spikes on its tail; generally, however, it is said that it mostly tanks the enemy's attacks and then repels them with its blades. Its Special Move is shooting the blades on its back up into the sky, which rain down on the enemy ({{AT|Shell Needle Rain}}). Few Digimon can evade the downpour of blades, but should they manage to fully evade the attack, Stegomon will have lost all of its blades and become completely exposed; hence, it seems that it seldom uses this attack. name: Stiffilmon
raw_text: Only a small fraction of [[Filmon]] who have tempered their quills to the extreme can achieve evolution into this Perfect Digimon. The fur covering its entire body is said to rival [[Red Digizoid]] in hardness, acting as both a shield that protects its body from harm and as a weapon that boasts unparalleled offensive power. The "{{EQ|Hurricane Knuckles}}" it wields in both hands are its prided weapons, made from compressing its own shed fur to ultra-high density. It trains diligently on a daily basis, dreaming of the day that it can finally face [[Were Garurumon]]—who it views as its rival—in battle. Its Special Moves are charging forth while doing a high-speed drillspin, cleaving the opponent to bits with its bristled quills and {{EQ|Hurricane Knuckles}} ({{AT|Giga Crimson Dive}}), and causing the red, drill-shaped spears all over its body to extend, annihilating multiple enemies in one go ({{AT|Vermilion Vortex}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} The quills all over its body are powerful weapons boasting unequaled hardness. Its quills have reached [[Chrondigizoit]]-level hardness. It views [[Were Garurumon]] as a rival. The fur covering its entire body serves as a weapon that boasts unparalleled offensive power, acting as a shield that protects its body from harm. It trains diligently on a daily basis, dreaming of the day that it can finally face [[Were Garurumon]], who it views as its rival. Causes red, drill-shaped spears to protrude from all over its body, annihilating multiple enemies in one go. Charges forth while spinning at high speed, attacking with its quills.

name: Stingmon
raw_text:
An extremely unusual Insect Digimon with a humanoid form. It possesses nimble movements and a tough exoskeleton, defining traits of Insect Digimon. It excels in its abilities as an assassin, aiming for the opponent's vitals with its nimble movements and keen judgment, and specializes in attacks that silence the opponent with a single blow. It is highly intelligent and has great composure, along with a cool disposition. Its Special Move is a terrifying technique in which it skewers the opponent with the Spikes on both of its arms ({{AT|Spiking Finish}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{S2Ep|ZT|25|e=Spirit Needle}} An extremely unusual Insect Digimon, which possesses a humanoid shape.

name: Strabimon
raw_text: A Digimon that was transformed into a half-beast, half-man form when [[Wolfmon]]'s power was halved. Because it has not lost its "Combat Instinct", unlike the similar half-beast, half-man [[Flamon]], it has a ferocious side. For that reason, although it has the appearance of a Child Digimon, it will sometimes rampage enough that even the typical Adult Digimon is unable to control it. As with Flamon, although its power was decreased, it seems that Adult-class Digimon aren't a match for it. Its Special Move is cutting the opponent to pieces with the shining claws on its hands ({{AT|Licht Nagel|Light Nail}}).  {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Digimon that was transformed into a half-beast, half-man form when [[Wolfmon]]'s power was halved. name: Strikedramon
raw_text: The "{{NN|Commando Dragon}}" that aims to be a [[:Category:Virus Busters|Virus Buster]] is Strikedramon. Although there are many of its parts that are left-behind traces of [[Monodramon]], like the horn extending behind it, because it transformed into the {{FM|Commander Mode}} covered in {{EQ|Metal Plate}}, it can even be seen as a wholly different species. Although it is naturally a kindhearted Digimon since it is part of the Vaccine-species just like [[Angemon]], once it discovers a Virus-species it becomes possessed by the extermination instinct (destruction instinct?), and it won't try to stop fighting until it has reduced the opponent to trash data. It is also said that, at that time, its red hair will burst into scorching flames, and will become bluish-white hair of flames. Its Special Move "{{AT|Strike Fang}}", which is what its called when all the portions of its {{EQ|Metal Plate}} burn red hot, its whole body becomes a mass of flames, then it rams the opponent, is a terrifying technique. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Incandescently burns the metal plates on each part of it, and it is said that its whole body becomes a mass of flames and rams into the opponent. Incandescently burns the metal plates on its claws and cuts the opponent with them.

raw_text: An Armor-level Aquatic Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Sincerity]]". Its Special Moves are discharging super-compressed oxygen ({{AT|Oxygen Homing}}), and after distancing itself underwater, instantly accelerating and performing a ramming attack while spinning the drill on its snout ({{AT|Submarine Attack}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DL}} An Aquatic Digimon. name: Susanoomon
raw_text: Told of in Oriental legends, it is the strongest destructive god and the god which governs over regeneration. It is told that when the Network System descends into chaos, it will erase the existing system, and create a new one. Its Special Moves are slicing and stabbing everything in the world with the sword of light emanated from the "[[ZERO-ARMS: Orochi|{{EQ|ZERO-ARMS: Orochi}}]]" ({{w|Ama-no-Habakiri|{{AT|Ama-no-Habakiri|Heavenly Wings Beheading}}}}), and an ultimate technique in which it points the sword of light (emanated from the {{EQ|ZERO-ARMS:}} {{w|Yamata no Orochi|{{EQ|Orochi}}}}) at the heavens, which then rain incessant bolts of lightning upon the ground ({{url2|http://tinyurl.com/y89qltx|{{AT|Yakusa-no-Ikazuchi|Eight Thunder Gods}}}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} A legendary Digimon born from the union of the Spirits. It is said that it wields power able to shake heaven and earth. {{MultiDesc Slashes through everything in the world with the blade of light extending from [[ZERO-ARMS: Orochi]].{{DD|sa}} {{MultiDesc Casts down a powerful lightning bolt from the sky.{{ref|''[[Digimon Masters]]''}} Rains down blue lightning upon enemies.{{ref|''[[Digimon Masters]]''}} Gathers electricity into a spear of energy, then hurls it into the ground to summon a huge red thunderbolt.{{ref|''[[Digimon Masters]]''}}

name: Swanmon
raw_text:
An Armor-level Bird Digimon that evolved through the power of the "[[Digimental of Love]]". The appearance of its white body, long neck and wings spread out is divine. It has a habit of preferring to live in cold regions, and it is said that when Swanmon passes through the [[Network]], computers "{{w|Hang (computing)|Freeze}}". It used to be a species that behaved in bevies, but lately it often acts alone. Although the cause is unknown, it is said that a rise in atmospheric temperature within the [[Digital World]] may be the reason. Its Special Move is "{{AT|w=Down feather|Down}} {{AT|Tornado}}". It spreads its wings, and engulfs the opponent in an intensely whirling cold wind and feathers, tearing them apart with its sharp-pointed feathers. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Bird Digimon that evolved with the [[Digimental of Love]].{{br}}Special Move - Spreads its wings, and engulfs the opponent in an intensely whirling cold wind and feathers, tearing them apart with its sharp-pointed feathers. Its Special Move "{{AT|w=Down feather|Down}} {{AT|Tornado}}" is a technique where it intimidates the opponent with its wings and generates a wind with feathers.{{S2Ep|DF|42|e=Protect the Digitama! The Miracle of Disappearing Life}} Spreads its wings, and engulfs the opponent in an intensely whirling cold wind and feathers, tearing them apart with its sharp-pointed feathers. {{--}}

name: Swimmon
raw_text: A Tropical Fish Digimon with a brightly colored body. It inhabits and forms schools within the warm coral reefs right below the equator. Using its large fins, it is able to fly above the ocean's surface for short periods, and the sight of a school of Swimmon elegantly flying about the surface of the ocean is counted as one of the [[Digital World]]'s three most scenic views. The scales that cover the surface of Swimmon's body have the special characteristic of matching their coloring to the colors of their surroundings, and in case it is attacked by a gigantic aquatic Digimon, it is capable of camouflaging itself to escape difficulty. Its Special Moves are cutting the opponent to pieces with its fins ({{AT|Slash Fin}}), and firing off from its mouth the water that it inhaled through its gills ({{AT|Brine Pistol}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} Fires off from its mouth the water that it inhaled through its gills. Cuts the opponent to pieces with its fins.

name: Symbare Angoramon
raw_text: The Adult form of [[Angoramon]] that has shed the long, soft fur covering it in pursuit of agility. Although it has lost the defense offered by the cushioning fur that used to cover its body, its movements have become nimble. It strives for beauty in its behavior and movements, and in battle, it dodges the enemy's attacks as if it were dancing, in lockstep with its own attacks.{{br}}Its Special Moves are dishing out a barrage of quick kicks while standing on one leg ({{AT|w=Jive (dance)|Jive}}), spinning its body and slashing the enemy with the razor-sharp tips of its ears ({{AT|w=Ländler|Ländlizer}}), and unleashing a powerful tornado from both of its hands ({{AT|w=Breakdancing|Breakin'}} {{AT|Stream}}). It strives for beauty even when unleashing these techniques. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} Dishes out a barrage of quick kicks while standing on one leg. Spins its body and slashes the enemy with the razor-sharp tips of its ears. Unleashes a powerful tornado from both of its hands.

name: Tactimon
raw_text: A soldier Digimon that possesses a peerless sword called "{{EQ|Jatetsufūjin-maru|Snake Sealed by God in Iron}}". Within the {{EQ|Jatetsufūjin-maru|Snake Sealed by God in Iron}} is sealed a sinister power strong enough to split a star in two, so drawing this sword marks the collapse of a star. Therefore, Tactimon battles without drawing the sword, but even so, it exhibits the destructive force of its menace. If it stabs the ground once it generates an earthquake, if twice it awakens one hundred dead warriors, and if thrice it collapses the surrounding land with a shock wave. The {{EQ|Jatetsufūjin-maru|Snake Sealed by God in Iron}}, which conceals such power, is not a sword that just anyone can handle. From that alone can you understand the depth of Tactimon's true might. Even more than its merit as a soldier, it excels in strategy with plans which are even said to be, "ingenuity itself, as if gushing forth like a spring," so Tactimon's true merit is not in physical strength but in ingenuity. When Tactimon leads an army, the outcome has already been decided, and it is said that, "the victory has been decided before it even fought." Due to the various plans it has laid out, when Tactimon stands upon the battlefield it has already guaranteed its absolute advantage. name: Takutoumon
raw_text:
A God Man Digimon born from the data of a {{w|Li Jing (deity)|certain warrior}} from Chinese legend. It is a hero who despises deceiving others, and uses its sword to resolve actions that deviate from the path of righteousness. It frequently imposes its own sense of justice onto others, and since it does not even make the effort to explain itself again, it often fights alone.{{br}}It has abandoned dialogue with anyone else and remains extremely taciturn, possibly because it believes that one's own thoughts are enough as long as they make sense to oneself. When forced into a conservation with someone, Takutoumon's white mouse-shaped, mechanical pet "{{EQ|Paishū|パイシュー}}"{{note|Paishū is dervied from the creatures Chinese name, {{EQ|Báishǔ|白鼠; lit. "White Mouse"}}. It may be based on {{w|List of Journey to the West characters#Lady_Earth_Flow|Lady Earth Flow}}, a mouse character from ''{{w|Journey to the West}}'' who is friends with {{w|Li Jing (deity)|Li Jing}}.|n=N 1}} will speak on its behalf. As such, whenever Takutoumon speaks itself, it is limited to when it has something particularly important to say.{{br}}Also, its treasure tool "{{EQ|w=Pagoda|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}}", which contains data from [[Shakamon]], is housed within the gauntlet on its left palm, and since it can use this to seal away the opponent's fighting spirit, Takutoumon forces the Digimon that oppose it to become more docile.

Its Special Moves are unleashing a blade of light from its swung treasure sword ({{AT|Tenseizan|Sky Star Slash}}), and projecting an enlarged {{EQ|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}} above the opponent's head and dropping it on them, crushing them ({{AT|Tettensaisai|Iron Sky Crush}}). Unleashes a blade of light by swinging its treasure sword. Projects an enlarged {{EQ|w=Pagoda|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}} above the opponent's head and drops it on them, crushing them. {{--}} {{--}}

name: Takutoumon: Wrath Mode
raw_text: The form that [[Takutoumon]] boldly [[Mode Change]]s into when throwing itself into great battles. The {{EQ|w=Pagoda|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}} has materialized into armor, its white mouse-shaped mechanism has transformed into a trident, and its appearance is a manifestation of the data of an "{{w|Vaiśravaṇa|Eastern God}}" who is identified with a {{w|Li Jing (deity)|legendary warrior}}.{{br}}It amplifies its own power by releasing the vast amount of fighting spirit it had stolen and sealed within the {{EQ|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}} all at once. However, it is an extremely aggressive and dangerous form that went into a state one can safely say is berserk as a result of gaining this immense power.{{br}}The {{EQ|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}}, which is now its armor, not only protects its body, but can also be detached into smaller components and deployed as autonomous attack units for long-range shooting.{{br}}Its Special Move is a tricky slash attack where the detached {{EQ|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}} disperse, and reflect the trajectory of the blade of light released from its trident ({{AT|Ryūsen Rangeki|Dragon Flash Random Shooting}}). Its "{{AT|Bishamon Hakkyoku Senjin|Bishamon Eight-pole Annihilation Formation}}" is both an offensive and defensive technique in which it uses all of the deployed {{EQ|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}} units to form a defensive barrier while simultaneously firing a massive laser that can blast even mountains away. Makes the detached {{EQ|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}} units disperse, and reflect the trajectory of the blade of light released from its trident. Uses all of the deployed {{EQ|Bǎo Tǎ|Pagoda}} units to form a defensive barrier while simultaneously firing a massive laser. {{--}} {{--}}

name: Tanemon
raw_text: A Bulb Digimon with something resembling plant sprout burgeoning from its head. It is a [[Yuramon]] that floated around in search of the optimal environment, then settled into the ground and evolved. Due to its extremely timid personality, the moment it senses an intruder's presence, it will burrow into the ground with its four feet and bury its main body beneath the surface. Once it is completely hidden underground, the thing growing from its head camouflages as a plant, allowing it to defend itself from intruders. However, this is ineffective against herbivorous Digimon. {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{SameProfile|DRB}} {{--}} Shoots a series of pink bubbles from its mouth at the opponent. Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth. Tackles the opponent with all its might.{{ref|''[[Digimon Championship]]''}}

name: Tankdramon
raw_text: A Machine Digimon which functions as the riot-suppression and assault-extermination for the mechanized "[[D-Brigade]]". It specializes in the extermination of hordes of "Targets", and it boasts overwhelming firepower. It is equipped with radar which is able to {{w|radar lock-on|lock}} onto thirty "Targets" simultaneously, and if one Tankdramon supplements its "Targets" by data-linking to other Tankdramon, it is said to be impossible to escape. Also, its mission survival rate is very high, and it is said that so far only [[Darkdramon|one]] has ever been shot down during a sortie. Its Special Move is its "{{EQ|Striver Cannon}}" firing a shell loaded with a {{w|Special Atomic Demolition Munition|mini-nuke}}, reducing everything within a 30 km radius to scorched earth. Also, in close-combat it uses the "{{EQ|Blast Gatling}}" beside its cannon, which can fire all 3600 bullets in one second. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Machine Digimon. It specializes in the extermination of hordes of "Targets", and it boasts overwhelming firepower. Its Special Move is its "{{EQ|Striver Cannon}}" firing a shell loaded with a {{w|Special Atomic Demolition Munition|mini-nuke}}, reducing everything within a 30 km radius to scorched earth. Also, in close-combat it uses the "{{EQ|Blast Gatling}}" beside its cannon, which can fire all 3600 bullets in one second. Fires shots from its back cannons that split into many missiles, reducing everything within 30 kilometers of the impact to ashes. Uses the guns on its sides, which fires 3,600 shots per second.

name: Tankmon
raw_text: A Cyborg Digimon which has the appearance of a tank. Tankmon holds the alias of "{{NN|Mercenary Digimon}}", since it will assist both Vaccine and Virus Digimon as long as it is to its own benefit. With its heavyweight-power and the heavy artillery installed throughout its body, it pulverizes all approaching enemies into scrap. As it is extremely fond of strife, it chases after conflicts no matter where they occur. Wherever this lone wolf Digimon goes, conflict will never cease. Its Special Move is firing a super-powerful missile from the gun barrel on its head ({{AT|Hyper Cannon}}). {{S2Ep|DA|48|e=Bombing Mission! name: Taomon
raw_text:

Its faculty with magic is particularly high, and attacks with talismans and spells are its forte. Also, it is a master of concealed weapons, and hides various weapons up its sleeves. It doesn't talk very much due to its extreme reticence, and it is a being that lives and lurks within the darkness. Also, it is able to turn its talismans into {{w|shikigami}} and command them. name: Taotiemon
raw_text: An Oni Digimon whose body is covered in wool-like fur, wearing an object resembling a bronze ornament. While it is innocent like a child, it is an immature, cruel brat as a result.{{br}}It can be seen floating and moving through the skies over [[Jakeizan]] like a cloud. It is in a constant state of hunger—perhaps due to it having a bug somewhere—and attempts to voraciously devour any prey that catches its eye. When it preys, the ornament on its head opens wide, revealing its terrifying maw.{{br}}The talismans affixed to its head have confined it so that it can never leave Jakeizan. Because of this, it is thought to be a Digimon that has existed in the [[Digital World: Shambala|Eastern Digital World]] for a long time, just like [[Dijiangmon]] and the [[Shikyoju|others]], sealed away within the mountains by someone with immense power.{{br}}Its Special Move is sucking up prey with the enormous maw on its head, swallowing them whole ({{AT|Kyūen Donkaku|Bottomless Greed Horns}}). Its "{{AT|Etoga|Filth-vomiting Hunger}}", in which it spits out and sprays leftovers from the vast amounts of data it has devoured, completely dissolves the opponent's body. Although its "{{AT|Tōkibaku|Ravenous Hunger Explosion}}", where it triggers an explosion by releasing the power amassed in its body from overeating all at once, is immensely powerful, the recoil causes it to fall into a state of hunger even greater than usual. Sucks up prey with the enormous maw on its head, swallowing them whole. Spits out and sprays leftovers from the vast amounts of data it has devoured. Triggers an explosion by releasing the power amassed in its body from overeating all at once. {{--}}

name: Taowumon
raw_text: A Demon Beast Digimon that resembles a boar with enormous tree tusks, enveloped in freezing cold vapors. It is the largest and most sluggish among the Digimon referred to as the [[Shikyoju]].{{br}}It is usually buried underground, sleeping as stiff as ice, and rarely ever shows itself. Once it awakens, it disperses intense cold vapors from the skull on the tip of its tail, transforming its surroundings into a snowscape. It then rushes recklessly toward the outer perimeter of [[Jakeizan]], doing nothing but ram into its unbreakable barrier over and over again.{{br}}Traces of data from a [[Susanoomon|Digimon]]—also known as the "{{NNO|God of Regeneration}}" in the [[Digital World: Shambala|Eastern Digital World]]—have been found on the talismans affixed to its tusks, and it is presumed that they were deeply involved in sealing away the Shikyoju.{{br}}Its Special Moves are shooting chunks of ice from the skull on its tail ({{AT|Hyōgaireki|Icy Corpse Stones}}), and raising its forelegs up high and then slamming them into the ground, creating fissures ({{AT|Gōteihō|Thunderous Hoof Break}}). In addition, its "{{AT|Tōretsu Tōga|Extreme Cold Blockhead Tusk}}", in which it charges forth with its sharp ice-coated tusks, is a simple technique, but is powerful enough to be fatal if it hits. Shoots out chunks of ice from the skull on its tail. Slams its forelegs down, creating fissures in the ground. Performs a fatal charging attack with its sharp ice-coated tusks. {{--}}

name: Targetmon
raw_text: Repeatedly strikes the opponent with the sneakers on both of its arms. Loses control of itself and charges the opponent. Revives itself over and over with the "{{AT|Anja Serenade}}" in its heart.

name: Tekkamon
raw_text: A Digimon said to have been created by an evil [[hacker]] to destroy programs, in opposition to the "Net Keeper" [[Giromon]]. It wears a mask made of iron, and glares at its enemies with sharp eyes.{{br}}Its Special Moves are cutting the enemy's configuration data in half with a terrifyingly sharp sword ({{AT|Zandenken|Slicing Electric Sword}}), and flinging itself after turning into a {{w|Pachinko|pachinko ball}} ({{AT|Skull Stand}}). A Machine Digimon with a very small appearance just like [[Mamemon]]. Despite being tiny, it will occasionally swing down the "{{EQ|Zandenken}}" katana in its hand whenever anyone is off their guard, instantly deciding the outcome of the match. Cuts the enemy's configuration data in half with its electrified sword.{{DD|ta}}<ref name=DWDCA/> {{MultiDesc Spins around and self-destructs.<ref name=DWDCA/> Weakens the enemy's attack strength by absorbing their energy.<ref name=DW2/>
