raw_text: A Fairy Digimon that is always snuggling up to [[Petermon]]. It does its best to work with Petermon in building "[[Never-Ever Land]]", a world of children. It bounces around in the best of moods when it is with Petermon, but if it's ignored then it will angrily strike Petermon and then fly off somewhere. After that, it is happy to come looking for Petermon and meekly receive pampering. Tinkermon's wings shine, and because there is a change in the strength of the radiance when it is tense, looking at the wings' radiance is considered a good way to suss out Tinkermon's mood. It applies a paralytic nail polish to its sharply pointed, poisoned spear and nails, and if one mocks its tiny appearance, they'll suffer a massive retaliation. Its Special Move is dragging the opponent into a nightmare with the fast-acting "{{AT|Speed Nightmare}}" hallucinogen from its poisoned spear. name: Titamon
raw_text: The titan of revenge, Titamon, was born from the hatred of the Digimon defeated by the [[Olympos XII]] in battles over the sovereignty of the [[Digital World]]. It holds the alias of "{{NN|One-Man Division}}", and bearing the inexhaustible energy of its hatred within its gigantic body, it runs through the battlefield seeking the heads of the Olympos XII. Its large arms are covered in a multitude of skulls, which are all data of the power it has stolen from the enemies it has defeated so far. As its gigantic sword "{{EQ|Zanjintou|Beheading God Sword}}" is a bone sword carved from [[Skull Greymon]]'s bones, the hatred filling the sword makes a low growl. The swing of its Special Move, "{{AT|Konpaku Shingeki|Soul Core-attack}}", slides through the opponent's armor and body with its blade, reaching their [[Digicore]] unhindered and chopping it up. If one takes this technique head on, they'll never be able to recover. Its "{{AT|Genjin Mukon|Phantom-blade Unscarred}}", which eviscerates the opponent, causes them to fall into a hallucination that they are still being harrowed even after the {{EQ|Zanjintou|Beheading God Sword}} is pulled out, so that they don't stop suffering until their spirit dies. Its "{{AT|Koou Meigun|Pact with Nether-army}}" summons shades based on the skulls on both of its arms, which overrun the enemy's forces as an undead legion. This is the reason Titamon is called the "{{NN|One-Man Division}}", and it is treated as if it were a legion despite being a single being because it is able to instantly summon a mighty host. raw_text: [[Titamon]] used its strength to overpower and tame [[Skull Baluchimon]], who is thought to lack emotion. Normally, the cold black vapors flowing from Skull Baluchimon's [[Digicore]] instill the fear of death in those who come into contact with them, rendering them powerless. However, Titamon absorbed them as its own through its tenacious willpower. name: Tyilinmon
raw_text: Said to be an ancient Digimon that was born at the creation of the [[Digital World]], it is a Holy Beast Digimon that has been handed down through legend as boasting strength on par with an Ultimate, even though it is a Perfect. Although it is a Digimon that possesses mighty strength, it deeply detests conflict, and it is said that it will never shed blood. Although it has a deeply compassionate personality that loves everything living in the Digital World, when it is up against a being that commits senseless killings, it is said that it will inflict merciless punishment. Its Special Moves are abruptly swooping from the skies, running through the opponent with the horn on its head ({{AT|Shippū Tenshouken|Gale Soaring Sword}}), and using its fast movements to unleash clones and confound the opponent ({{AT|Jinsoku no Kokoroe|Knowledge of Swift}}). name: Tyrant Kabuterimon
raw_text: The "{{NN|King of Bugs}}" which governs all Insect Digimon. Its stronghold, the "[[Dark Forest|Under Forest]]", exists deep underneath the darkest forest, and it is said that it only moves at night. It is able to manipulate every Insect Digimon at will, so it almost never fights in person. Due to the high density [[Chrome Digizoid]] which compose its shell, it is thought to be impossible for ordinary Digimon to even scratch it. The red-hot explosion which it emits from its entire body ({{AT|Shine of Bee}}) is impossible to defend against, and instantly reduces all of its opponents to ash. name: Tyutyumon
raw_text: A tactician Digimon that has a tiny body but also a shrewd mind. As Tyutyumon's plans are absolutely precise, they are enough to admirably guide even the slow-footed dullard [[Damemon]] and earn great military gains through combat.{{br}}Only victory is important to Tyutyumon, and it considers the advancement of everything according to its plans to be more important than anything else. Its battles are settled before they even begin. It must be so, and it will even become partners with someone to do so, but will still betray them at any time. Lukewarm words like "friendship" and "trust" can't even be found in Tyutyumon's vocabulary.{{br}}As for those who disturb its plans, it manipulates them at will with its "{{AT|Tyutyu Twitter}}", in which it puts the opponent in a state of hypnosis by whispering into their ears. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A tactician Digimon that has a tiny body but also a shrewd mind. raw_text: A mythical [[Ancient Species]] Digimon whose activity records remain in the ancient [[Digital World]]. The more heroic its tactics and the more powerful the opponent is, the more it burns with combativeness. Its Special Moves are firing lasers that rival a solar heat ray from the "{{EQ|Rudriya Darpaṇa|Terrifying Mirror}}" superweapons{{Note|The {{sanskrit|Rudriya Darpaṇa|रुद्रियदर्पण|rudriya darpaNa|lit. name: Vulcanusmon
raw_text: One of the [[Olympos XII]], it is a Digimon "{{NN|God of Smithery}}". Most well-known weapons are the work of Vulcanusmon, and the famous "{{EQO|Berenjena|Esp: ''Eggplant''}}" cherished by [[Beelzebumon]] is also an article of Vulcanusmon's. It has an artisan's pride and a stubborn personality. It sees through the competence of its clients, and when it feels that they can not master or will not treasure the weapon, it will deny the request. When building, it performs with a standard of work corresponding to the other party. As such, the "{{EQO|Berenjena|Esp: ''Eggplant''}}" that it put all of its effort into after being charmed by Beelzebumon's power is considered to be an excellent article, even by Vulcanusmon. Although it's a Digimon that freely manipulates its eight arms and works in silence, it exhibits an artisan's style even in battle. It radiates its "{{AT|Bomber Art}}", flames to use for welding, and manufactures then and there an appropriate weapon to fit the situation ({{AT|Pinpoint Weapon Works}}). Furthermore, during its "{{AT|Appropriate Works}}", in which it equips its weapons, manufactured one after another with its "{{AT|Pinpoint Weapon Works}}", to each of its arms, all of Vulcanusmon's power is fully unleashed. However, Vulcanusmon's own fighting ability is not very great, so it prefers working behind the scenes to fighting in person. name: Xiquemon
raw_text: A different kind of Bird Digimon that travels freely in the air and water. It contains fish data within its [[Digicore]], and dives directly into the water from a flying position, swimming and hunting as if it were flying. It is said that the reason why it wears goggles is to protect its vision while swimming. It is a migratory bird that inhabits cold lakes and rivers, and travels across the [[Digital World]] in search of new habitats once the water temperature rises. Witnessing Xiquemon flying around in search of a nest is considered to be a sign of good luck, and it is renowned as a Digimon that brings good omens. Since the amount of food it eats at a time is small, it has a habit of using a technique to freeze and preserve leftover food.{{br}}Its Special Moves are traveling underwater at high speed and launching a surprise attack on land enemies ({{AT|Bakusen|Waterfall Flash}}), and firing a small fish-shaped missile from its mouth ({{AT|Gyoryūhō|Fish Stream Cannon}}). name: Zamielmon
raw_text: The general of the Wood-spirit Army of the "[[Big Death-Stars]]". It has dominion over many Fairy and Plant Digimon which are able to blend in with the land of meadows and forests to camouflage themselves. It goes forward with things in a calm and collected manner, and in surprise attacks, pincer attacks, exterminations, feints, blitzes, guerrilla attacks, or any other tactic it pleases, it directs its army to make the extermination of its enemies successful. As enabling such a strategy definitely needs strict iron discipline, it possesses enough of a cool head that in situations where its subordinates throw its movements out of order, it snipes from anywhere to deal with it. No matter what the strategy is, its own actions are considered to hold the key to success, so it shoots through the opponent's head with its "{{AT|Snipe Headshot}}" while rushing about the battlefield. Its body is trained in various techniques, and it freely draws the techniques out in order to fire arrows from its hands with its "{{AT|Arrow Lance}}", slash with its "{{AT|Bow Cutter}}" that uses the bow on the side of its abdomen as a blade, and trick-fire with its "{{AT|Foot Shot}}" that it prepared in its feet. Even if it is surrounded by a group, it slashes at its neighbors with its "{{AT|Turbulence Arrow}}", then fires arrows into the distance and shoots the opponents dead with its random firing, without missing a single shot. When facing formidable and gigantic opponents, it deals with them using its "{{AT|The World Shot}}", a bold move that concentrates energy into the gigantic "{{w|Indra|{{EQ|Indra}}}}" arrow that is set on its abdomen, then pierces it into the opponent's core. name: Zanbamon
raw_text: A Demon Man Digimon which has the appearance of a horse-riding warrior. It is a courageous warrior who reigns as the general of the [[Musyamon]] corps. Although it is a general, it voluntarily stands at the head of its own army, and prefers fighting styles which cut into the enemy. Its lower half is fused with its horse in order to move more easily about the battlefield, so that even during a pitched battle it is able to swing its sword without losing its balance. Its Special Move is using the gigantic {{w|zanbato}} "{{EQ|Ryūzan-maru|Dragon Beheader}}" it holds in its right hand to unleash its "{{AT|Uchikubi Gokumon|Prison Gate of Beheadings}}", which has the power to cut through the opponent's armor with its gigantic blade, regardless of whether they are defending themselves. name: Zanmetsumon
raw_text: A swordmaster Digimon that freely wields five swords. It wanders the [[Digital World]] and devotes itself to battle, thinking only about honing its sword techniques. It is capable of unleashing slash attacks in all directions from the swords it holds in its four hands and the one equipped to its tail, so it is difficult even for those with considerable skill to avoid them completely. Its Special Moves are a combo attack with its five swords ({{AT|Goren Danreizan|Five Continuous Soul-rending Beheadings}}), and slashing from five directions simultaneously ({{AT|Gojū Rasendachi|Quintuple Spiral Slash}}). It also has a technique called "{{AT|Gokumon-Shibari|Prison Gate Bind}}", in which it lets out a huge roar from the maw on its torso to restrict the opponent's movements, but because it believes in slaughtering its opponent only by slashing them, it rarely performs this. A combo attack with its five swords. Slashes from five directions simultaneously. Lets out a huge roar from the maw on its torso to restrict the opponent's movements.

name: Zassoumon
raw_text: A subspecies of the [[Vegimon]] species whose body is completely green. Unlike Vegimon, it does not ripen and turn red; in turn, it has obtained the vitality of a weed, allowing it to survive no matter how many times it is cut or beaten. Its Special Move is using its vine arms to squeeze the enemy ({{AT|Squeeze Vine}}). A subspecies of the [[Vegimon]] species whose body is completely green. name: Zeed Millenniumon
raw_text: Flying freely between space and time, it is a king of evil that is still trying to destroy all eras and worlds. Although a Digimon will become a [[Digitama]] if defeated in battle, there are very rare occasions when it has instead been reborn from within the corpse of its data. According to one theory, when [[Millenniumon]] died in a furious battle, the dark soul it possessed was reborn as Zeed Millenniumon. Also, as for the bands which wrap around Zeed Millenniumon, it is said that they are like chains which suppress its abilities, but it is unknown who could cast such a spell on Zeed Millenniumon.<ref group="N" name="Bands">These bands consist of the original web address for [[Digimon Channel]], "<nowiki>http://www.digimonchannel.or.jp</nowiki>". In ''[[Digimon Ghost Game]]'', it instead uses the current web address, "http∶//digimon.net".</ref><ref group="N" name="Card">On card ''[[Bo-742]]'', the code around Zeed Millenniumon is in the form of an iterated url: ''<nowiki>http://www.digimonchannel.or.jp</nowiki>''</ref> However, it is foretold that if it is released from this spell, it will rain unfathomable destruction upon the Digital World. Its Special Move is "{{AT|Time Destroyer}}", which consigns hostile opponents to oblivion across space and time. So far, no one who has been brushed off by this technique has returned alive from space and time. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Wicked God Digimon. Its Special Move is "{{AT|Time Destroyer}}", which consigns hostile opponents to oblivion across space and time. {{MultiDesc {{MultiDesc Imprisons the opponent in a dark spherical dimension where time is compressed.{{ref|''[[Digimon Masters]]''}} Detonates space-time around the opponent.{{ref|''[[Digimon Masters]]''}} Fires streams of purple and green energy from its mouths, annihilating enemies.{{ref|''[[Digimon Masters]]''}} Fires a barrage of fireballs from its [[Chimairamon]] head and ice crystals from its [[Mugendramon]] head.{{rfe|GG|61|''Resurrection''|b}}

name: Zeke Greymon
raw_text: Zeke Greymon is a new form attained when the legendary Digimon bestowed "[[Evolution]]" upon a [[Metal Greymon (2010 Anime Version)|Metal Greymon]] that sought perfect victory. Its body armor, bestowed by the legendary Digimon, is solid, virtual super-metal called [[Chrome Digizoid]], and it was enhanced further to form a body of "[[Gold Digizoid]]", which emits a noble, golden radiance simply due to its dazzle. It is surprisingly lightweight for the great defensive ability it possesses, so its movements are more agile than one would imagine from its heavy-looking armor.{{br}}Zeke Greymon's combat strength has high, all-round potential. It specializes in a strategy where it restrains the enemy with the "{{AT|Plasma Railgun}}" on its right hand, while chopping them up in a single blow to their trunk with its "{{AT|Trident Fang}}", and it deals with long-range or high-altitude enemies by shooting a high-power energy shot ({{AT|Hyper Launcher}}). Also, when facing a large army, it burns most opponents to cinders with its "{{AT|Zeke Flame}}", in which it spews hellfire out of its mouth, and when facing a formidable opponent, it slaughters them by maintaining a lowered stance while it becomes an arrow of shining light and charges at them, releasing the energy at point-blank range to atomize them ({{AT|Final Strikes}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} ''{{fc|Metal Greymon "Evolved" due to the power of the legendary Digimon!|#B3901A}}''{{br}}{{br}}A new form attained when the legendary Digimon bestowed the "[[Evolution]]", upon a [[Metal Greymon (2010 Anime Version)|Metal Greymon]] that sought perfect victory. name: Zenimon
raw_text: A mechanical-looking Digimon in the shape of a 5-yen coin that resides within [[Ganemon|Ganemon's]] trunk. It silently collects money for Ganemon; Zenimon is also able to emit a special wave that attracts money to great effect. It is also said that there are Digimon who seek out Zenimon in order to exploit those waves it emits. Its Special Moves are launching rice grains from the guns on both hands ({{AT|Comet Launcher}}), as well as tossing a fellow Zenimon towards the opponent, striking them ({{AT|Zeninage|Coin Toss}}). name: Zephagamon
raw_text: Transforms each of the swords in its hands into boomerangs, and unleashes a slashing attack enveloped in a tornado.{{DD|ka}} Transforms its wings into wind energy forms and bisects the enemy as it passes by them.{{DD|ka}} Expands the wings on its chest and releases the maximum amount of wind energy from its [[Digicore]].{{DD|ka}} In its "exposed Digicore" form, releases an even greater amount of wind energy than {{AT|Divine Tempest}} from one of its hands.<ref name="Liberator 11" /> In its "exposed Digicore" form, creates an energy sword of wind and slashes its opponents with it.<ref name="Liberator 11" />

name: Zerimon
raw_text: An extremely rare Digimon, which is born in pairs from a single [[Digitama]]. The reason why only Zerimon and [[Cocomon]] are born as twins is unclear at the present stage. Moreover, they are not restricted to always being born as twins, and either a Zerimon or Cocomon may be born from a single Digitama. Compared to the extremely energetic, one-horned Zerimon, the three-horned Cocomon has a relatively docile personality. In addition, unlike other Slime Digimon, more of Zerimon than just the horn on its head is firm-knit and rigid. Like other Baby Digimon, it spits acid bubbles to intimidate opponents. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Spits acidic bubbles to intimidate enemies.{{DD|sa}}

name: Zhuqiaomon
raw_text: One of the [[Four Holy Beasts]] who protect the Digital World, it guards the South and manipulates incandescent flames. Reigning since the age of myth, its existence has passed into legend, and it is extremely difficult to track down. Also, it is difficult to overthrow with the power of an ordinary Ultimate, and its power is set as the highest authority among other Digimon, so it is surely the epitome of a god. Zhuqiaomon's temperament is the roughest among the Four Holy Beast Digimon, and it incinerates anything that approaches it without reason. Its Special Move is a swirl of flames comparable to the {{w|Solar prominence|prominences}} which jet out with a solar eruption ({{AT|Kouen}}). {{SameProfile|DRB}} ''This profile matches its partner in the [[Digimon Reference Book]], except that a picture of [[Xuanwumon]] is mistakenly shown.'' name: Zombie Plutomon
raw_text: A strange state in which [[Plutomon]]'s [[Digicore]] shut down due to reaching the end of its lifespan, yet only its body continues to function. It no longer has free will, and has lost its sense of purpose in defeating evil. It is a cursed being that thinks of nothing but indiscriminately devouring the data of others, endlessly roaming about in search of Digicores. It is a "terrible predator" in a completely different sense to when it was alive, and its decaying body will never be satiated, no matter how many Digicores from others it consumes.{{br}}Its Special Moves are absorbing data from the Digicore of an enemy it grabs until it rots away ({{AT|Hazard Hold}}), emitting X-particles from its left hand in the shape of a sickle and mincing the enemy with it ({{AT|Hell's Slice}}), and infecting the enemies it has bitten with its own virus, turning them into its puppets ({{AT|Marionette Abomination}}). {{SameProfile|DRB|except for different paragraphing}} Absorbs data from the Digicore of an enemy it grabs until it rots away. Emits X-particles from its left hand in the shape of a sickle and minces the enemy with it. Infects the enemies it has bitten with its own virus, turning them into its puppets.

name: Zubaeagermon
raw_text: "I, who am the Twentiest, will never halt! I'm going to keep on running forth!" With those words carved into [[Zubamon]]'s heart, it evolved into a form that embodies that forward-charging style. Zubaeagermon's policy is simply to continue charging forth without pause, no matter if smooth or rough terrain awaits it, or even if it has to crawl and struggle to continue forward.{{br}}Its Special Moves are thrusting straight into the enemy's chest while shouting "Twentiestttt!!" ({{AT|Road T(w)o Decade}}), and curling its body into a ball and spinning towards the enemy, slicing them with its tail blade ({{AT|Vingtième|Fra: "Twentieth"}}). Not only that, by transforming itself into its prided sword form, it is able to slice through any enemy using 100% of its strength. {{SameProfile|DRB}} It advances without stopping even on flat land or bad roads! It is a Weapon Digimon which can transform into a sword!! Thrusts straight into the enemy's chest while shouting "Twentiestttt!!".{{DD|sa}} Curls its body into a ball and spins towards the enemy, slicing them with its tail blade.{{DD|sa}}

name: Zubamon
raw_text: One of the "[[Weapon Digimon|Legend-Arms]]", who are capable of transforming themselves into weapons. A legend about the Legend-Arms goes, “if held by an angel it will save the world, and if held by a demon it will destroy the world.” Zubamon carries the ”Twentiest” data, and often shouts out “I am the Twentiest!” despite not understanding what it means. It despises crookedness, and is constantly seeking sharpness. A day where its battles, jokes, and sharpness turn out well will leave it in high spirits. Although it has a technique, "{{AT|Twenty Dive}}", in which it charges head-first, Zubamon's true power is exhibited while it is in its weapon form. {{SameProfile|DRB}} Charges head-first at the opponent.{{DD|sa}} {{--}}

name: Zurumon
raw_text: As a Digimon that was born from fusing a malevolent [[computer virus]] and the negativity of humans who abuse computers, it is a special Slime Digimon which differs from other Digimon in its root cause<!--precipitating factor/cause of origin-->. It nimbly maneuvers its pliable body, and moves as if crawling across the ground. Because the substance composing its body is a potent toxin, and it spews intensely venomous bubbles from its mouth, even large Digimon will not approach it. {{SameProfile|DRB}} A Digimon that was born from the fusion of a super-malignant [[computer virus]] and a computer [[hacker]]'s evil desires.
